title: Creative Strategist
description:
**About fonio**
===============

**We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.**

Fonio is Europe’s market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we’re expanding globally and into new products.  
We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.  
Join one of **Europe’s fastest-growing companies**.

**Your role**
-------------

You own the *how we say it*. All day, you concept and script ads: hooks, angles, and narratives that stop the scroll and convert. You work closely alongside the Creative Director, who sets final direction - but day-to-day you run independently. Full ownership over your scripting, no micromanagement loops.

**What to expect**
------------------

* You script and concept paid ads at pace — hooks, angles, storylines
* You own the creative angles for our campaigns and constantly develop new approaches
* You work closely with the Static Ads Designer and Content Creator to turn concept into finished output
* You operate autonomously; the Creative Director sets direction and gives final sign-off
* You test, learn from performance data, and iterate

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

* Experience scripting paid ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) with demonstrable performance
* You think in hooks and angles and understand what stops people in the feed
* You produce fast and at volume without sacrificing quality
* Genuinely excited about AI and the space
* Very good English

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary: €65,000–€100,000
* Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.
* Food & drinks - lunch and dinner are on us at the Vienna office (plus all the drinks you want, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).
* Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)
* Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.
* Regular team offsites.

**Hiring process**
------------------

* 15 min intro call
* Case study (take-home)
* 30 min skill interview (walk-through of your case)
* 20 min culture fit

Compensation Range: €65K - €100K

title: Senior Art Director (Beauty, Skincare, Wellness & Lifestyle)
Performance Creative Strategist — Freelance
description:
**Modalidad: Freelance · 100% remoto (España / UE, horario CET)**

**Idiomas: español nativo o profesional · inglés fluido**

### **Sobre el rol**

En Ironhack buscamos un/a Performance Creative Strategist freelance que combine pensamiento creativo, copywriting y estrategia orientada a performance. Alguien que entienda la publicidad digital desde la idea hasta el resultado: que sepa identificar un insight, convertirlo en un concepto creativo potente y traducirlo en anuncios capaces de captar la atención, generar interés y convertir.

Trabajarás mano a mano con nuestra diseñadora gráfica para convertir las ideas en creatividades listas para testear, aprender y escalar. La autonomía y el criterio creativo son clave: esperamos que detectes la oportunidad, desarrolles la idea y des una dirección clara a diseño hasta su ejecución.

### **Tus responsabilidades**

* Performance creative y copywriting: desarrollarás conceptos, hooks, headlines, body copy y CTAs orientados a conversión, partiendo de los pain points y motivaciones de nuestra audiencia (cambio de carrera, empleabilidad, progresión profesional). Serás responsable del criterio creativo y estratégico final.
* Conectar datos y creatividad: junto al equipo de Marketing, usarás métricas como CTR, CPA, CVR y frecuencia para detectar oportunidades y convertirlas en nuevas hipótesis, ángulos, formatos y variaciones creativas.
* Dirección creativa y briefing: no necesitas ser diseñador/a, pero sí tener un criterio visual y publicitario sólido. Crearás briefs y/o wireframes que indiquen qué debe comunicar la pieza, qué debe captar la atención, cuál es la jerarquía del mensaje y qué elementos deben destacar. Darás feedback y dirigirás las iteraciones hasta llegar a la creatividad final.
* Creative research e innovación: investigarás de forma continua la Meta Ad Library, TikTok y otras fuentes para identificar tendencias, formatos y oportunidades, analizando competidores directos e indirectos y siempre respetando nuestro Brandbook y posicionamiento.
* Project management: gestionarás el proceso creativo de principio a fin: planificación de ideas, briefs, coordinación con diseño, seguimiento de entregables y preparación de los assets finales para su lanzamiento, cumpliendo los plazos acordados.

### **Lo que buscamos**

* Creative thinking y performance copywriting — Prioridad #1. Generas ideas publicitarias originales que destacan en un feed saturado y sabes explicar por qué deberían funcionar, qué insight explotan y cómo se pueden testear. Tu portfolio demuestra publicidad digital orientada a performance, no solo piezas visualmente atractivas.
* Project management — Prioridad #2. Eres una persona organizada, metódica y autónoma en remoto. Sabes estructurar proyectos, gestionar prioridades y coordinar a otros perfiles para entregar a tiempo.
* Experiencia demostrable en creative strategy para Meta Ads, idealmente en entornos de performance marketing.
* Criterio creativo y atención al detalle. Trabajas dentro de unos Brand Guidelines y Value Propositions definidos sin perder la capacidad de proponer ideas nuevas y diferenciadoras.
* Orientación a resultados. Quieres entender por qué funciona una creatividad y usas los resultados de cada test para alimentar la siguiente ronda de ideas.
* Idiomas: español nativo o profesional para escribir copy; inglés fluido.

### **Será valorable**

* Experiencia en agencia de publicidad
* Experiencia con funnels de adquisición y lead generation.
* Conocimientos básicos de CapCut (edición de vídeo) y Figma.
* Experiencia creando o participando en contenido UGC.

### **Proceso de selección**

* Candidatura: responde a las preguntas de selección e incluye el link a tu portfolio en tu CV.
* Caso práctico: te lo enviaremos por email (45–60 min de trabajo estimado).
* Entrevista: defensa del caso práctico y revisión de un proyecto real de tu portfolio y sus resultados.

### **Portfolio**

Para valorar tu candidatura, incluye un portfolio con ejemplos de performance creative. Siempre que sea posible, añade no solo las piezas y el copy, sino también el contexto del test, el objetivo y los resultados (CTR, CPA, CVR u otras métricas relevantes).

Nos interesa entender qué problema intentabas resolver, cuál era tu hipótesis creativa, cómo llegaste al concepto, qué ejecutaste y qué aprendiste. Las candidaturas sin portfolio no serán consideradas.

title: AI Creative Strategist
description:
Impact Clients is building a new organic growth channel around highly targeted social media pages in the supplement space, each with its own character, audience, voice, and content strategy.

The goal is simple: create genuinely useful content that earns attention organically, builds trust with specific demographics, and ultimately drives supplement sales through relevant affiliate offers.

As our **AI Creative Strategist**, you’ll own the thinking behind the content: developing new characters and avatars, finding angles that resonate with different audiences, writing hooks and scripts, analyzing what performs, and building a repeatable creative system that can scale across dozens of pages.

This isn’t only a content role.

What we learn from building this division will eventually become part of the curriculum taught inside our education company. You’ll help train our coaches and students on what’s working while also giving direct product feedback to our engineering team on the AI creative tools you use every day.

You’ll be helping build the playbook from zero.

**ABOUT IMPACT CLIENTS**

Impact Clients is a fast-growing tech-enabled education company helping everyday people build online businesses through a combination of education, coaching, community, and proprietary software.

Our culture is built around **clarity, extreme ownership, high standards, and speed of execution**.

We move quickly. We expect people to solve problems without constant direction. And we give talented people a significant amount of ownership when they demonstrate they can produce results.

If you thrive in environments where creativity and speed go hand-in-hand, where your work gets implemented immediately, and where you're expected to think like an owner rather than an employee, you'll fit in well here.

***This is a fully remote, full-time role.***

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

* **A blank canvas.** Start from zero and shape the avatars, angles, accounts, and content strategy from the ground up.
* **A path to leadership.** Help build the team as the channel grows, with the opportunity to eventually lead the creative division.
* **A team around you.** Work alongside AI video editors and publishing support so your time stays focused on strategy, copy, and creative direction.
* **Freedom to test.** No ad spend approvals or endless creative bottlenecks. Put ideas into the market, learn what works, and iterate quickly.
* **Simple production.** Let the strength of the idea carry the content without the heavy production requirements often associated with paid creative.
* **Exposure across three business units.** Help build a new supplement division, shape how the playbook is taught inside our education business, and influence the roadmap of our proprietary software.
* **Real influence beyond your own function.** What you discover can become curriculum taught to thousands of students, while your daily use of AI tools helps determine what our engineering team builds next.

**WHAT YOU’RE GETTING INTO - The Day To Day of this Role:**

* Creating the AI avatars: determine which demographics deserve their own character, what those characters should represent, and which concepts should be killed.
* Generate **10–20 new ideas, hooks, and angles every day** for short form 7-30 second reels.
* Write and direct scripts for **30–60 second organic Reels**, then hand them to the AI video editing team for production.
* Own what gets tested across **5–10+ Instagram and Facebook accounts**, each with its own personality, demographic, and content strategy.
* Match message to demographic precisely. A 45-year-old man and a 68-year-old woman should not receive the same hook, framing, or script.
* Turn genuinely useful information into content that earns trust first, allowing the offer in the bio to convert second.
* Study account-level performance and identify which avatars, hooks, formats, and topics are receiving organic distribution.
* Retire weak avatars and scale the characters and concepts that show traction.
* Turn winning creative patterns into repeatable systems rather than one-off successes.
* Help build the department once the model is proven, including future strategists, editors, and publishing support.

Approximately 10–20% of your time:

* Once the model is proven, help build course content for the company's education division
* Run a weekly group coaching call helping students apply what we've learned.
* Give our software engineering team hands-on feedback about how to improve the internal AI tools you use every day.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You come from the **direct-response Meta advertising world**, ideally within supplements, health, wellness, or another performance-driven ecommerce category.
* You have produced paid creative at meaningful volume — ideally **hundreds or thousands of assets per month**.
* You are a strong direct-response copywriter, and developing hooks, angles, and concepts is one of your favorite parts of the job.
* You've developed messaging for demographics significantly different from your own.
* You understand that what moves men aged 40–50 may be completely different from what moves women aged 60–70 — and you know how to adjust the creative accordingly.
* You can look at performance data and turn what is working into the next generation of creative ideas.
* You are comfortable testing aggressively, killing losing concepts quickly, and doubling down on winners.
* You are highly fluent with AI creative tools. Our current stack includes **Higgsfield, Google Flow Omni, Openart, and CapCut**.
* You can operate independently without needing a detailed SOP for every decision.
* Ideally, you've also worked on an **info-product, course, or coaching-based offer**, particularly in the make-money-online or start-an-online-business space (optional, though preferred).

The ideal candidate brings an unusual combination: **ecommerce/supplement direct-response experience + strong creative strategy and copywriting + familiarity with info-product or coaching businesses.**

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In Your First 90 Days On Our Team**

**30 Days:**  
Three to five avatars are defined, scripted, and actively in production. A consistent daily idea pipeline exists so the editing team is never waiting on creative direction. The first Reels are live across the initial accounts.

**60 Days:**  
We have a clear understanding of which characters, hooks, topics, and angles Instagram and Facebook are actually distributing. Weak avatars are being retired, winning concepts are being expanded across additional accounts, and each audience is matched to a relevant offer.

**90 Days:**  
A repeatable system exists from avatar brief creative concept script production published Reel performance analysis across 5–10+ accounts, without requiring you to manually touch every step.

You should also be able to clearly tell us what the department needs next, where the bottlenecks are, and who we need to hire to continue scaling it.

If this is role is exciting to you, then apply by filling out the questions below. Truly take your time with putting in quality effort into the Loom video, and our team will be in contact with you to schedule interview within 24-48 hours.

title: Creative Engineer / AI Creative Technologist
description:
We’re looking for a **Creative Engineer / AI Creative Technologist** to explore what’s possible with the rapidly evolving generative media ecosystem and turn that exploration into exceptional model examples, workflows, and content.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of generative AI, creative technology, and technical storytelling. You’ll work directly with image and video models, experiment with different models and workflows, push them to their limits, and figure out how to consistently get the best possible creative results from them.

You’ll turn that experimentation into compelling examples, workflows, guides, and social content that show developers and creators what is possible with Runware and help us move quickly around new model releases.

We’re looking for someone who is already deeply immersed in generative media — not simply using AI tools, but understanding how models, prompting, pipelines, conditioning, and automation fit together, and knowing how to combine them to produce standout creative output.

**What you’ll do**

* **Experiment hands-on with new generative image and video models**, understanding their capabilities, limitations, and how to get exceptional results from them.
* **Build and refine advanced generative-media workflows**, combining models, prompting techniques, conditioning, automation, and tools such as ComfyUI.
* **Create standout model examples, workflows, demos, and visual content** that demonstrate what developers and creators can build with Runware.
* **Turn technical experimentation into engaging content** for model launches, social media, guides, workflow breakdowns, and other creator- and developer-facing channels.
* **Develop repeatable and automated generation workflows** that make it possible to produce high-quality creative output efficiently and at scale.
* **Stay close to new model releases and emerging techniques**, rapidly testing them and identifying opportunities for compelling content and examples.
* **Work closely with Growth, Product, and Engineering** to surface interesting use cases, support launches, and share insights from model experimentation and the wider generative AI ecosystem.

  
**Requirements**  

* **3+ years of relevant experience** in generative media, creative technology, creative engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* **Advanced experience with ComfyUI or comparable workflow tooling**, with the ability to build sophisticated, repeatable pipelines combining models, conditioning, prompting, and automation.
* **Coding and API experience**, including building custom integrations, scripts, tools, or ComfyUI nodes.
* **Strong knowledge of the generative media model ecosystem**, with practical experience across multiple image and/or video models such as FLUX, Stable Diffusion, Wan, LTX, Hunyuan, Kling, or similar.
* **A strong creative eye and a portfolio of high-quality generative AI work** that demonstrates both technical depth and the ability to get exceptional creative results from models.
* **Strong technical communication skills**, with the ability to turn complex experiments and workflows into clear, engaging content for developers and creators.
* **Ability to work independently and move quickly** in a rapidly evolving ecosystem of models, tools, and techniques.  
    
  **Nice to have**
* + Experience working at a **generative AI model, inference, or developer platform company**.
  + Experience with **model adaptation or fine-tuning**, such as LoRAs.
  + Contributions to **open-source generative AI projects or communities**.
  + Experience **presenting technical or creative work publicly**, through talks, workshops, livestreams, conferences, or similar formats.

  
**Benefits**

We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.

Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready & stronger than ever for the next leap.

* **Generous paid time off** – vacation, sick days, public holidays
* **Meaningful stock options** – share in the upside you create
* **Flexible hours** – own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
* **Family leave** – paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
* **Company retreats** – twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

title: Senior AI Creative Designer
description:
CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our core values guide our approach to building and refining an internal product ecosystem that powers profitable acquisition models, flexible scaling, and optimized operations. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

**Role overview**

Our Design department is scaling its AI visual production capabilities - and we're looking for a **Senior AI Creative Designer** who will produce **high-quality visual creatives** with **the primary goal of improving conversion rates**. We’re looking for a designer who is deeply engaged with the fast-moving AI landscape, proactively tests new tools, features, and approaches, and is driven to continuously improve how AI is used in day-to-day creative work.This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, generative AI, and performance marketing - creating visual assets that capture attention and convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google, and landing pages: **from static ads to lifestyle imagery and photorealistic human characters.**

You will work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to produce assets that are photorealistic, visually compelling, and true to client product specifications.

**Responsibilities**

**AI Visual Production:**

* Create high-quality AI-generated visuals for performance marketing campaigns across paid media channels and landing pages.
* Produce photorealistic human imagery, lifestyle scenes, and product-focused visuals.
* Work with source materials from photo shoots - enhance, retouch, and extend imagery using AI tools.
* Generate multiple creative variations to support testing and scaling across campaigns.
* Ensure consistency with brand guidelines and product requirements across all assets.

**Creative Iteration & Testing:**

* Iterate on visual concepts based on performance data and creative feedback.
* Explore different visual angles, hooks, and formats to improve conversion rates.
* Collaborate with copywriters and marketers to align visuals with messaging and funnel logic.
* Translate briefs into multiple creative directions, not just single outputs.

**Quality & Realism:**

* Ensure high visual quality and realism (lighting, composition, anatomy, textures).
* Identify and fix common AI issues (artifacts, distortions, inconsistencies).
* Maintain a strong visual standard across all generated content.

**AI Tools & Workflow:**

* Use modern AI tools and models to generate, refine, and enhance visual assets.
* Actively research, test, and integrate new AI tools to improve output quality.
* Work within structured production workflows with a focus on execution and creative output.

**Performance & Optimization:**

* Understand how visual content impacts campaign performance and audience engagement.
* Adjust creative output based on data and testing results.
* Support A/B testing by delivering multiple creative variants.

**Collaboration:**

* Work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to ensure creative alignment.
* Provide visual input during concept development and campaign planning.
* Ensure assets are structured and ready for use in video production and marketing funnels.
* Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards.

  
Requirements:  
  

Skills & Background:

* 3-5+ years of experience in **design, visual content creation, or creative digital marketing** (paid social, social media content, performance campaigns)
* 1-2+ year of active hands-on **experience with AI image generation** platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar) - **producing photorealistic human imagery, lifestyle scenes, and product-focused visuals.**
* Cross-platform proficiency, experience in connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite).
* **Strong visual sense**: composition, lighting, color, typography, realism, and human anatomy.
* **AI-Geek:** stays close to AI news and new releases, experiments hands-on with emerging features and workflows, and is constantly looking for smarter ways to improve the quality, speed, and effectiveness of creative work.
* Ability to conduct audience/target group research and reflect it properly in the visuals
* Understanding of **performance marketing basics** (CTR, hooks, conversion-focused creative).
* Ability to iterate quickly based on feedback and data.
* Strong attention to detail and visual quality.
* Proactive mindset - suggesting improvements, not just executing tasks.
* Clear communication and strong collaboration skills.
* **Portfolio with AI-generated photorealistic visuals** demonstrating quality and high-end visual sensibility.
* Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher.

Nice to Have:

* Basic understanding of how static visuals translate into video production pipelines.
* Experience producing creative assets for high-CPA verticals (home services, insurance, finance, or similar).
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.

**﻿**

**What we offer**

* **Remote Work -** we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
* **Paid vacations** - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
* **Unlimited Sick Days** - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
* **Ongoing Learning** - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
* **Home Office** -we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
* **Physical Well–Being** - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
* **Fun Stuff** - there is never a shortage of fun stuff

title: Creative Director
description:

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.
  
  
We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.
  
  
**About The Team/role**
Reporting to Checkr's VP of Marketing, the Creative Director, Head of Brand will set the creative vision for how Checkr shows up in the world, while owning and evolving our newly refreshed brand identity.
  
  
This role will lead Checkr's Brand Studio team and creative execution across Marketing's full portfolio of work, turning brand strategy into distinctive, memorable creative that builds recognition and preference for Checkr. The role will build brand into an operating system — clear standards, briefs, and review processes paired with AI-powered, self-serve tools — so the rest of the company can produce great work without the team touching every asset. Partnering closely with teams across Marketing, Internal Communications, HR, and Product, and advising executives on how Checkr shows up and is perceived, this leader will play a defining role in the company's reputation as it continues to grow.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Set and lead the creative vision for Checkr, translating brand strategy into distinctive ideas, campaigns, and experiences that build recognition and strengthen the brand over time
* Own and evolve Checkr's newly refreshed brand identity system — visual language, voice, and design standards — ensuring it's applied consistently and thoughtfully while continuing to push the brand creatively as the company scales
* Lead and inspire the Brand Studio team, raising the creative bar through strong direction, mentorship, and a high standard of craft, while continually exploring new ways of working — including AI tools and processes — used additively to extend the team's craft, never in place of it
* Lead the development of high-impact brand campaigns and creative platforms from concept through execution, bringing strong creative judgment to work across channels and formats
* Build brand into an operating system — standards, briefs, review cycles, and clear decision rights — paired with AI-powered, self-serve tools, and partner across Checkr to put those tools directly in every team's hands

* Advise Checkr's executives on brand positioning and narrative, and partner with Marketing leadership to align brand strategy with go-to-market priorities

* 10+ years of experience in creative and brand leadership

* Demonstrated use of AI tools in real, shipped brand work, with a clear point of view on where automation belongs and where human judgment and craft are non-negotiable
* Proven judgment shaping brand and narrative at the company level, with experience advising executives on positioning
* Rigorous measurement instincts — defines and owns brand health metrics like awareness and sentiment as a discipline in their own right, alongside campaign performance

title: Creative Director, Fundraising and Mobilization (Evergreen)
description:
Interested in joining Blue State's Creative Director team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission.

If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.

**What to know**
----------------

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we're delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands' social impact teams.

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We're looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We're interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

**The company**
---------------

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

**A day in the life**
---------------------

* **Lead and inspire:** Working closely with your colleagues, you'll develop a vision for our client's creative success. You'll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.
* **Create with purpose:** Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
* **Accountability:** Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.

description:

26WD100658
  
  
**Creative Director, Product & Experiences — Flow Studio (Remote)**

We’re looking for a
**Creative Director**
to help define what AI filmmaking can become with Autodesk Flow Studio. This is a rare opportunity to shape both the creative direction of the product itself and the films, experiments, demos, and cultural moments that show the world what it can do.
  
  
This is an AI-first, hands-on creative leadership role embedded within the Flow Studio Product organization. You’ll have significant creative freedom, lead a dedicated content team, work closely with Product leadership, and get hands-on with emerging AI filmmaking tools and workflows. The work can range from ambitious cinematic showcases and AI films to fast-moving social experiments designed to earn attention organically.
  
  
You’ll own the creative bar for everything that lives in or represents the product: the creative look and feel of key product surfaces, cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, templates and examples, demos, launch storytelling, and other content that helps creators understand what Flow Studio can make possible.
  
  
You’ll also be the primary product-side creative partner to Flow Studio Marketing, helping shape concepts, promos, launch videos, campaigns, social content, and other external storytelling. Marketing leads audience, campaign, channel, and brand strategy; this role brings the product’s creative vision, AI filmmaking expertise, cinematic taste, and product truth into the work.
  
  
The ideal person is already deeply engaged in AI filmmaking, has exceptional visual taste and a strong cinematic eye, understands internet culture and social trends, and wants the freedom and resources to make ambitious work that people actually want to watch.
  
  
**Please submit a portfolio or reel with your application.**

* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.

**Qualifications**

* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.

* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.

title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$157,505—$218,000 USD
  
  
**The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation**
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
  
  

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:**
  Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:**

title: Associate Design Director
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well-known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

  

**WHAT’S AN ASSOCIATE DESIGN DIRECTOR AT HOOK?**

Hook is seeking a hands-on Associate Design Director to join one of our teams.

Associate Design Directors are experienced leaders who use design to exceed client goals, while working within the guard rails of existing brand marketing strategies. They operate alongside creative and motion teams, serving as a client-facing bridge between high-level brand strategy and systematic visual execution. They create robust visual languages and scalable design frameworks that power industry-leading content across static and animated mediums.

They are driven experts with a passion for making premium, ground-breaking work and a commitment to fostering the talents of the employees they collaborate with. They are fearless executors who elevate the work into new creative territories. They’re fundamentalists when it comes to digital design, but approach projects with rational and innovative mindsets, always mindful of how it looks and how it works.

Associate Design Directors are ready for hands-on projects at every stage of the life cycle, from brainstorming creative concepts with the project team and developing original campaigns, to participating in client presentations and ensuring deadlines are met, to building dynamic design systems and overseeing high-volume production rollouts that scale seamlessly across digital, video, print, and emerging platforms.

They have a well-established process for concept development, using visual presentations, storyboards, and mocks to communicate solutions to peers, leadership, and clients. They also excel at translating bold concepts into modular, extensible design systems. With expertise in design tokenization, asset automation, and end-to-end production pipelines, they ensure pixel-perfect, efficient client delivery at scale, always on time and on spec.

While this role would oversee tactical production workstreams, their responsibilities will also focus on strategic and conceptual visual design challenges for national and global brands/campaigns. With an existing design team in place, and opportunities to recruit additional talent, previous experience with team and project leadership within a rapid production environment will be a critical skill. Given the close proximity to marketing clients, being an excellent communicator and an overall joy-to-work-with will also go a long way toward success.

While this role can work from any approved location, this person must have the flexibility to work around PST hours as the team’s clients are based on the West Coast.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Demonstrate a mastery of visual design across design disciplines
* Execute, manage, and govern original, conceptual, and system-driven visual design work in line with agency standards and complex brand design systems
* Build and maintain comprehensive visual design systems, component libraries, and modular toolkits that empower teams to produce high-volume assets efficiently without losing creative fidelity
* Apply design rigor to provide mentorship to cross-functional teams with the goal of accelerating skill progression
* Inspire, oversee, and provide mentorship to design staff with the goal of accelerating skill progression through a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and knowledge sharing
* Fluently speak the language of design with both clients and creatives enabling effective feedback and direction
* Demonstrate emotional intelligence in all meetings and communications
* Work closely with creative staff to ensure design work goes above and beyond the expected
* Maintain and promote internal best practices around modern production design, tool integrations, automated workflows, and standardized asset handoffs
* Model a sense of ownership that elevates the standards and quality of all work achieved by the designers
* Demonstrate an ability to work on multiple projects at the same time while maintaining clear vision of priorities
* Lead projects and oversee a team to ensure that work is client-ready at all phases of their projects
* Manage direct reports to help shape and grow their careers as it relates to their hard and soft skill development

  

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship in design, with expertise working on design solutions as it relates to campaigns and visual systems across multiple platforms
* Expertise in visual design with a deep focus on design systems, component architecture, and multi-channel campaign scaling
* Proven experience leading design streams, multi-format adaptation pipelines, and modular creative rollouts for complex, multi-market campaigns
* Have outstanding communication and presentation skills
* Be imaginative, collaborative, conceptual, and curious
* Have an optimistic outlook toward client revisions, knowing when and how to offer opportunities to push boundaries creatively
* Generate and maintain enthusiasm for ideas within the agency as they move from concept to execution
* Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator) alongside a strong technical understanding of digital production formats, asset optimization, and platform specs
* Mastery of Figma (variables, auto-layout, component libraries, dynamic templates) to build scalable design infrastructure and drive workflow efficiencies
* Additional programs and skills are great to come with (illustration, motion/After Effects, 3D/Cinema 4D)
* Have direct experience—and an enthusiasm for—team leadership and mentorship

  

**WHAT ELSE**

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a link to a portfolio/body of work that demonstrates a breadth of experience.

This is a full-time position that can be hybrid or remote, depending on geographic location. We're a close-knit group of people who love what we do and want to create phenomenal work.

Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, wellness stipends/continuing education subsidies and more.

At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Creative Director - Paravel Insights
description:
Creative Director - Paravel Insights

**Creative Director**
=====================

**Location:** Remote, U.S. Based
  
**Type:** Full-Time Contract

**About Paravel Insights**
--------------------------

Paravel Insights is a strategy, marketing, and creative agency that exists to empower visionary and faith-based organizations. We partner with mission-driven clients across advocacy, education, nonprofit, political, and cultural spaces to help build meaningful movements and high-impact campaigns.

Our team thrives in fast-moving environments where strategy, creativity, and execution work hand in hand. We value excellence, initiative, adaptability, humility, and strong collaboration.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Paravel Insights is seeking an experienced, strategic, and visionary **Creative Director** to lead our creative department and oversee creative direction, strategy, development, and execution across our client accounts and campaigns.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for guiding the entire creative process, from initial strategy and conceptual development through design, copywriting, storytelling, film and video production, and final execution.

We are looking for someone who can see the big picture while maintaining a strong understanding of the details that make great work successful. The ideal candidate brings a combination of creative vision, strategic thinking, strong leadership, and hands-on expertise.

We need someone who can lead a multidisciplinary team, develop strong campaign concepts, oversee visual and written content as well as film and video, establish clear standards, and ensure everything produced by the department is strategically aligned and executed with excellence.

The right person will be comfortable leading creative conversations, presenting and defending ideas, making decisions, mentoring team members, and taking ownership of the department's performance and output.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Creative Department Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead and oversee Paravel's creative department, including design, copywriting, film and video, and related creative disciplines.
* Serve as the primary day-to-day leader of the department, providing clear direction, support, and accountability.
* Establish and maintain high standards for quality, consistency, collaboration, and execution.
* Provide mentorship, coaching, professional development, and performance feedback to team members.
* Partner with the Design Director to ensure strong visual leadership, effective design execution, and consistency across projects.
* Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment that encourages innovation, initiative, ownership, and excellence.
* Partner with executive leadership on department structure, staffing needs, resource planning, and long-term team development.
* Establish and improve workflows, review processes, and departmental practices that support both quality and efficiency.

### **Creative Vision, Strategy & Direction**

* Lead the development of compelling campaign concepts, brand narratives, messaging approaches, and integrated creative strategies.
* Collaborate closely with strategists and account leads to translate client objectives, audience insights, and campaign strategies into effective creative solutions.
* Oversee concept development from initial brainstorming and strategic planning through final execution.
* Guide the creative direction of campaigns across multiple clients, industries, and platforms.
* Ensure that creative decisions are intentional, strategically grounded, and aligned with client goals.
* Bring fresh perspectives, original ideas, and innovative approaches to campaign development and creative challenges.
* Evaluate concepts and provide clear, constructive feedback that strengthens the work.
* Help identify opportunities to elevate campaigns, improve storytelling, and increase overall impact.
* Contribute to new business opportunities, pitches, presentations, and strategic planning initiatives.

### **Design, Copywriting, Film & Content Oversight**

* Provide leadership and direction across visual design, written content, film, and video, ensuring cohesive creative execution.
* Oversee brand identity development, campaign design, advertising creative, messaging, copywriting, film and video production, content development, and storytelling.
* Ensure that design, copy, and video work together to communicate clear, compelling, and strategically aligned messages.
* Ensure all campaign messaging, copywriting, and written communications reflect natural American English, appropriate cultural context, and the intended tone and voice for U.S. audiences.
* Provide creative direction for video campaigns, television commercials, digital advertising, branded films, and other video content from concept through final production.
* Collaborate with internal production teams, videographers, editors, directors, and external production partners to ensure a cohesive creative vision.
* Guide creative development across digital, print, social media, websites, film, video, advertising, presentations, events, and other campaign channels.
* Review and approve creative concepts, designs, messaging, scripts, storyboards, video treatments, and final deliverables for quality, accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment.
* Work closely with the Design Director to maintain high visual standards while providing overarching direction across the department.
* Lead copywriters in developing effective messaging, headlines, campaign narratives, advertising copy, scripts, and other written communications.
* Maintain a strong understanding of design principles, copywriting, brand strategy, visual storytelling, audience engagement, and multichannel execution.
* Provide hands-on creative guidance and contribute directly to concept development or execution when needed.

### **Campaign Development & Execution**

* Lead the creative development of integrated campaigns and initiatives from initial concept through launch.
* Oversee campaign identities, messaging frameworks, visual systems, content development, and supporting creative assets.
* Ensure a cohesive approach across campaign platforms, channels, and deliverables.
* Guide creative work for brand launches, awareness campaigns, fundraising initiatives, advocacy efforts, recruitment campaigns, advertising, and storytelling experiences.
* Oversee the creative direction of film and video projects, including concept development, scripting, storyboarding, production planning, and post-production review.
* Partner with production teams to ensure commercials and video content align with campaign strategy, messaging, and overall creative vision.
* Balance ambitious ideas with practical considerations, including budgets, timelines, resources, and client expectations.
* Collaborate with project managers and account leads to ensure projects move efficiently from planning to delivery.
* Identify challenges early, provide solutions, and help keep projects moving forward.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities, evolving strategies, and new client needs.

### **Quality Control, Accountability & Department Performance**

* Take ownership of the overall quality, consistency, and effectiveness of work produced by the department.
* Establish clear review and approval processes to maintain high standards across all deliverables.
* Ensure creative work aligns with approved strategies, client objectives, brand guidelines, and project requirements.
* Provide decisive, constructive feedback and ensure revisions strengthen the final product.
* Work closely with project managers to maintain accountability for deadlines, deliverables, and project milestones.
* Evaluate campaign performance, client feedback, and results to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Identify and implement improvements to creative workflows, team collaboration, and departmental efficiency.
* Maintain a high standard of excellence while empowering team members to take ownership of their responsibilities.

### **Cross-Department Collaboration & Client Leadership**

* **Reporting Structure:** Report directly to the Senior Marketing Strategist (Account Lead) and the Chief Operating Officer (Acting Executive Creative Director).
* **Department Leadership:** Directly oversee and lead the Design Director, designers, and copywriters, while providing creative direction and oversight for film and video production.
* Translate strategic direction from the Senior Marketing Strategist and executive creative direction from the COO into clear, actionable guidance for the creative team.
* Collaborate closely with executive leadership, senior strategists, account managers, project managers, and production teams.
* Serve as a key creative leader in internal planning, campaign development, and strategic discussions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, campaign reviews, and creative workshops.
* Present concepts confidently, communicate strategic rationale, and guide discussions with internal teams and clients.
* Build strong working relationships across departments to ensure alignment between strategy, creative development, and execution.
* Help bridge the gap between strategic vision and the practical work required to bring campaigns to life.
* Communicate proactively regarding creative needs, project challenges, priorities, and opportunities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Must be based in the United States and legally authorized to work in the U.S.
* Exceptional written and spoken English proficiency, with native-level fluency, is required.
* 8+ years of professional experience in creative, advertising, marketing, branding, or campaign development, preferably within an agency environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading creative teams, departments, or multidisciplinary creative initiatives.
* Proven ability to oversee design, copywriting, and film and video, with a strong understanding of how these disciplines work together.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative direction, integrated campaign development, brand strategy, advertising, storytelling, and high-quality execution.
* Experience developing and leading campaigns from initial strategy and concept through production and launch.
* Experience providing creative direction for film, video production, television commercials, digital advertising, or branded video content.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, scripting, production workflows, editing, and post-production, with the ability to guide specialized production teams.
* Strong understanding of branding, art direction, design, copywriting, content strategy, advertising, and multichannel marketing.
* Ability to translate complex strategies, audience insights, and organizational objectives into clear and compelling concepts.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and developing creative professionals while maintaining accountability and high performance standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, organization, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and fast-moving projects without sacrificing quality.
* Comfortable collaborating directly with senior leadership, strategists, account teams, and clients.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to evaluate both the big-picture strategy and the finer details of execution.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and modern design and production workflows.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, or similar collaboration and project management tools preferred.
* Experience with web development, motion graphics, or emerging creative technologies is a plus.
* Experience working with advocacy, nonprofit, education, faith-based, or mission-driven organizations is a plus.

**Cultural Alignment**
----------------------

At Paravel, culture matters deeply. We are looking for someone who:

* Leads with confidence, humility, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Is proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented.
* Can inspire and develop team members while holding them accountable.
* Thinks strategically and creatively, always keeping the bigger objective in mind.
* Communicates clearly, professionally, and proactively.
* Is comfortable making decisions, providing direct feedback, and navigating challenges.
* Values excellence without allowing ego to get in the way of collaboration.
* Takes initiative and looks for opportunities to improve processes, ideas, and outcomes.
* Adapts quickly and works well in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
* Is comfortable supporting mission-driven and faith-based organizations and working across a variety of client perspectives and initiatives.

**Why Work With Paravel**
-------------------------

* Opportunity to lead and help shape the creative department of a growing, mission-driven agency.
* Meaningful leadership role with influence over creative direction, team development, and departmental performance.
* Opportunity to work on high-impact campaigns across branding, advocacy, advertising, film, video, media, and storytelling.
* Collaborative environment with direct access to executive leadership and strategic decision-making.
* Talented multidisciplinary team with opportunities to mentor, develop, and strengthen creative professionals.
* Variety of projects, clients, and campaigns that provide ongoing opportunities for new challenges and innovative thinking.
* Flexible remote work environment.
* Fast-moving agency culture that values initiative, excellence, collaboration, and strong leadership.

**To Apply**
------------

Please submit a resume, portfolio or portfolio link, and a short introduction outlining your experience and interest in the role.

We are especially interested in seeing examples of campaigns or initiatives you have led from strategy and concept through final execution, including integrated campaigns, branding, advertising, and film or video projects.

Please highlight one's experience leading creative teams, overseeing design and copywriting, directing film and video projects, developing integrated campaigns, and collaborating with senior leadership and clients.

This is a remote, U.S.-based position. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Exceptional written and spoken English proficiency is required.

Applications without relevant portfolio examples demonstrating creative leadership and campaign development may not be considered.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
------------

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore.

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That's not a policy. It's just who we are.

It is working, with tens of thousands of families trusting us. But most of the people who need us have never heard of us. By the end of 2027, we expect half of America's seniors will know who we are.

You will be the author of what they see. This isn't about directing a campaign. It's about building a courageous, iconic household brand close to scratch, with real budget and real creative license behind you. We aren't trying to rent attention. We want the kind of organic awareness that comes from people recognizing us, remembering us, and telling each other about us. If that's what you want to spend the next few years on, we'd love to talk.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* You will set our creative direction as we scale from <10% of American seniors and their families knowing about us to >50% in 2027. That’s millions of impressions. Super-bowl-commercial scale.
* You'll decide how Community Phone looks everywhere it shows up: TV, paid social, web, direct mail, the box, and our social channels. A family should recognize the same brand whether they see us at 9pm on TV or open the box at mom's house.
* You will be the steward of our brand, ensuring all platforms, from paid ads to customer newsletters, meet our brand standards.
* You'll take the brand identity system our design agency is launching in mid-October and make it world-class. Their work is the starting point. Scaling it across every surface and pushing it further is your job.
* You'll do the real work yourself. You'll design the website, the box, and the pieces that define us, and you'll be excited to make things rather than just advise on them.
* You'll build the creative machine for paid social and guarantee the quality of its output.
* You'll own creative performance alongside growth. Beautiful work that doesn't move CAC isn't done yet.
* You'll build the team that scales the brand with you.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* You have 8+ years in creative direction, and you've built a phenomenal consumer brand.
* You have a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative work across digital, retail, social, packaging, experiential, film, photography, and product storytelling.
* You have both agency and in-house experience. You know how to get great work out of a studio, and you know what it takes to live with a brand every day.
* You grew up on the visual side of creative direction (art direction, design, motion), and you have real experience leading copy and concept too.
* You still love making the work. Your best days are the ones where you're designing, not sitting in review meetings.
* You believe in the power of AI in creative work. You use it every day, you know where it makes the work better, and you're excited about what it makes possible next.
* You've made creative that performs at scale, ideally across TV, paid social, and physical.
* You have experience managing production budgets, agencies, freelancers, and complex creative programs.
* You have excellent taste.
* You have superlatively high humility, intelligence, and hunger. Great creative reveals truths that were already there. It is a pursuit of truth just as much as a pursuit of beauty. The people who can do it seem to possess these three qualities to a high degree.
* You have the judgment to operate as the entire creative function today, and you want to push and be pushed by the growth team.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've designed packaging and unboxing for a consumer hardware or DTC product.
* You've worked on eldercare, health-adjacent, or other trust-sensitive consumer brands.

**How we work**
---------------

We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly to our Cofounder who runs Revenue and Operations, and you'll have a very direct line from your work to customers who will tell you, often within the same day, whether you got it right.
