title: Creative Director
description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Creative Director leads creative strategy, brand identity, and creative operations for High Profile's marketing organization. This role directs creative across every channel, with depth in paid and organic social, and builds AI-enabled systems that let the team scale. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at a strategic altitude while simultaneously able to get hands-on needed, doing the work and setting an example when needed. The Creative Director works with autonomy and brings fully formed recommendations to the VP of Marketing.

**JOB DUTIES:**

Core duties and responsibilities include the following.

**Creative Strategy & Brand Stewardship**

* Accountable for creative direction across every channel and format, including in-store, wholesale support, internal packaged brands, traditional media, paid digital, and organic social. Set the bar and give final creative approval before work goes to the VP of Marketing or other stakeholders.
* Lead creative ideation for tentpole campaigns. Facilitate brainstorms with marketing teams to generate the strongest ideas in the room. Set the creative throughline for each initiative: the core idea, tone, visual direction, and example executions, as inspiration for channel directors to build strategies against.
* Serve as the primary steward of brand identity across all channels once standards are established, holding the internal team and any outside partners or agencies accountable to them.
* Bring an external point of view on creative quality, benchmarking High Profile's output against strong work in retail, CPG, and adjacent categories, and raising the team's overall craft bar.

**Channel Expertise & Growth Channels**

* Define a high quality standard for High Profile's paid advertising creative across digital and traditional media, including display, paid social, video, direct mail, and out-of-home. Produce to that standard across all operating states and their compliance rules.
* Own creative direction and content quality for paid digital and organic social, partnering with the Digital team, which owns channel strategy, targeting, and media spend, to ensure content performs and reflects brand standards.
* Lead creative concepting for campaign and initiative-level work, including seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives, and new channel launches.
* Lead the Design Manager on creative direction for traditional media, maintaining quality and consistency in High Profile's highest-spend traditional channels.

**Creative Operations & Systems**

* Own and rethink High Profile's highest-volume recurring production processes, beginning with the weekly promotional workflow, identifying opportunities to reduce manual production time through AI-assisted tools and improved systems.
* Evaluate and implement AI and workflow tools across the creative team to increase throughput and creative capacity without adding headcount.

**Team Leadership**

* Provide strategic direction, workload prioritization, and professional development to the creative and design team.
* Build a scalable, well-documented creative operating model that teaches frameworks for creative thinking, brief writing, and critique.
* Report on creative team performance, capacity, and initiative progress to the VP of Marketing. Owns creative & design budget and manages to target.
* Builds productive working relationships within marketing and with cross-functional partners: buying & planning, retail, compliance, wholesale, and facilities.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Leads a team of four: Design Manager, Production Packaging Designer, Senior Graphic Designer, and Graphic Designer. This role directly manages the Design Manager, Packaging Designer, and Graphic Designer. Creative Director will also direct external paid media agencies.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

* 6+ years in creative roles, with at least 3 years as a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or equivalent.
* 3+ years at an integrated, full-service, or brand agency in a concept-leading role (copywriter, Design Manager, ACD, or CD), creating campaign ideas rather than only producing assets.
* Agency work for retail, consumer, or regulated-category clients, including campaigns that ran in-store as well as in paid, social, and CRM channels.
* Portfolio with integrated work from concept through execution across three or more channels.
* Portfolio evidence of distinctive paid media creative across digital and traditional channels.
* Strong, current point of view on social-native content, ideally with experience connecting content quality to measurable performance.
* Experience building or improving creative production systems and workflows, familiarity with AI-assisted workflows strongly preferred.
* Experience managing a creative or design team of 3+ people.
* Experience leading brainstorms or concept development with cross-functional partners who don't report to them, with examples of ideas others built out across channels.
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and bringing proactive recommendations to leadership.
* Cannabis or other regulated industry experience a plus, but not required.

title: Creative Director
description:
EverOn Data Center Services is seeking a highly creative, strategic, and execution-oriented Creative Director to lead the development and implementation of the company's visual identity and creative initiatives across all marketing, sales, and corporate communications channels, including video production, podcast development, and multimedia storytelling.

As a key member of the Marketing & Sales team, the Creative Director will be responsible for translating EverOn's business objectives, brand positioning, and marketing strategies into compelling visual and multimedia experiences that strengthen brand recognition, support business development, and communicate the company's expertise in the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

This individual will serve as the organization's internal creative authority, ensuring brand consistency, design excellence, and high-quality execution across digital, print, presentations, proposals, events, video, podcasts, and other customer-facing materials. The Creative Director will also lead the creative development and production of video and podcast content, from concept and production planning through recording, editing, and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative vision with strong project management capabilities and a hands-on approach to design, video, audio, and multimedia production. This role requires the ability to balance strategic creative thinking with day-to-day execution in a fast-paced, growing organization.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Creative Direction & Brand Management**

* Lead the creative direction and visual execution of EverOn's brand across internal and external communications.
* Serve as the primary steward of EverOn's visual identity, ensuring consistent application of brand standards across all channels and materials.
* Translate company positioning, business priorities, and marketing objectives into impactful creative concepts and visual communications.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, design systems, templates, and creative standards as the company grows.
* Establish and uphold standards for design quality, visual storytelling, multimedia production, and creative consistency.

  + Digital and social media graphics
  + Website graphics and digital assets

  + Event branding, signage, and environmental graphics

  + Motion graphics, animation, and multimedia content
* Ensure all creative deliverables meet brand standards, quality expectations, and established deadlines.

* Oversee final artwork preparation, production specifications, and coordination with external vendors when necessary.

### **Video Production, Podcast Development & Multimedia Storytelling**

* Lead the creative development, production, and post-production of video and podcast content that supports EverOn's marketing, thought leadership, employer branding, and customer engagement initiatives.

* Plan and coordinate video shoots, podcast recordings, interviews, project footage, and other multimedia production activities.
* Direct or execute filming, audio recording, editing, motion graphics, sound design, and post-production activities.
* Develop and maintain consistent visual and audio branding for EverOn's video and podcast programming.
* Produce multimedia content for corporate communications, social media, website initiatives, recruiting, customer presentations, and industry thought leadership.
* Create short-form video clips, promotional trailers, audiograms, and other supporting assets to extend the reach and value of long-form content.
* Identify emerging multimedia formats, production technologies, and creative approaches that enhance EverOn's storytelling capabilities.

* Work collaboratively with the Chief Customer Officer, marketing team, sales organization, executive leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
* Support the marketing team in the execution of campaigns, brand initiatives, corporate events, and digital marketing programs.
* Collaborate with internal content owners to translate approved messaging into visually engaging materials.
* Ensure creative work is aligned across internal teams and external partners while minimizing duplication of effort.

### **Creative Operations & Project Management**

* Manage the creative production process from initial concept through final delivery.
* Establish clear creative briefs, project timelines, production schedules, and approval workflows.
* Prioritize creative requests based on business impact, urgency, available resources, and established marketing priorities.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows, standardize processes, and increase production efficiency.
* Maintain visibility into creative project status, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Ensure appropriate version control, file organization, and accessibility of final creative assets, including video and audio content.
* Evaluate and recommend creative tools, technologies, production equipment, and processes that improve quality and productivity.
* Provide guidance and creative feedback to internal contributors while fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment.

### **Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, Multimedia Production, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in graphic design, creative development, brand management, multimedia production, or related creative disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading creative direction and managing complex creative projects.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing expertise in branding, visual storytelling, presentation design, digital creative, and multimedia production.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and related design and editing applications.
* Demonstrated experience in video production, editing, and post-production workflows.
* Working knowledge of podcast development, audio recording, editing, and production processes.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to create sophisticated executive-level and customer-facing presentations.
* Experience developing and maintaining corporate brand guidelines and design systems.
* Strong understanding of digital, print, video, and audio production processes, file preparation, and creative asset management.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and execute projects with minimal oversight.

* Experience developing, producing, or managing branded podcast series.
* Familiarity with video recording equipment, lighting, microphones, and podcast recording setups.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

* **Drive the Core ML Platform Vision:** Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
* **Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios:** Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
* **Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure:** Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
* **Establish Model Evaluation and Governance:** Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
* **Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance:** Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
* **Elevate and Mentor the PM Function:** Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

* **Uncompromising Quality Standard:** High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

* Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe's premier digital banks.
* Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
* A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.
* An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

**Comprehensive Benefits:** We provide free private health insurance, a €200 monthly stipend for meals and transportation, and a yearly allowance for professional development.

**Team & Culture:** We are a team of talented people who love what they do and support each other. You can look forward to regular team events and after-work hangouts.

##### **Ready to apply?**

Send your portfolio, as well as your CV and cover letter in English. We review applications continuously, so don’t wait!

Let’s build something amazing together!

title: Head of Content Performance
description:
**We've set the standard in kids entertainment.** 
**Come help us raise it.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.

Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we've earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

**You in? Keep on reading.**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Our Studios create the games and content kids love. This role decides what that content has to achieve, and makes sure it does.

You're the data-driven counterpart to our creative leadership. They own how we make it. You own what we make, what we double down on, what we kill, and what success looks like.

Nobody will ask you to tell us what the data says. You'll be asked to go get the answer, yourself or through our analysts, and turn it into a decision you're accountable for.

* **Run the content portfolio.** Decide which games and content we greenlight, extend, double down on or retire, based on how much they contribute to paid subscriber retention.
* **Set success criteria for new content.** Define the targets a new game has to hit before launch and at every review after: early engagement, repeat play, retention of engaged users. "Shipped" is not a success metric.
* **Own content's contribution to paid retention.** It's your team's primary KPI. You define the leading indicators and defend them.
* **Lead release and live-ops.** Own the weekly release cadence and the content calendar: when we ship, how we package, slice and sequence content, and who sees what, when. Our Content LiveOps Manager reports to you.
* **Keep experiments running.** Build a steady pipeline of tests on launch, packaging and surfacing, with clear rules on what's worth shipping.
* **Shape how the app presents content.** Work with Product and Design on in-app surfaces, discovery and features so the content we make gets found and played. With our Director of Personalization, you define what recommendations need to achieve for content. They own the engine.
* **Tell the content performance story.** Give leadership a clear view of what content is delivering and what we do next.

### **Where the role sits**

* Reports to the VP of Studios. Peer to creative and production leadership in Studios.
* Main internal customer of the Product/Content & Engagement analytics team in Business Performance. Business Performance owns company-level metric definitions and the value-of-content measurement. You build on them, you don't duplicate them.
* Works with Growth on shared in-app surfaces, owning the Studios side.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* You've owned game or content performance as the accountable PM, GM or live-ops lead in a games business. A KPI you delivered, not one you reported.
* You've made greenlight, scale and kill calls based on data, and can walk us through the ones you got wrong.
* Fluent in retention curves, cohorts, engagement and session metrics, renewal. You know what moves them, and you tell signal from noise.
* Hands-on enough to get your own answers (SQL, Amplitude or equivalent), and you know how to brief analysts to get the rest.
* You've run a release cadence, content calendar or live-events pipeline.
* Commercial, not creative. You respect creative work and push it with targets, not taste.
* You've led a small team and built a function from a partial starting point.

**English is a must:** We’re a multicultural team providing a service in **English**, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective **spoken and written communication**, especially in asynchronous and long-form formats, is key to collaborating successfully.

##### **Life at Lingokids**

**Career Growth:** Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to **€2,000 per year** for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

**Remote-Friendly:** Work from where you’re most productive, home or our offices in Madrid, anywhere within a **2-hour difference from Spain (GMT+1)**. The choice is yours!

**Stock Options:** Your contribution matters! You'll receive **stock options**, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

**Home Office Setup:** Create your ideal workspace with a **€400 allowance** for setup and **€35/month** for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

**Meal Allowances:** Get **€60/month** on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

**Flexible Compensation:** Manage your **meal, transport and childcare expenses** easily with **Cobee**, integrating them directly into your payroll.

**Health Insurance**: Access **private health coverage** at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

**Language Lessons:** Learning never stops! Enjoy **free language classes** in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

**Visa Sponsorship:** If you need a **visa to work in the EU**, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

**Company events**: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

### **Passion matters more than perfection**

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

### **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

description:

PMY is a full-service provider of technology, data, and creative solutions for the live environment.

title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
description:
Established in 2004, **OLIVER** is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of **The Brandtech Group**, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our **AI solutions** enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

### **Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)**

**Language requirement:** fluency in German or Spanish

**Location:** Spain (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

**Employment:** permanent

**About the role:**

We're hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You'll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You'll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren't there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you'll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

#### **New Business and Client Engagement**

* Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
* Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
* Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren't present, and know when and how to bring them in.
* Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

#### **Requirement Gathering and Analysis**

* Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
* Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
* Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

#### **Operating Model and Solution Design**

* Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
* Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
* Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
* Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

#### **Commercial Modelling**

* Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
* Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
* Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

#### **Stakeholder Communication**

* Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
* Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

#### **Data, Measurement and Reporting**

* Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
* Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

#### **About You:**

#### **Essential**

* 10-15 years' experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
* A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
* Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
* A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
* Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
* Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren't in the room.
* Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
* Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

#### **Desirable**

* Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
* Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
* Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

#### **What Success Looks Like:**

* Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
* Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
* Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
* Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

title: Freelance Campaign Manager, Beauty (UK/ Europe)

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. title: Editor, Marketing
description:

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a Video Editor on Darkroom’s internal Marketing Team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the visual storytelling behind our brand. You'll work closely with our Video Lead, Design Lead, and Director to transform raw content into engaging, high-impact videos for platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. This is a fast-moving, creative, and collaborative role for someone with sharp instincts, strong technical skills, and a passion for crafting content that connects with audiences.

In this role, you’ll develop a scalable, high-output video content engine that fuels Darkroom’s brand voice. You’ll design a creative system for rapid, high-quality production across channels, repurposing standout moments from podcasts, events, and behind-the-scenes footage. With a performance-driven approach to storytelling, you’ll adapt quickly to platform shifts, experiment with new formats, and continuously refine output based on real-world results.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Social-First Video Editing**

* Edit and produce standout content across short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and long-form (YouTube, webinars).
* Create native video formats optimized for IG, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X, including repurposed edits and cutdowns.
* Build scroll-stopping hooks, apply text overlays, closed captions, sound design, and motion graphics that support performance.
* Turn voice notes, podcasts, webinars and interviews into polished, platform-native video content.
* Surface and extract the most compelling moments from raw footage: podcast soundbites, behind-the-scenes gems, founder tangents, interviews, etc.
* Collaborate with the Video Lead on edits, structure, and narrative framing.
* Organize, tag, and manage footage to create a systemized pipeline for recurring content formats.
* Understand performance data and collaborate with the marketing team to refine editing strategies based on what drives reach, engagement, and conversion.
* Test hooks, variations and formats to optimize output over time.
* Stay ahead of editing trends and platform algorithm shifts.

### **Production Excellence**

* Apply finishing touches: color correction, transitions, graphics, and text effects that align with the Darkroom brand language.
* Deliver content in multiple aspect ratios and formats for cross-platform distribution.
* Maintain high audio fidelity, visual clarity, and consistent branding across deliverables.
* Proactively troubleshoot creative or technical challenges and recommend solutions.
* Support post-production for Darkroom’s podcast and event recordings.
* Add intros/outros, audio enhancements, and accessible subtitles.

**You’re a Great Fit If You:**
------------------------------

* Have 3-4+ years of experience editing content for social-first brands, creators, or agencies.
* Know your way around Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and have working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and motion graphics.
* Have a sharp eye for storytelling, pacing, and rhythm, and you know how to build content that keeps attention.
* Understand editing for performance, not just aesthetics. You know what performs on TikTok vs. YT Shorts vs. LinkedIn.
* Are fluent in optimizing content across multiple aspect ratios and formats.
* Can own your edit from concept to final export while staying collaborative, communicative, and open to feedback.
* Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments where no two days (or edits) are the same.
* Are organized, meticulous, and always ready with a plan B (or C).

### **Bonus Points If You:**

* Have experience editing founder-led content or personal brand material.
* Have worked on performance-driven or growth marketing creative.
* Use AI tools (Descript, Runway, etc.) for cutdowns, transcription, or speeding up your workflow.

**What it's like to work at Darkroom**

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

* Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
* Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
* Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
* Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
* Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

**This role is currently a Talent Pool, which means we are not actively interviewing — but plan to do so in the near future. We want to be transparent and cognizant of your time.**

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

title: Global Revenue Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage.

We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

 **Job Description**

**QAD** is seeking a **Global Revenue Marketing Manager** to own and execute strategic go-to-market campaigns and drive pipeline generation globally. This role is based in EMEA (Spain/UK preferred) and reports to the Director of Revenue Marketing.

This role sits within the Revenue Marketing team and partners closely with the Director of Revenue Marketing and the broader Revenue Marketing organization to set strategy, run integrated campaigns, and deliver pipeline contributions globally.

This role is responsible for deciding and developing *both customer and new logo* revenue campaigns, focusing on industry-specific campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and drive measurable revenue impact across QAD's manufacturing solutions portfolio.

You will partner closely with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, and global channel partners to run multi-channel GTM motions, from account-based strategies to broad-based demand generation, executing against the global pipeline plan set in partnership with the Director of Revenue Marketing.

*This remote role requires 10–15% travel to represent and align marketing strategies at key industry gatherings, including Champions of Manufacturing (CoM) events, annual Sales Kickoffs, and integrated marketing planning meetings.*

**What You’ll Do**

* Decide and develop customer and new logo revenue campaigns, with a focus on industry-specific campaigns, in partnership with the Director of Revenue Marketing
* Run strategic GTM motions, including ABM, digital campaigns, and webinars, aligned to global pipeline goals
* Build and execute integrated campaigns (email, digital, webinars, ABM) targeting priority accounts and segments globally, across both customer and new logo audiences
* Execute and participate in industry conferences and trade events to drive brand visibility, lead generation, and account engagement globally
* Support execution of customer events and programs, driving registrations, engagement, and pipeline follow-up
* Partner with Sales and Business Development to align campaigns with territory plans, account priorities, and pipeline targets
* Work with global channel partners to extend campaign reach and drive co-marketing pipeline contribution
* Coordinate with the Product Marketing team on shared messaging, positioning, and campaign assets, ensuring consistent global execution
* Drive demand generation and pipeline acceleration programs tailored to industry and regional market dynamics and buyer behavior
* Develop segmentation and targeting recommendations by industry, geography, and buying stage
* Deliver against pipeline and revenue targets (Sales Accepted Opportunities, pipeline contribution) globally
* Track pipeline performance from campaign inception through to revenue, flagging funnel risks to the Director and Sales
* Partner with Sales to improve conversion and progression where opportunities are stalling
* Maintain pipeline hygiene and SLA accountability, ensuring timely follow-up, clear stage progression, and accurate data capture across all marketing-generated opportunities
* Report on weekly campaign performance, recommending spend and optimization adjustments
* Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps on data, reporting, and campaign execution; maintain dashboards to track pipeline, conversion, and ROI
* Work with Localization teams to adapt messaging and GTM programs across global languages and markets

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing required**, with a proven track record of driving demand generation, pipeline growth, and measurable revenue impact. ERP industry experience is a plus.
* **GTM & ABM Strategy:** Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies and account-based marketing programs aligned with business priorities, target accounts, and revenue goals.
* **Self-starter and proactive approach** is required to enable working both independently but also collaboratively.
* **Integrated Campaigns:** Proven ability to plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across email, paid media, digital advertising, events, webinars, and sales-driven programs.
* **International Experience Required:** Demonstrated experience executing marketing programs across international markets, adapting campaigns and messaging to regional business needs.
* **Sales & Marketing Alignment:** Strong ability to collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, and regional teams to accelerate pipeline and drive revenue growth.
* **Data-Driven Marketing:** Strong understanding of marketing KPIs, funnel conversion, campaign attribution, pipeline contribution, and ROI to optimize performance.
* **Marketing Technology & AI:** Proficiency in Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, digital marketing tools, and emerging AI-powered technologies. Experience with Google Workspace required.
* **Project Management & Execution:** Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* **Collaboration & Ownership:** Results-oriented, creative, proactive, and adaptable, with excellent communication skills, strong accountability, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams.

 **Additional Information**

**Compensation Package:**

* Base pay range: 65,000 EUR - 70,000 EUR (12 Months) base salary
* Placement within our pay range will vary based on knowledge, skills, experience, and market location variations as well as internal peer equity.
* This role is eligible for the Marketing Bonus Plan.

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

description:

title: Quality Director
location: Sant Boi de Llobregat, CT, Spain
description:
#### **About Stark**

Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road-legal VARG EX & SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.

We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year-on-year), and building a team that will take us even further. If you want to work on a product that people are genuinely obsessed with, this is it.

Stark will become the global market leader in premium motorcycles. Building premium motorcycles requires innovation and we need your help to make us succeed

Our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry, by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.

This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

#### **The Role**

We need your help to make sure we become the leader in quality and cost. The challenge is defining the best suppliers, convincing them, negotiating the best possible terms, and controlling them to follow our guidelines. Our guidelines will include component specification, quality assurance, delivery time, pricing, and sustainability policy.

* Define Final vehicle process quality assurance and implement auditplanning.
* Manage resolutions of concerns and promote continuous improvement.

* A fast-growing company with real momentum

We encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are excited to see how your unique perspective can help us grow

title: Head of People
description:
Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,600 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

We are looking for a **Head of People** who will own the **operational infrastructure** that lets Qualifyze **hire, pay, develop, and retain people effectively**: Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Performance Management, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Administration, and Compliance. Reporting directly to the SVP of Finance, you are the backbone of the People function.

**You'll have end-to-end ownership.** Every area below is yours, from design through execution to results. You don't hand work off and step back. When something breaks, you fix it, then fix the process behind it

You'll **shape the team**, hire into new roles, and set the standards the People function runs on.

#### **Main responsibilities:**

* **Leading and developing a high-impact team:**
  + You'll lead a lean, pragmatic team across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Business Partnering, setting clear priorities and performance expectations while carrying your own operational workload.
  + You'll coach each team member through regular 1:1s, reviews, and growth plans, building a team that becomes a trusted advisor to managers and business leaders as the business scales, hiring into open roles, and putting shared processes in place so delivery stays consistent across every location.
* **Driving end-to-end hiring & Employer Branding initiatives:**
  + You’ll deliver the hiring plan across all entities, owning the full recruitment process from sourcing and interviews to hiring manager enablement and offer management, while strengthening our employer brand to attract the talent we need.
  + You bring a data-driven mindset, tracking and acting on metrics such as time-to-hire, pipeline health, and source effectiveness to set priorities.
* **Building scalable People Operations & HR Systems:**
  + Own and continuously improve Personio and end-to-end People Operations across our entities ensuring accurate, compliant, and scalable processes throughout the employee journey.
  + Oversee accurate and timely payroll across all entities and jurisdictions, in collaboration with Accounting and external partners, while managing benefits administration and vendor relationships.
  + Drive operational excellence through automation, self-service, and AI-enabled solutions that improve the employee and manager experience, focusing on outcomes rather than activity.
  + Ensure compliance with local labour laws, maintain employment policies, contracts, and the employee handbook, and handle employee relations cases in partnership with legal counsel.
* **Driving our rewards policy & high-impact performance:**
  + Own compensation reviews, promotions, compensation ranges, and progression frameworks, ensuring fair and consistent outcomes.
  + Maintain compliance with EU Pay Transparency requirements and related audits and reporting.
  + Lead the performance review cycle across all entities, including manager enablement, calibration, and consistent, well-documented outcomes.
  + Design and continuously improve performance frameworks, ensuring successful rollout and adoption.
* **Workforce Planning & Organisational Effectiveness:**
  + Partner directly with Finance to build and maintain workforce planning models, budget-to-actuals tracking, and headcount reporting.
  + Provide the data and process rigour needed to support organisational design and restructuring decisions.
* **Creating and Engaging Workplace & Culture:**
  + Ensure the smooth running of our offices in Frankfurt, New Jersey, Hyderabad, and Barcelona, creating environments that support productivity, community, and employee well-being.
  + Lead culture and key company initiatives, including global and local office events.

#### **Main requirements:**

* 7+ years in people, HR, or shared services roles, with direct, hands-on ownership of talent acquisition, performance management, payroll, HRIS, and compliance.
* Experience in high-change environments. Multi-country and multi-entity experience is a strong plus.
* Comfortable managing complexity across multiple jurisdictions. Practical experience with Spanish and/or German labor law is a strong plus.
* A track record of personally owning the operational execution of people processes at scale, and of managing teams across multiple locations.
* Tech-savvy with a mindset for adopting AI, automation, and process optimization.
* Fluent English is required. Spanish and/or German are a plus.
* An organized, structured thinker with a pragmatic approach to finding solutions in a fast-paced environment.

#### **Salary:**

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around **80,000 - 85,000 €**, centred around the median.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

#### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
* Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
* ️ Country specific benefits offering incl.private health care, fitness and meal allowances
* Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
* Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
* All the best kit and tools to work effectively
* Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
* Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

#### **Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:**

We believe in a humanled hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription. All hiring decisions are made by people!

#### **Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze:**

At Qualifyze, we value diversity and inclusion, recognizing the strength that complementary talents and perspectives bring to our team. Join us and help drive innovation, tackle challenges, and create meaningful change. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

title: Head of Paid Acquisition
description:
**About Click&Boat**
--------------------

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy.

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals, with over €170M in annual GMV and a community of 2.4M+ registered users across 150+ countries worldwide. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the globe, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To fuel our next phase of growth, we're hiring a Head of Paid Acquisition to own and scale our paid marketing strategy, based in our Barcelona office.

**The role**
------------

We're looking for a Head of Paid Acquisition to join our crew in Barcelona and own the strategy behind how we acquire renters and boat owners at scale, across all our markets.

Paid acquisition is a core growth lever for Click&Boat, sitting at the intersection of performance marketing, data, and brand. You'll lead a team of 3, own the paid media P&L, and work in close, day-to-day collaboration with Global Group Head of Performance (based in Miami) to align on global strategy, share learnings across the Group's marketplaces, and make the most of our combined scale.

Given the strategic weight of paid acquisition in our growth model, you'll report and present regularly to our Executive Board as well as to Boats Group stakeholders, on performance, strategy, and investment decisions.

**What floats your boat**
-------------------------

* Define and own the paid acquisition strategy (SEA, paid social, display/programmatic, app campaigns) across all markets, to hit revenue, contribution margin, and growth targets.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 3 Paid Acquisition Managers, setting clear objectives and building a culture of accountability, testing, and continuous improvement.
* Own the paid media budget and P&L: allocate spend by market and channel, and manage CAC/ROAS targets with rigor.
* Partner closely with Global Group Head of Performance to align on global media strategy, share best practices across the Group's marketplaces, and coordinate shared vendor relationships (Google, Meta, TikTok, etc.) where relevant.
* Report to the Executive Board and Boats Group stakeholders on performance and strategy, translating data into clear investment recommendations.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Tech, and Data teams on tracking, attribution, and landing page optimisation.
* Identify and test new channels and formats, and assess where AI can improve targeting, bidding, or creative performance.

**What you bring aboard**
-------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in paid acquisition / performance marketing, ideally in a B2C, marketplace, e-commerce, or travel environment.
* 3+ years of experience managing a team, driving performance through coaching, prioritisation, and clear goal-setting.
* Deep hands-on expertise across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and programmatic/display, ideally in multi-market, multi-language contexts.
* Data-obsessed and analytically rigorous: comfortable building and reading dashboards (Tableau or equivalent) and modeling CAC/LTV/ROAS.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, international organisation, collaborating with Group stakeholders across time zones.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and confidently to a Board / C-level audience.
* Full proficiency in English is required.

###### **Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Fluent in Spanish or French.
* Experience in the travel or marketplace industry.
* Experience working within a global group structure, balancing local execution with global alignment.

**The hiring journey**
----------------------

* HR call with our Head of Talent Acquisition
* Manager interview with our Head of Paid Acquisition (Group)

title: Head of Business Operations
description:
**Take over founder-led operations and build the systems that help us grow.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

You might be a consultant who moved into a startup, a founder’s associate already running important parts of a business, or an operator who has started building software and automations yourself.

You enjoy understanding how a business works, finding what slows it down, and making it work better. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, bring people with you, and build the first solution.

We are looking for someone ready to take that ability further: own our operations function, lead a small team, and join the company’s leadership team.

**About us**
------------

Platform Engineering Masters is the company behind platformengineering.org and PlatformCon. We bring together engineers, technology leaders and vendors through our community, conferences, education and Weave Intelligence.

As the business grows, the systems behind it need to grow too: how we deliver for customers, run events, produce content, understand performance and share information across teams.

Our co-founder, Christoph currently leads operations. You will work closely with him during the handover, then take responsibility for running and developing the function independently. You will report to Luca, our Managing Director.

**The challenge**
-----------------

We have a working business, an existing operations team and plenty already being built. We also have manual handovers, disconnected information and processes that depend too much on particular people.

Your job is to decide what needs attention, understand the business problem behind each request, and lead the work through to a solution people actually use.

Some of the questions you will tackle:

* How do we turn a customer commitment into a reliable delivery process across sales, content and events?
* How do we give teams trustworthy information about what is working and where to focus?
* How do we make recurring work, such as publishing a webinar or delivering a sponsored asset, easy to run consistently?
* Which problems need custom software, which need better use of existing tools, and which simply need a clearer process?
* How do we keep improving our systems without making the business dependent on their original builders?

**What you will own**
---------------------

**The operations roadmap.** Work directly with Sales, Growth, Content and Events to understand their needs. Prioritize by business impact, challenge requests where necessary, and make trade-offs explicit, including when requests come from founders.

**A small, growing team.** You will manage our existing revenue operations and systems engineering specialists from the start, and help recruit and develop additional content/design and growth operations capacity.

**Hands-on delivery.** Prototype, write code, connect systems and build automations yourself when that is the fastest way to make progress. Give your team clear direction and space to own delivery.

**Systems that last.** Make sure critical workflows have clear ownership, useful documentation and sensible standards for reliability, access and maintenance.

**Adoption and results.** Work with business teams until the solution is part of their everyday work. Judge success by better delivery, useful information and time saved.

Your remit is the operational systems supporting the business. Functional leaders own their commercial, editorial and event outcomes; you work with them to make those outcomes easier to achieve.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Structured problem-solving and strong communication.** You can understand an internal customer’s needs, question assumptions and explain a recommendation clearly. Consulting or similar client-facing experience would be useful.
* **Evidence that you build.** You have used code, APIs, automation or AI tools to solve real problems. You can walk us through what you built, why you chose that approach and what happened when people used it.
* **Commercial judgment.** You connect operational improvements to revenue, delivery quality, cost or capacity.
* **Ownership in an ambiguous environment.** You can make progress without a complete brief and follow through when implementation gets difficult.
* **Readiness to lead.** You can set priorities, give useful feedback and hold a small team accountable while staying close to the work.
* **Curiosity about technology and the business.** You learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly and care about the quality of the result.

Experience managing processes in a startup would be valuable. You do not need to have held a Head of Operations title or worked in every area this role touches. We care more about your judgment, learning speed and track record than a particular CRM certification or tool stack.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

In your first months, you will establish clear priorities with the team, take ownership of the most important systems and deliver improvements that business teams can see and use.

Over time, routine work will run with fewer manual interventions, teams will have better information, and the founders will be able to step out of day-to-day operations with confidence.

**Why join**
------------

You will inherit a real team, work directly with leadership and have the mandate to shape an important part of a growing business. This is an opportunity to move from solving individual problems to owning the function that solves them.

**Interested?**
---------------

Send us your CV or profile and a short example of something you improved or built. Tell us what the problem was, what you personally did and what changed. If you have any questions, please contact james@platformengineering.org

We operate in 14 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Spain, and more. We are proud to work with flagship accounts such as Uber, DoorDash, Chipotle, Deliveroo, and many others.

Our tech team of 50 is AI-first and ships fast. We are currently building an AI agent platform that will power our product for the next five to ten years, led by a Chief AI Officer who previously worked at NASA and SpaceX. We operate in a category with very few real competitors, against incumbents who are growing at 5% a year.

**The role**

Reporting to the COO, you will lead Oppizi's SDR team in Barcelona and personally contribute to pipeline. This is explicitly a player-coach role. You will spend part of your week prospecting your own accounts and the rest managing, coaching, and building the systems that make the team better.

We do not have a finished outbound playbook. We have strong logos, a differentiated product, and a team that needs a leader who knows how to build sequences that land, coach reps who are ramping, and turn activity into qualified pipeline. That build is the job.

**Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership and Coaching**

* Manage, coach, and develop the Barcelona SDR team, owning ramp, performance, and progression
* Run weekly one-to-ones, call reviews, and pipeline reviews with a consistent methodology
* Set clear activity and outcome KPIs, and hold the team to them
* Build a performance culture grounded in accountability, feedback, and continuous improvement
* Own hiring and onboarding for the SDR team as it grows

**Personal Pipeline (The Player Half)**

* Carry your own quota for qualified meetings and pipeline generated
* Personally prospect into strategic and enterprise accounts, leading by example
* Stay hands-on in the tools every week; you should be writing sequences, not just approving them
* Run discovery calls and hand over cleanly to Account Executives and General Managers

**Outbound engine and process**

* Own the full outbound motion: list building, segmentation, sequencing, multichannel cadence, and follow-up
* Own email deliverability end to end, including domain warming, inbox rotation, and sender reputation
* Continuously test and improve messaging, subject lines, open rates, reply rates, and meeting conversion
* Build the objection handling library and the qualification framework the team runs on
* Partner with Marketing on ICP definition, ABM target lists, and campaign follow-up

**Reporting and Revenue Operations**

* Own CRM hygiene and data quality for the top of the funnel
* Report weekly on activity, pipeline generated, conversion rates, and forecast to the COO
* Run the business off data, not anecdote
* Leverage AI-powered sales tools and Oppizi's internal agent stack to raise team productivity

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* **Know outbound as a craft.** You have personally written the sequences, fixed the deliverability, and cracked the list that finally worked.
* **Coach rather than supervise**. You have taken a ramping SDR and made them good, and you can point to who and how.
* **Lead from the front.** You are comfortable carrying your own number while developing the team around you.
* **Build where there is no playbook.** You bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for it to arrive.
* **Move with urgency.** You operate fast, adapt quickly, and prefer shipping to planning.
* **Communicate with precision**. Whether it is a cold email, a call review, or a weekly report, you are clear and credible.
* **Are genuinely ambitious.** You want the next role after this one, and you want to earn it by building something.

**Why should I Apply?**

* **Build the engine, don't inherit it**. There is no outbound playbook here yet. You will write it, and it will carry your fingerprints.
* **Sell a genuinely differentiated product**. Oppizi operates in a category with very few real competitors and serves enterprise clients you already know.
* **Real progression**. This role sits directly under the COO with visibility across the leadership team. Strong performance opens the path to Head of Sales Development or a broader commercial mandate.
* **Work with exceptional people.** We are builders, not politicians. The Oppizi culture values directness, curiosity, and getting things done.
* **Join at the right time**. We are scaling across 14 markets with a growing enterprise client base and significant product investment.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5 to 8 years in B2B sales development or inside sales, with at least 2 years directly managing an SDR or BDR team
* Demonstrable track record of building and scaling an outbound engine in B2B SaaS, MarTech, or AdTech
* Deep hands-on expertise in outbound: sequence design, deliverability, domain and inbox management, multichannel cadence
* Proven coaching ability, with concrete examples of reps you ramped and developed
* Experience prospecting into enterprise or mid-market accounts, not just SMB volume
* Strong command of CRM and outbound tooling; experience with HubSpot, Clay, and Lemlist is a strong plus
* Comfortable being measured on both team output and a personal number
* Fluent English is mandatory. Fluency in either French or German is also required, while Spanish is a strong plus.

title: Head of Product Analytics - 100% Remote - EMEA
description:
**NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within LOCATION to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but** **please only apply if you are physically based within LOCATION.**

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn . Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

### **About the role**

Hostaway is looking for its first Product Analytics leader, someone to own how we choose what to build, and to prove what it delivered. This role is about setting the standards and building the tools that help teams move faster with confidence. You'll define what good looks like, set the standards for how we measure, and bring the whole product organization along with you.

You'll work alongside our product leaders, who decide which bets we make, helping make sure the evidence behind them is solid. In a company leaning hard into AI, you'll also work out what measurement even means when the AI, not the human, is doing the work. It's a rare chance to be first: to shape the processes, metrics and KPIs, in a fast-growing, profitable, AI-first company with low bureaucracy and little hierarchy. Your work will make the impact of everyone around you visible.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, this is a hands-on role where you will write SQL, build analyses, and mentor others rather than purely manage. While Data Engineering oversees the data pipelines, warehouse, and central architecture, you will own the product measurement layer on top, maintaining a dotted-line partnership with the CTO.

**Your Mission**

* Set the product measurement standard: what counts as an active, adopting customer, and how every analysis gets segmented.
* Bring measurement into planning early, so every product requirements document includes sizing, an expected metric impact and a measurement plan.
* Design measurement where clean A/B tests aren't available, and redefine it for an AI-native product where activity metrics no longer tell the full story.
* Bring numbers to investment decisions, and grow metrics fluency so product managers can bring their own numbers to reviews.
* Set the technical standards and build the function: tracking plans, instrumentation specs, data quality, starting with an experienced product analyst.
* Stay close to the work. You'll remain hands-on day to day, writing queries and building analyses yourself rather than only directing others.

* **8+ years in product analytics, ideally in B2B SaaS at a scaling stage.** We're open to strong candidates from other product backgrounds too.
* **Strong data foundations.** You know how to design clean, reliable data models together with Data Engineering, and how to set up event tracking that stays consistent across features and domains. Experience with SQLMesh is a plus. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and understand where they help and where they mislead.
* **Influence beyond your title.** You've disagreed with a senior leader about a number, backed it up with evidence, and your definition was still in use six months later. You've helped a company move from gut feel to data-led decisions, and you work patiently with product managers to find what fits a company of our size.
* **You build the function, not just run it.** You've set up analytics operating models rather than inherited them. You can build business models that hold up to a finance leader's scrutiny, and you can show what actually worked: designing fair comparisons in a complex B2B product and being honest about what a number does and does not prove.

**Nice to have**

* Measuring AI features, automated workflows or API usage; product-led growth; churn modeling; platform businesses with more than one user type (ours are property managers and their guests); travel, hospitality or property technology.

**This role probably isn't for you if...**

* You see analytics as a service desk, waiting for tickets to come in.
* You're a dashboard specialist. Dashboards are an output; the real work is changing how decisions get made.
* You've only worked in large, mature data organizations, where the frameworks and teams were already established.
* You need a formal title to have influence.

### **What we offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.
* **100% Remote:** Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).
* **Equity:** Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.
* **Values-Driven Leadership:** Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.
* **Professional Growth:** Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.
* **Annual Paid Leave:** The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.
* **Geographic Specific Benefits:** As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.
* **Dynamic Team Culture:** As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

title: PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative: Postdoctoral Researcher in TGV Metallization and Seed-Layer Processes
description:
As part of the **PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative**, ICFO coordinates PIXEurope, a flagship **Pilot Line funded under the European Chips JU program**, focused on Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) through which ICFO is advancing frontier technologies, including optical interposers for Co-packaged optics for next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices.

To strengthen this initiative, ICFO is seeking a highly motivated Engineer/Scientist with strong expertise in thin-film deposition and metallization of high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias (TGVs).

**Position Overview:**,

We offer a post-doctoral position to a scientist with hands-on experience in thin-film deposition, surface preparation, and metallization for semiconductor, MEMS, or advanced-packaging applications. The successful candidate will develop, optimize, and scale reliable adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed layers inside high-aspect-ratio glass vias, ensuring continuity and compatibility with subsequent copper plating and interconnection processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**,

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Develop and optimize seed-layer deposition processes for high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias
* Develop substrate cleaning, glass-surface activation, and adhesion-promotion processes
* Develop adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed stacks such as Ti/Cu, Cr/Cu, TiW/Cu, and related systems
* Optimize sputtering, evaporation, electroless, ALD or CVD-assisted, and hybrid deposition approaches
* Achieve continuous and conformal seed coverage along via entrances, sidewalls, and exits
* Characterize thickness, morphology, resistivity, adhesion, continuity, and wafer-level uniformity
* Identify and mitigate shadowing, seed discontinuity, oxidation, delamination, and cracking
Coordinate with the laser and glass team to align via geometry and surface condition with seeding, plating, and interconnection requirements  

  
This position will report to the **Prof. Dr. Valerio Pruneri, Director of the European Chips JU Pilot Line PIXEurope.**

PIXEurope is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of the Participating States, Spain, Ireland, The Netherlands, Finland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, France, Italy, United Kingdom. In particular, it is co-funded by Spain through the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service under reference CJU-010000-2025-0005, as part of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan (PRTR).

Applicants must hold a PhD in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics, microengineering, or related fields, or equivalent research experience.

Candidates should demonstrate expertise in the following areas (not all mandatory, but strongly preferred):

* Thin-film deposition by sputtering, evaporation, ALD, CVD, or electroless methods
* Metallization processes for semiconductor, MEMS, microfabrication, or advanced-packaging applications
* Surface preparation, activation, and surface chemistry of glass or dielectric materials
* Metal-to-dielectric adhesion and adhesion/barrier/seed-layer material systems
* Metallization or coating of high-aspect-ratio three-dimensional structures
* Redistribution layer patterning and fabrication
* Electrical and structural characterization of thin films and interconnects
* Cleanroom processes, safety procedures, and fabrication protocols
Process optimization, reproducibility, failure analysis, and wafer-level uniformity  

Desired (but not required):

* Direct experience with Through-Glass Via or Through-Silicon Via metallization
* Experience with FIB/SEM cross-sections, X-ray inspection, four-point-probe measurements, or via-resistance testing
* Experience with reliability testing, thermomechanical stress, process scale-up, or wafer-level packaging
* Experience with glass surface processing will be evaluated as a strong asset
Experience with electroless deposition, ALD-assisted seeding, or electroplating  

**What We Offer**

* Full time contract up to 3 years (ASE (Accés al Sistema Espanyol de Ciència i Innovació) contract pursuant to Spanish Law 14/2011)
* Access to state-of-the-art microfabrication and characterization facilities
* A dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment
* Opportunities to work on high-impact projects bridging fundamental research and real-world applications
A family allowance may be granted to candidates with dependents, according to ICFO policies.

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

To apply, please submit your:

contact information for 2 professional references.

Bimeda is a leading global innovator, manufacturer and marketer of veterinary pharmaceuticals and animal health products and has over half a century’s experience in providing science-driven solutions to optimize the health, wellbeing and productivity of the world’s animals.
