title: Head of Global Events and Travel (100% REMOTE)
description:
The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

* **Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events** (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);
* **Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel** (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and
* **Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management**.

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

**Responsibilities**

* **Function Leadership:** Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.
* **Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events:** Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.
* **Internal Meetings & Offsites:** Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.
* **Travel Operating Model Transition:** Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.
* **Corporate Travel Oversight:** Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.
* **Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship:** Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.
* **Financial Governance & Client Billing:** Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.
* **Strategic Suppliers & Commercial Partnerships:** Lead major RFPs and negotiations with TMCs, airlines, hotel chains, event venues, registration platforms, and production partners. Maintain competitive discipline, set service expectations, and delegate routine vendor management while remaining the key point of contact for material escalations.
* **Policy, Duty of Care & Risk Management:** Own the global events and travel policy. Establish traveler assistance, emergency response, data privacy, and incident escalation frameworks in coordination with People Ops, Legal, IT, and Security, ensuring comprehensive coverage for collaborators, clients, and external VIP guests.
* **Cross-Functional & Client Partnership:** Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on client event revenue targets, sponsorships, client experience, and commercial outcomes. Collaborate with C-Level executives on internal event agendas, keynotes, and executive participation. Partner with Finance, Legal, and People Ops to streamline global delivery.
* **Events & Travel Leadership:** 8+ years leading corporate events and managed travel programs, including 3+ years leading a global function in a fast-growing, international environment.
* **Client & Internal Event Expertise:** Proven track record running both internal company meetings/offsites and high-impact, client- or customer-facing events (e.g., user conferences, client advisory boards, sponsored summits, roadshows).
* **Large-Scale Event Execution:** Proven experience directing large conferences (5,000+ attendees) end-to-end, covering budgets, venue sourcing, registration tech, production, speaker/VIP management, and vendor teams.
* **Travel Program Transformation:** Hands-on experience implementing or re-platforming corporate travel frameworks (TMC selections, booking/expense integrations, phased migrations, and duty-of-care rollouts). Multi-TMC or hybrid experience preferred.
* **Travel Industry & Commercial Fluency:** Strong understanding of airline/hotel distribution economics (GDS, NDC, dynamic pricing, corporate direct programs) and commercial contracting for high-value event venues and suppliers.
* **Financial & Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated budget ownership, financial forecasting, ROI tracking, vendor negotiations, and client event billing/cost recovery. Experience with virtual-card systems or modern payment settlements is a plus.
* **Executive & External Presence:** Exceptional communication and presentation skills; comfortable engaging directly with C-Suite executives, enterprise clients, sponsors, and key industry partners.
* **Data Privacy & Duty of Care:** Solid understanding of global travel safety protocols, crisis management, GDPR compliance, vendor DPAs, and attendee data privacy standards.
* **Language & Mobility:** Professional fluency in English (Spanish and/or Italian are strong pluses). Willingness to travel internationally up to 40% and operate across European, Middle Eastern, and Americas time zones.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io

In collaboration with Medical and Market Access teams to develop proposals and business cases for further data generation and RWE.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across matrix teams and achieve goals by delivering through others.

* Experienced with key global regulations in the field of pharmaceutical compliance and commercialization, including pharmacovigilance

title: Key Account Manager - Wholesalers
description:
**Key Account Manager - Wholesalers**

Description: Responsible for the strategic development and profitable growth of the wholesaler channel in Spain.

  

**Purpose:**

The Key Account Manager – Wholesalers will play a pivotal role in accelerating Bayer Consumer Health growth through the indirect route to market in Spain. The role will respond to the need to strengthen distribution and reach in non-visited pharmacies through the wholesaler channel.

The KAM will translate market, customer and distribution insights into clear account plans, manage customer relationships and deliver profitable growth with assigned wholesalers, directly influencing more than 25% of the Consumer Health business in Spain.

The role reports to the Head of Sales Spain and works cross-functionally with key internal stakeholders across Sales, Brand Marketing, Trade Marketing, Finance, Logistics and Order to Cash.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Own the commercial relationship with assigned wholesaler customers for Bayer Consumer Health brands, acting as the primary point of contact.

2. Develop and execute strategic account plans based on customer potential, market insights, channel dynamics, distribution opportunities and commercial priorities.

3. Lead annual negotiations and joint business planning, securing sustainable agreements that balance customer value, sales growth, profitability, market share and brand objectives.

4. Build trusted relationships with customer decision-makers and develop a strong internal stakeholder network to align priorities, remove barriers and accelerate execution.

5. Ensure end-to-end execution of commercial agreements through clear follow-up with customers and internal teams, translating account plans into concrete actions and measurable outcomes.

6. Co-create and execute annual promotional and activation calendars with Trade Marketing and Marketing, including assortment strategy, innovation launches, offline and online visibility, and promotional effectiveness.

7. Monitor account performance through clear KPIs, customer P&Ls and regular business reviews; identify risks and opportunities and take corrective action to deliver commitments.

8. Maintain a strong customer-contact rhythm throughout the year, including regular customer reviews and field contact where relevant, and champion a superior customer experience across physical and digital touchpoints.

  

**Main Objectives of the Role:**

Accelerate profitable growth through the wholesaler channel in Spain, strengthening distribution and execution for Bayer Consumer Health brands in non-visited pharmacies.

Secure consistent visibility and execution for Bayer Consumer Health brands across assigned wholesaler customers and the pharmacies served through this channel.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic mindset: translates market, channel and customer insights into focused account strategies and clear priorities.

* Strong drive for results: takes ownership, maintains pace and converts plans into measurable commercial outcomes.

* Customer focus and relationship building: establishes credibility and trusted partnerships with customer stakeholders.

* Influencing and collaboration: aligns cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

* Negotiation and commercial acumen: prepares scenarios, understands value drivers, protects profitability and reaches sustainable win-win agreements.

* Planning, analytical thinking and complexity management: prioritizes effectively, uses data to make decisions and manages multiple workstreams with discipline and clarity.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Courage and ownership

* Learning agility and innovation

**Education and Experience:**

* University degree required; business, economics, marketing or a related field preferred.
* 3-5 years of experience as a Key Account Manager within the pharmaceutical industry, with deep knowledge of the pharmaceutical wholesaler channel and a proven track record of managing strategic customer relationships and leading complex commercial negotiations.

* Proven ability to build customer relationships, negotiate complex agreements and deliver ambitious sales and profitability targets.

* Strong analytical and financial skills, including scenario planning, forecasting, profitability analysis and customer P&L management.

* Demonstrated success in managing multiple priorities and influencing cross-functional teams.

* High degree of autonomy, sound judgment and disciplined prioritization.

* Strong attention to detail while maintaining a clear strategic perspective.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt messages to different audiences.

* High energy, resilience and perseverance in a fast-paced environment.

* Fluency in Spanish and English is required.

description:
**Location** Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain **Job ID** R-261834 **Date posted** 13/10/2026

  

The Associate Director (AD) of Scientific Communications Excellence is responsible for driving operational excellence and innovation across activities managed by the Global Scientific Communications team. This role sits at the intersection of scientific communications, digital innovation, and intelligent process design and includes a strong focus on governance, continuous improvement, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.

The Excellence AD will establish strong partnerships with Sci Comms team members and internal cross-functional stakeholders to implement best publication practices, automate and harmonize processes, and ensure optimal departmental efficiency, compliance, and resource utilization. A core expectation of this role is the ability to proactively identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and emerging opportunities, and to drive scalable, sustainable, and measurable solutions that support the evolving needs of the business.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Scientific communications sit at the heart of how AstraZeneca shares critical medical evidence with the world — influencing clinical decisions, shaping medical understanding, and ultimately improving patient outcomes. The Associate Director of Scientific Communications Excellence is a critical role that sits at the intersection of technology, compliance, innovation, and operations. **Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience: 5–7 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical company or Medical Communications agency, with demonstrated experience in operations or excellence.

* Proven project management and facilitation skills. Ability to manage plan and execute timelines across complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent is a plus.

* Analytical & Reporting Skills: Proficiency with Excel/Smartsheet, Microsoft Power BI, and other reporting tools. Exceptional attention to detail.

description:

Are you looking for an exciting and fulfilling new position? Join our dynamic team at WEP Clinical, where your contributions will play a key role in driving impactful solutions and improving outcomes for clients and patients. We encourage innovation and collaboration, challenging our team to bring ideas that make a real difference. Be part of a mission-driven organisation dedicated to advancing clinical research and transforming lives.

  

**Role Objectives:**

The **Medical Director** at WEP Clinical serves as the primary medical and scientific expert for clinical trial protocols and Expanded Access Programs (EAPs), playing a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and successful execution of studies. As the protocol expert, the Medical Director is responsible for guiding investigators and internal/external teams in implementing and adhering to the study protocol. This includes but is not limited to medical and safety monitoring, data interpretation/presentation, and providing expert input on all medical aspects of the trial. As a Medical Director, you’ll collaborate with clinical, regulatory, and operational teams to ensure trials meet the highest ethical and scientific rigour standards.

### **The Ideal Candidate:**

* Detail-oriented
* Proactive
* Collaborative
* Strong Leader

### **What You'll Do:**

* Serve as the primary medical point of contact for investigators, regulatory agencies, and internal/external teams, ensuring consistent protocol interpretation and addressing all medical inquiries.
* Monitor clinical trials and Expanded Access Programs to ensure participant safety, data accuracy, protocol compliance, and timely resolution of medical issues.
* Participate in investigator discussions during site selection to assess suitability and experience for the study or program.
* Lead investigator calls to review inclusion/exclusion criteria and support optimal site selection and patient recruitment.
* Act as the primary medical expert for the protocol, ensuring full understanding and adherence across investigators, study teams, and stakeholders.
* Review and ensure proper documentation and timely reporting of AEs, SAEs, and other safety events.
* Provide causality assessments for AEs, including those requiring expedited reporting to regulatory authorities.
* Work with DSMBs and safety committees to provide safety oversight and evaluate ongoing trial data.
* Deliver ongoing training and support to investigators, site staff, and internal/external teams on protocol requirements and the study’s medical/scientific objectives.
* Participate in investigator meetings, site initiation visits, and study training to present protocol details, clarify eligibility criteria, and address medical concerns.
* Lead the development of protocols, treatment guidelines, and project documents by providing key medical input on design, endpoints, criteria, and methodology.
* Oversee protocol adherence, manage deviations, collaborate with cross-functional teams (clinical operations, regulatory, project management, pharmacovigilance), support safety reporting, and represent Medical Affairs in bid proposals, bid defences, client presentations, and cross-functional scientific discussions.

### **What You'll Need:**

* A Medical Doctor (MD) degree is required
* At least 5+ years of relevant clinical research experience, preferably medical monitoring
* Ability to travel internationally and domestically up to 15%
* Experience in EAP / CUP / NPP is preferred
* Proven experience in protocol development, implementation, and interpretation
* Experience in safety monitoring, adverse event reporting, and medical data review in the context of clinical trials
* In-depth knowledge of clinical trial design, regulatory requirements, and drug development processes
* Computer literacy and proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and external stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to make data-driven decisions and navigate complex challenges in the healthcare sector
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills are required to work independently and in a team environment

**What We Offer:**

Group Private Medical Insurance

Group General Life Assurance

Group Critical Illness and Group Income Protection

Salary sacrifice pension scheme

Enhanced maternity & paternity pay

Educational Assistance allowance

Paid volunteering day

WEP Clinical partners with biopharmaceutical Sponsors to help them bring treatments closer to the patients who need them most. Through end-to-end clinical trial delivery, home health services, expanded access programs, and market access consultancy, we provide flexible, fit-for-purpose solutions that support drug development, improve access, and help therapies reach the right patients at the right time. With more than 15 years of global experience, we have supported programs across 150+ countries, combining operational scale with the agility and personalised service of a specialised provider. Our work helps bridge critical gaps in care, ensuring safe, ethical, and efficient access to promising new treatments.

**We're Committed to Our Team:**

WEP has many initiatives to encourage wellness, growth, development, and team relationships. Check out our LinkedIn life page to learn more about our team events and all that we do to support our employees.

At WEP Clinical, we look for individuals who are conscientious, exercise sound judgement, and engage with others thoughtfully and professionally. We believe excellence is achieved through integrity, accountability, and respect for diverse perspectives – and we are committed to helping our people grow and succeed in an inclusive, supportive environment.

Access Programs

Market Access and Commercialisation

**Job ID** R-261456 **Date posted** 10/09/2026

title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
description:
**About You**
-------------

We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we're open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue.  
  
XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting.  
  
You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.  
  
This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

### **About Us**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Research and discovery.** Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.
* **Coordinate the roadmap.** Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.
* **Write product requirements.** Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
* **Manage delivery.** Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
* **Track what matters.** Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.
* **Keep everyone connected.** Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

### **Requirements:**

* **Product experience.** 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.
* **Customer insight.** You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You're comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved.
* **Clear writing.** You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly.
* **Engineering partnership.** You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.
* **Cross-team communication.** You enjoy keeping people across the company informed and being a go-to resource for product questions.
* **Adaptability.** You're energized by a fast-moving, globally distributed team and comfortable making progress while the picture is still coming together.
* **Video game marketing.** You understand how games find and grow their audiences, including user acquisition, community building, and influencer campaigns. We prefer candidates with experience in the creator economy or influencer marketing.
* **Creator platform familiarity.** You know how creators work on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, or Kick, including their analytics, audience growth, and monetization tools.

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* **Marketplace or platform experience.** You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.
* **Partner commercial models.** Experience with revenue-share or performance-based partner programs.
* **Campaign attribution.** Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.
* **Data comfort.** You can pull and explore your own data with analytics tools.

Salary range based on US location only. This position is open for global remote. Salary will be determined based on location and experience.

**Benefits:**  
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**  
Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act.

**Rights Under the Fair Chance Act:**  
Applicants are encouraged to inquire about their rights under the Fair Chance Act. If you have questions regarding our hiring practices, please contact careers@xsolla.com.

*By submitting the following job application form, you consent to Xsolla processing your data for career-related inquiries and potential employment opportunities. We process your data in accordance with this**Xsolla Privacy Notice for Job Applicants**. Please direct any inquiries regarding your data privacy to* *careers@xsolla.com**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov  
Remote · Full-time contractor

**The Quick Version**

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

**The details**

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

* Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
* Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
* Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
* Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
* The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
* Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

* Exceptional Enthusiasm
* Extremely Creative Energy
* You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
* You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
* AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
* Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
* Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
* B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

* Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
* There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

  
**Requirements**  
  
**IMPORTANT**

* Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
* Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

title: GEO Specialist
description:
GEO Specialist

The GEO Specialist supports the strategy and execution of Generative Engine Optimization programs for a portfolio of B2B clients. This role works predominantly across on-site content planning and Reddit distribution (the two primary channels through which Foundation builds AI visibility) contributing to strategic engagements, content planning, and performance reporting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

GEO Research & Execution

* Research and document the prompts, questions, and content gaps that matter most for each client's audience and competitive position.
* Support analysis using GEO tools such as Profound, Ahrefs, and more.
* Contribute to AI visibility benchmarking — tracking how clients are cited across LLMs and the AI Search space relative to competitors.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of GEO strategies, execution scopes, and client-facing reporting assets.

On-Site Content Planning & Support

* Create content plans which support AI citation
* Audit existing client content for GEO alignment and flag restructuring opportunities that could improve AI Visibility.
* Collaborate with writing and strategy teams to ensure content plans are executable and successful

Reddit Strategy

* Develop and manage Reddit strategies that build client visibility & presence in the community content sources AI models reference.
* Identify the right subreddits, content angles, and participation strategies for each client's audience and objectives.
* Plan platform-native content that earns upvotes & citation — understanding what Reddit culture demands vs. what traditional marketing assumes.
* Support the strategy which drives authentic Reddit presence including organic participation, strategic comment engagement, and branded posts where appropriate.

Performance & Reporting

* Track client KPIs including AI visibility, citation share, share of voice, AI referral traffic, prompt coverage, and Reddit engagement metrics.
* Contribute to regular performance reports with clear documentation of what's working, what isn't, and what to test next.
* Support ongoing testing across content formats, subreddit selection, post framing, and content structure.

Cross-Channel Integration

* Collaborate with creative, SEO, and senior GEO team members to ensure Reddit and on-site activity supports broader channel strategies.
* Surface audience insights — trending topics, community sentiment, competitive signals — and feed them into client content planning.
* Participate in client content audits and strategy sessions with a GEO and AI Visibility lens.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Execution Quality

* Post-handoff survey: senior strategists and execution teams rate brief clarity and deliverable quality 1–5 (target 4).
* No more than 1 significant rework cycle per deliverable triggered by unclear or incomplete work.

Client Satisfaction

* Client NPS score within 4 weeks of initial strategy delivery (target 8).
* QBR question: "How confident are you in the strategic direction?" (1–5, target 4.5).

Growth Toward Strategist

* Demonstrated expansion of skills into adjacent areas (technical SEO, social strategy, earned media) via PDP milestones.
* Contribution of at least one reusable internal framework or playbook per quarter.
* Ability to contribute meaningfully to client strategy presentations within 6 months.
* Showcased presentation confidence & client facing, consultative ability.

Compensation

* Base salary $50k–60k CAD depending on experience and location
* Variable compensation: team performance bonus and company-wide profit-sharing

* Fill in Culture Index survey: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/RPvunZfypMzd
* Apply through the application form

title: Senior CRO Strategist
description:
**Company Overview**

**CapsLock** is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across Marketing, IT, Analytics, CRO, and Media Buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a **Senior Marketing Strategist** who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
* Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
* Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
* Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
* Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
* Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
* Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
* Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
* Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
* Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
* Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

**AI & Experimentation Mindset**

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
* Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
* Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Exceptional communication skills.
* Proficient English language skills.
* Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
* Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
* Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
* Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

**﻿****Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

**Unlimited Sick Days**

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

**Medical Coverage**

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

**Co-Working Space**

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

**Fun Stuff**

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

* Proven ability in leading a global team in the management and completion of multiple, complex clinical studies
* Ability to demonstrate successful coaching/ mentoring and people management (remote management experience preferred)
* Expertise in Subject Matter and competent in application of standard business procedures (SOPs, ICH, Global Regulations, Ethics and Compliance)
* Integral participation in initiatives or advancement strategies for clinical operations
* Experience in successful study initiation through study completion/primary data analysis and in multiple phases of studies (Phase 1-3, 4)
* Must possess good communication skills

**Responsibilities**

**Job ID** R-252142 **Date posted** 10/09/2026

The Global Safety Program Lead, Senior Director is accountable to the Global Safety Head for the safety strategy, delivery, and oversight of the assigned asset(s); the professional will work with safety physicians and scientists responsible for the development, implementation, and application of safety strategy at asset and study level. Acts strategically to generate opportunity and value for the asset or indication to optimize benefit risk and maintain a competitive advantage. Line manages a team of safety physicians and / or scientists. They will be required at times to deputise for the Global Safety Head.

The Global Safety Program Lead, Senior Director will operate according to the highest ethical, quality and compliance standards in compliance as provided by global and local regulations, GxP practice and AZ procedures.

**You will be responsible for:**

**Safety Expert**

* Accountable for the overall scientific and clinical safety content for the assigned asset(s) or indications.

* Accountable for the implementation and the high quality delivery of the Safety & Strategy Management Team (SSaMT) and Safety Surveillance Team for assigned asset(s).

* Responsible for overall safety content for the product or indication(s) aligned to GPT strategy. Sets safety team goals aligned to TA and product strategy.

* For the assigned asset(s), accountable for safety TPP, Safety Go/No Go criteria, safety communication/messaging and the guidelines for toxicity management of the asset

* Is accountable for project representation for Global Patient Safety at governance and other forums where safety is involved, eg DRC, eCRC, SARB, FSIRB, and DSMB/DMC, Medical Affairs Review Committees (MARC), product teams such CPT and GPT and Advisory Board meetings in partnership with GSH.

* Accountable for the quality of key safety deliverables e.g., Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and Periodic Safety Reports (PSRs), compliance and adherence to PV regulations of the assigned asset(s).

* Leads response to complex technical issues for specific safety aspects for the assigned asset(s).

* Is accountable for safety contribution to study designs and study concept delivery within their assigned program

* Through integrated understanding of the product strategy, provides strategic safety knowledge and support to the safety medical directors and scientists through initiation, execution, and completion of the clinical programs for the assigned asset(s).

* Leads the safety physicians and scientists to support the safety strategy and input into the program design, monitoring, and data interpretation from pre-clinical and clinical studies, communication and post-marketing surveillance, epidemiology, pre-clinical and literature, epidemiology for each asset.

* Ensures that own work and work of team is compliant with Safety Health and Environment (SHE) standards and all other relevant internal and external regulations and standards.

* Represents the Company and accountable for the quality of safety delivery e.g., regulatory submissions, answers to Health Authority Queries, Ethic Committees, Marketing Companies, investigators/sites, and provides clarifications as well as solves safety issues in the study team.

* May be required to support in-licensing opportunities.

* Promotes and enables cross-functional, proactive and solutions-orientated team actions and behaviours

* Accountable for implementation of new processes, systems and learning, including new ways of working.

* Prioritizes risk mitigation strategies and effective trouble shooting.

* Line manages a team of safety physicians and / or scientists.

**Scientific clinical safety analytical accountabilities**

* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of the relevant safety scientific literature, and is able to clearly communicate key impactful information,

* Accountable for proper data collection and interpretation for determination of the risks and inform the label in markets globally

* Delivers analyses of clinical safety data in a balanced and statistically robust manner, to drive interpretations and develop novel proposals.

* Serves as a source of scientific and clinical safety knowledge for the Product Team, in the analyses and interpretation of scientific and clinical safety data.

**You will need to have:**

* Medical degree or equivalent degree in biomedicine or science

* 5 years extensive relevant clinical, safety and risk management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO industry, academia or Health Authorities

* Proven track record of successful clinical safety delivery with demonstrated examples of strategic influence to clinical studies/programs.

* Ability to collaborate across a matrixed environment and influence cross-functional- leaders on decision-making (e.g. Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs).

* Excellent, independent judgment based on leading-edge knowledge and expertise.

* Excellent speaking skills, industry conference speaking experience.

We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

**Responsibilities**

* **Engineering** - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.
* **Product Partnership** - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.
* **Leadership** - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

**Mandatory:**

* Experience **managing engineers or engineering leads** who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.
* **Strong product sense**: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.
* **Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints**: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.
* You **use AI tools heavily in your own work** and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.
* Deep **JavaScript and React**.
* **Initiative, curiosity, resilience**, and the ability to **give and receive direct critique.**

**Preferred:**

* **Bonus:** Experience with **local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source**.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Business Solution Architect
description:

* Lead business discovery, executive interviews, and cross-functional workshops to define objectives, pain points, capabilities, value drivers, and transformation priorities
* Assess current-state operating models, processes, customer journeys, data flows, and technology landscapes, then define target-state business architecture and roadmaps
* Translate business needs into solution vision, capability maps, process models, epics, use cases, requirements, and measurable success indicators
* Shape Salesforce-enabled transformation across the core portfolio, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, complemented by one or more advanced capabilities such as Agentforce and Salesforce AI, Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Health Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, or other industry solutions

title: Cloud Architect
description:
**Company Description**

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**

We're looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to join our organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, governance, and cost-effective operation of Ergomed's Cloud (Microsoft Azure) environment. This hands-on role leads the design of new and improvements to existing Azure projects, builds reusable deployment templates and standards, and provides architectural review across the tenant — collaborating with project teams on solution design and standards, with IT stakeholders on demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), and with IT Operations on day-to-day support

* Lead the architecture of new and existing Azure projects, recommending solutions and reviewing designs to ensure strong, repeatable foundations tailored to meet organizational requirements and business objectives
* Analyze current infrastructure and applications to identify optimization opportunities, cost reduction strategies, and migration pathways to cloud environments
* Drive improvements in Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, Advisor reviews, and reservation/commitment strategies.
* Build and maintain reusable project templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules so new workloads are provisioned consistently and correctly.
* + Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
* Develop, implement and maintain cloud governance frameworks, security policies, and compliance standards to ensure adherence to industry regulations and organizational standards
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps engineers, security specialists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into solution architectures that meets Ergomed's cloud standards and updating those standards where required
* Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
* Define and maintain tagging, naming, and subscription-structure standards, driving their consistent adoption across the tenant.
* Work with IT Security and workload teams to achieve and maintain demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), putting the right controls in place so compliance status can be evidenced at any time.
* Evaluate and recommend cloud technologies, tools, and services that align with organizational needs, including containerization platforms, orchestration systems, and infrastructure-as-code solutions
* Oversee cloud infrastructure deployments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities are properly implemented and tested
* Establish best practices for cloud resource management, including monitoring, performance optimization, and automated provisioning
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development and operations teams on cloud architecture patterns and cloud-native application design

  
**Qualifications**

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Extensive experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or cloud architecture, with significant hands-on experience designing and running Azure environments.
* Demonstrated experience in a cloud architecture or senior technical role
* Deep, hands-on Azure architecture expertise: landing zones, management groups, networking, identity, storage, compute, and security.
* Proven ability to design and build reusable deployment templates using Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, ARM).
* Strong understanding of Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, reservations/savings plans, and Azure Advisor
* Experience defining and enforcing cloud governance frameworks: Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC, and tagging/naming standards.
* Experience maintaining compliance against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA, including control implementation and audit evidence.
* Ability to translate architectural designs into operational requirements, working with IT Operations on support models.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex cloud infrastructure issues.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
* Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 frameworks, and experience supporting regulated (validated) cloud systems.

\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Experience with multi-cloud strategies and hybrid cloud architectures
* Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles
* Experience with serverless architectures and microservices design patterns
* Background in enterprise application migration and modernization projects

  
**Additional Information**

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: Data Product Engineer, Data & Analytics
description:
**Drive Innovation as our Next Data Product Engineer - Data & Analytics**

Ready to participate in shaping the next evolution of our central Data & Analytics team as we elevate our reporting and data-product foundation for the agentic AI era?

The central **Data & Analytics team** delivers trusted, governed data products for company-wide reporting through data engineering and analytics practices. In partnership with the Data Platform Team, we power the company’s data backbone and help ensure data supports day-to-day operations and decision-making.

To improve human and agentic AI data consumption, we are enhancing context and metadata management, extending our semantic layer, and strengthening deployment and AI-assisted workflows so these services remain governed, scalable, and resilient.

**What Makes This Role Interesting:**

This is a hands-on opportunity to shape the team’s future. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will influence direction and build solutions that turn promising ideas into durable data products, capabilities, and services.

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

**Build & scale data and analytics engineering**

* Design, build, and improve reliable data pipelines, analytical models, and reusable data products for BI, internal applications, and AI consumers.
* Provide opinionated technical leadership and establish standards for architecture, modeling, orchestration, testing, data contracts, documentation, ownership, access control, and lifecycle management.
* Shape and operate a governed semantic layer that provides consistent metrics and business concepts across reporting, applications, APIs, and AI-enabled services.
* Improve operational excellence through data-quality controls, observability, monitoring, alerting, incident practices, performance optimization, CI/CD, and cost management.

**Expand AI-native practices & solution delivery**

* Evolve the team’s AI-native practices, including how it defines work for (coding) agents and reviews generated designs, code, tests, and documentation.
* Make architectural decisions, dependencies, operational knowledge, and business context accessible and reusable by colleagues and AI agents.
* Deliver solutions end to end—from discovery and requirements through implementation, deployment, operation, and iteration—including internal applications, APIs, automation, and governed agent interfaces such as MCP servers.
* Improve shared workflows for programmatic dashboard deployment, authentication and authorization, access management, onboarding, and self-service, partnering with platform and security specialists where appropriate.

**Apply product judgment & engage stakeholders**

* Apply product judgment to determine which problems to solve, what a good solution looks like, and how to balance user value with security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

* Support the adoption of AI-native practices through practical guidance, review approaches, documentation, and reusable templates.
* Evaluate relevant developments in data, software engineering, and AI tooling, helping the team adopt practices that simplify delivery and improve outcomes.

**Your Essential Skills & Experience:**

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, or an adjacent field.
* Demonstrate mastery of data engineering and analytics engineering, including data modeling and ELT design, pipeline performance, reliability, and maintainability. Be an opinionated systems thinker.
* Deep practical experience with SQL, Python, data modelling, ELT, dbt, orchestration, and cloud data services—preferably using GCP (BigQuery), dbt, Airflow.
* Strong DevOps practices: Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, x as code, environment management, observability.
* Practical experience designing workflows for and directing AI coding agents, and validating generated designs, code, tests, and documentation.
* Experience building and maintaining production APIs, MCP servers, and endpoints.
* Ability to communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, self-directed builder who owns data products end to end and improves the analytics platform through strong data/analytics engineering and product judgment. They treat testing, observability, documentation, and governance as core product work, and they build trusted, resilient, cost-effective systems (pipelines, models, semantic layer, contracts, CI/CD). They are curious, opinionated but evidence-driven, AI-native in delivery (clear PRDs, effective use of coding agents, rigorous review), and a strong cross-functional partner who communicates trade-offs and enables correct data consumption.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge**

* Experience with BI and analytics governance, including metric consistency, semantic modeling, access control, data quality, discoverability, lifecycle management, and cost.
* Experience implementing semantic layers, metric stores, data catalogs, or governed analytical interfaces.
* Experience building internal applications with authentication and role-based access.

**About Us:**

Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.

**T&L:** In the Transportation & Logistics segment, our solutions make it safer, simpler and more efficient to move freight—bringing together a global network of shippers, carriers, brokers and 3PLs.

**Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us:**

* At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.

Data Product Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Python, SQL, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Airflow, Agentic AI, Semantic Layer, Transportation and Logistics, Data Product Engineer - Creator, Software Engineer, generalist

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. title: Product Manager
description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
* Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
* Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

**﻿Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

**Unlimited Sick Days**

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

**Medical Coverage**

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

**Co-Working Space**

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

**Fun Stuff**

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.
