title: Partner Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Ultralytics:**

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

**Join the team powering the future of vision AI**  
**Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour!** Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.  
  
**Who we are**  
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to **simplify AI for everyone**. As the creators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.  
  
Following our **$30M Series A round**, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.  
  
We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.  
  
**About the role**  
As a **Partner Solutions Engineer**, you'll work side by side with our Head of Partnerships to help partners build, integrate, and deploy computer vision solutions with Ultralytics YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, scope partner projects, and turn requirements into practical solution architectures, demos, and deployments.  
  
This is a hands-on, client-facing role with no people-management responsibilities. You'll collaborate with partners and internal engineering teams across model training, export, quantization, and cross-platform deployment. You'll thrive here if you combine deep technical curiosity with clear communication, sound judgment, and a bias for getting working solutions into users' hands.  
  
**What you'll do**  
**Partner solutions & delivery**

* Lead partner-facing technical calls, discovery, and project scoping.
* Design solution architectures for YOLO training, integration, export, and deployment.
* Build technical demos and rapid prototypes using Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.
* Support model export and INT8 quantization across ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, and LiteRT.
* Help partners deploy across Linux, macOS, and Windows, and document clear implementation guidance.

**Technical collaboration**

* Work side by side with the Head of Partnerships to advance partner integrations and unblock technical work.
* Review partner and community GitHub pull requests and share actionable feedback.
* Use OpenAI and Anthropic APIs to prototype client tools and accelerate partner workflows.
* Share partner needs and technical findings with Product and Engineering teams.

**Partner enablement**

* Create technical documentation, demos, and integration guidance using the Ultralytics docs and guides.
* Represent Ultralytics in partner meetings, technical events, and occasional travel.

**Skills and experience**  
**Core requirements**

* Experience in computer vision and AI, with practical knowledge of Python, YOLO, OpenCV, and PyTorch.
* Experience training, exporting, and deploying models; familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, LiteRT, and INT8 quantization.
* Proven ability to lead partner-facing technical calls, scope work, and deliver demos or solution architectures.
* Experience reviewing GitHub pull requests and writing clear technical documentation.
* Comfortable working across Linux, macOS, and Windows, with Docker and common development workflows.
* Strong spoken and written English; able to travel for partner meetings and events.
* Resourceful, collaborative, and comfortable taking ownership in a high-performance startup.

**Nice to have**

* Deep knowledge of vendor SDKs such as CUDA, ROCm, Vela, or Vitis AI.
* Experience with edge CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, including Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Snapdragon, or Arm platforms.
* Linux, Docker, and CI experience on ARM64 and x86; mobile or web deployment on Android, iOS, or WebGPU.
* C++ skills, performance profiling, or experience with PyTorch and OpenCV optimization.
* Familiarity with cloud ML platforms such as SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Azure ML, and video pipelines like DeepStream or Triton.
* Experience creating talks, blogs, or demo videos; additional Spanish, Italian, or Mandarin language skills.

**Cultural fit**  
At Ultralytics, we set **bold goals** and execute with **speed, precision, and teamwork**. We're driven by **hard work, ambition, and resilience** — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.  
  
**You'll thrive here if you:**

* Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.
* Combine technical depth with a client-first, hands-on approach.
* Value **excellence, grit, and creativity** in equal measure.
* See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.

**Our culture is built around our core values:**

* **Relentless progress:** Constant evolution and improvement.
* **Strive for excellence:** Perseverance and attention to detail.
* **Actions, not words:** Focus on delivering meaningful results.
* **Act with urgency:** Seize fleeting opportunities.
* **Open access to all:** Transparent communication and collaboration.

Learn more in our Ultralytics Handbook.  
  
**Compensation and benefits**  
We reward **excellence and impact** — not just tenure or title.

* **Competitive salary:** Reflecting your experience and contribution.
* **Equity packages:** We want our success to be yours too.
* **On-site collaboration:** Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs.
* **Flexible working hours:** We value results over routines.
* **Generous time off:** 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.
* **Tech & tools:** Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.
* **Gear:** Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.
* **Learning & development:** Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.
* **High impact:** Your work will shape the future of vision AI.

Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture, values, and teams.  
  
**Where and how you can work**  
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.

* This role is **on-site** at one of our global hubs: London or Madrid.
* Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country of application.

We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen.  
  
**Why join us**  
We're not just building models — we're building the **ecosystem powering the future of vision AI**. If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment.  
  
**Ready to build the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI?** **Apply now.**

title: Principal Environment Artist/ Lead
description:
**Job Title: Principal Environment Artist/ Lead**

**Location:** Remote, UK OR Hybrid Lisbon, EU  
**Reporting to:** Director of Art

**Salary:** £45k - £70k per annum/ €53,295 – € 82,748 per annum

**Contract:** Full time, 6 Month FTC *(with possibility to move to permanent)*

**Company Overview**

At Lockwood, our vision is to bring people together through Avakin Life, where players can play, share, and socialize in one of the world's largest and most populous metaverses. Avakin Life provides an immersive 3D life simulation experience for millions of users worldwide.

With a focus on innovation and collaboration, Lockwood offers a flexible and creative environment that empowers our teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible. We provide competitive benefits, including an employee share scheme, making Lockwood an exciting destination for those passionate about shaping the future of digital experiences. This position is available as a fully remote role, though there may be occasional meetups for social interaction and strategic sessions.

**Role Summary**

As a Principal Environment Artist, you will be responsible for defining and delivering world-class, immersive environments for **Avakin Life**, while driving artistic quality, technical excellence, and innovation across the environment art discipline. You will lead by example through hands-on creation, mentoring, production planning, and the adoption of AI-assisted workflows. Working closely with Art Direction, Experience Design, Technical Art, and Production, you will help shape the visual identity of the game while improving team workflows, scalability, and efficiency.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Environment Art & Visual Development**

* Translate creative briefs into compelling AI-generated visual concepts, enriching the original vision with innovative ideas while remaining aligned to the creative direction.
* Transform briefs, concepts, mood boards, concept art, and AI-generated visual explorations into polished, production-ready 3D environments that support gameplay, narrative, and player experience.
* Create visually stunning and immersive environments for Avakin Life, including interiors, exteriors, landmarks, and interactive spaces.
* Produce high-quality hard surface and organic 3D assets that meet both artistic and technical standards.
* Design and create high-quality textures and materials that achieve a cohesive visual style while remaining optimised for mobile platforms.
* Deliver lighting, simple environment animation, and VFX that enhance mood, atmosphere, and player immersion.
* Optimise environments and assets to achieve excellent performance across supported mobile devices without compromising visual quality.
* Maintain and improve the quality of existing environments through bug fixing, optimisation, and continuous polish.

**AI Innovation & Workflow Development**

* Champion the integration of AI-assisted workflows across the environment art pipeline, leveraging both proprietary internal tools and external AI technologies.
* Utilise AI tools for ideation, concept generation, image enhancement, texture creation, material generation, lighting exploration, and 3D asset generation to improve production efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to enhance quality, speed, and creative exploration.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of internal AI pipelines, implementation standards, and best practices.
* Promote responsible and effective AI adoption across the art team through documentation, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Act as a senior creative leader within the Environment Art team, setting quality benchmarks and driving artistic excellence.
* Under the guidance of the Art Director, lead environment ideation sessions, visual exploration, and workflow planning in collaboration with Experience Designers.
* Mentor Environment Artists and Prop Artists through regular feedback, technical guidance, workflow coaching, and AI knowledge sharing.
* Review environment and prop assets, providing constructive feedback to maintain consistent quality across the team.
* Present work to the Art Director, interpret feedback, and guide the team through implementation.
* Collaborate closely with Designers, Technical Artists, Engineers, Producers, and QA to ensure environments support gameplay, technical requirements, and production goals.
* Work effectively with external outsourcing partners by preparing clear briefs, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring outsourced work meets project quality standards.

**Production & Delivery**

* Support planning and oversight of environment and prop production, helping artists overcome blockers and ensuring timely delivery.
* Break down complex environment tasks into achievable work packages, providing accurate effort estimates and identifying dependencies.
* Prioritise environment work in alignment with production milestones and project objectives.
* Adapt priorities effectively as project scope evolves.
* Provide accurate reporting on progress, risks, blockers, and delivery status to Leads, Art Directors, and Production.
* Contribute actively to creative discussions, planning meetings, and production reviews.

**Quality & Testing**

* Deliver high-quality, bug-free assets ready for production.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and artistic issues throughout production.
* Apply strong quality control practices to minimise defects and improve asset stability

  
**Requirements**

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Expert knowledge of 3D environment creation, including both hard surface and organic modelling.
* Strong understanding of colour theory, composition, lighting, scale, and environmental storytelling.
* Excellent low-poly modelling and topology optimisation skills.
* Advanced UV mapping and texture creation experience.
* Strong understanding of mobile optimisation techniques.
* Experience creating lighting setups within Unity.
* Ability to create simple environment animations and visual effects.
* Experience using AI tools for image generation, concept exploration, texture creation, material generation, and 3D asset generation.
* Comfortable working with proprietary tools, scripts, shaders, and internal production pipelines.
* Ability to work effectively from briefs, mood boards, concept art, or AI-generated visual references.
* Excellent time management with the ability to consistently meet production deadlines.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Proven ability to lead environment ideation and visual development from concept through production.
* Experience mentoring artists and helping develop team capability.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence presenting work to Art Directors and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to provide constructive art reviews and maintain consistent quality standards.
* Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams including Design, Technical Art, Engineering, Production, and QA.
* Experience managing relationships with external outsourcing vendors.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to balance artistic ambition against technical constraints.
* Passion for sharing knowledge, improving workflows, and driving continuous innovation across the team.

**Production & Planning**

* Experience planning and overseeing environment and prop production.
* Ability to estimate task complexity, effort, and production timelines accurately.
* Strong understanding of game development production pipelines and milestone planning.
* Comfortable reprioritising work as project requirements evolve.
* Ability to communicate progress, blockers, dependencies, and risks clearly to stakeholders.

**Quality Assurance**

* Strong understanding of asset validation, testing, and bug prevention.
* Ability to identify and resolve technical issues efficiently.
* Commitment to delivering polished, production-ready content that meets both artistic and technical quality standards.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience shipping live service or mobile games.
* Experience working on stylised game environments.
* Experience developing or improving AI-assisted art pipelines.
* Knowledge of procedural content generation tools and workflows.
* Familiarity with performance profiling and optimisation techniques for Unity.
* Experience contributing to studio-wide art standards, documentation, and best practices.

 **Benefits**

At Lockwood, you’ll be part of an inclusive, creative, and highly motivated team. You’ll work on systems used by millions of players, shaping the live game experience and ensuring we can deliver new content and events rapidly and reliably. This is your opportunity to make a real impact—not just on our games, but on the future of how we operate.

title: Director of Partnerships and Technology Alliances
description:
**About DataCamp**

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you'll build the partnerships function that scales our curriculum—bringing the world's leading content providers, technology vendors, and highest-profile instructors onto DataCamp so millions of learners can build the skills that matter.

**About the role**

This is a player-coach role that reports to our Content organization. You will own the partnership strategy end-to-end, personally close the deals that define it, and then build a small team behind you as the function grows. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

* Own DataCamp's partnership strategy for curriculum: which content providers, technology vendors, and marquee experts we partner with, in what order, and why.
* Source, negotiate, and close partnerships—licensed and co-branded content, official vendor certifications, and marquee instructor deals.
* Build and manage senior relationships across the AI, data, and cloud ecosystem, from partner leadership through to their content and product teams.
* Work with curriculum, product, legal, and marketing to take partnerships from signed agreement to live content that learners actually complete.
* Define what a high-quality partner looks like for DataCamp and hold the bar—prioritizing depth and learner impact over volume of logos.
* Own the commercial and contractual side of partnerships, including licensing terms, revenue share, and instructor agreements.
* Hire, coach, and grow a small partnerships team over time, while continuing to carry your own portfolio of relationships.
* Report on partnership performance to leadership, and make the call on which partnerships to double down on and which to retire.

**Qualifications:**

* 3-5+ years in partnerships, alliances, or business development at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with a track record of sourcing and closing deals you personally led.
* Deep fluency in the AI, data, and cloud landscape. You know who the players are, how the ecosystem is shifting, and which partners will matter in 18 months.
* Experience in the education, EdTech, or enterprise L&D market, and a real understanding of what makes learning content valuable to a buyer and to a learner.
* Proven ability to build a function from near-scratch: you're a self-starter and are able to seamlessly switch from strategy to execution.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including comfort with licensing, revenue share, and content rights.
* Excellent cross-functional judgment. You can hold your own with content, product, and legal teams and translate between partner ambitions and internal reality.

**Bonus if you have the following**

* An existing network across AI and data technology vendors, certification bodies, or the creator and expert community in data and AI.
* A deep understanding of the DataCamp course format—you have an intuitive sense of what makes a great DataCamp course.
* Experience as an educator or curriculum developer in technical education.

**Why Datacamp?**

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you'll love being on our team:

* **Exciting Challenges** – Tackle some of the most important educational challenges in Data & AI.
* **Work with the Best Instructors** – Partner with top-tier instructors from leading organizations like Microsoft, Hugging Face, AWS, and more.
* **Competitive Compensation** – We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
* **Work Flexibility** – Benefit from flexible working hours and a remote-friendly culture.
* **Professional Growth** – Access to a yearly learning & development budget.
* **Global Culture** – Join a team that values international collaboration.
* **Annual Retreats** – Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
* **Tools & Setup** – Receive an annual IT equipment budget to refresh your workspace.

Our competitive compensation package offers additional benefits. On top of your salary you will also receive extra legal benefits such as best-in-class medical insurance including dental and vision. Depending on your location additional benefits might be available to you.

description:

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.
  
  
**Build the business. Build the marketing team.**
HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.
  
  
You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.
  
  
You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
* Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
* Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

**Who we are looking for**

* Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention

Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.

* Culture Index survey

Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  
  
Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

title: Director, Brand Design
description:
**About Us**

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick-care" to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again".

Reporting to the VP, Design & Experience, the Director, Creative will lead Prenuvo's Creative function and oversee a multidisciplinary team of contributors. This leadership role is responsible for the Creative function as a whole; its people, capabilities, priorities, creative vision, quality, and effectiveness. The Director, Creative will oversee Prenuvo's creative expression across brand, campaigns, paid media, social, web, content, motion, physical environments, events, partnerships, and emerging experiences.

Your role is both directive and integrative. You'll set the creative vision and quality bar while leading through your team, giving them the clarity, ownership, and autonomy to independently direct programs, disciplines, and bodies of work. You'll partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Product Design, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other subject-matter experts to ensure creative work is compelling, accurate, and responsive to the needs of a healthcare environment.

You'll combine a strong creative point of view with organizational leadership—building the team and capabilities we need, establishing scalable creative practices, and partnering across the company to turn brand and business strategy into exceptional creative work. This is a fully remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team gatherings, productions, events, and other business needs.

**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people's lives!

**What You'll Do**

* **Vision & creative direction**
  + Own and evolve Prenuvo's creative expression, translating brand and business strategy into a distinctive experience across channels.
  + Set the creative vision, principles, and quality standards that guide the brand design team and its partners.
  + Provide senior creative direction for major campaigns, launches, partnerships, and brand initiatives while empowering Creative Leads to direct individual programs and bodies of work.
  + Ensure the brand remains cohesive while continuing to evolve as Prenuvo, its audiences, and its offerings grow.
* **Organizational leadership**
  + Own the structure, capabilities, performance, and development of Prenuvo's Creative function, building a multidisciplinary team capable of supporting the company's evolving brand and business needs.
  + Lead and develop team members, establishing clear accountability and empowering them to lead their teams and work independently.
  + Identify capability and talent gaps and determine where to build internally versus leverage agencies, freelancers, and production partners.
  + Create an environment of high standards, collaboration, accountability, creative ambition, and professional growth.
* **Portfolio, priorities, and resources**
  + Own creative portfolio planning and resourcing, partnering with the VP of Design & Experience and cross-functional leaders to prioritize creative investment against the company's highest-value opportunities.
  + Balance business demand, team capacity, strategic importance, and creative opportunity when establishing priorities.
  + Ensure the Creative organization has the right talent, partners, processes, and resources to deliver against company priorities.
  + Provide visibility into creative priorities, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
* **Cross-functional leadership**
  + Serving as the senior creative authority to the local brand design and creative team while taking broader direction from the VP, Design and Experience and partnering with leaders across Marketing, Growth, Product, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other functions.
  + Translate business objectives, audience insights, and channel strategies into creative opportunities and direction.
  + Present and advocate for creative strategy and work with senior and executive stakeholders.
  + Partner closely with Product Design where brand and product experiences intersect, creating continuity while maintaining clear ownership between the two functions.
* **Creative systems and effectiveness**
* + Establish scalable approaches to creative intake, prioritization, briefing, review, production, and delivery.
  + Oversee agencies, freelancers, production partners, and other external creative resources.
  + Partner with Marketing and Growth to understand creative performance and translate learnings into stronger creative strategy.
  + Balance brand-building and performance objectives, ensuring short-term optimization doesn't come at the expense of long-term brand equity.
  + Identify opportunities for AI and emerging technologies to improve creative exploration, production, scalability, and efficiency.
  + Remain connected to the work and step directly into creative development when the scale, complexity, or strategic importance of an initiative warrants it.

**What You'll Bring**

* 15+ years of experience in creative, brand, design, or related disciplines, including significant creative leadership experience.
* 5+ years managing and developing creative teams and senior creative talent, with demonstrated success building high-performing multidisciplinary organizations.
* An exceptional portfolio demonstrating brand thinking and creative direction across multiple channels and experiences.
* Deep experience across brand, digital, web, paid advertising, social, video/motion, and integrated campaigns.
* Experience with physical or experiential design—including retail, clinics, hospitality, or events—is highly valued.
* Strong understanding of both brand building and performance marketing.
* Demonstrated experience with portfolio prioritization, resource planning, team building, and organizational development.
* Experience managing agencies, production partners, freelancers, budgets, and complex creative programs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and articulate the thinking behind creative decisions.
* Familiarity with product and UX design and the ability to partner effectively with Product Design leadership.
* Strong understanding of contemporary creative tools and emerging AI-enabled creative technologies.
* Consumer marketing experience in healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech, wellness, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

**Our Values**

First: we are **Pioneers**

* Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are **Platform-Builders**

* We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are **Patients**

* We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

**What We Offer**

* An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
* We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
* Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
* Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
* Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
* Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
* We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
* **The base salary for this role ranges from $180,000-$210,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location**

*We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.*

**Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [****prenuvo.com****]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

title: Chief Growth Officer
description:
**Position Title:** Chief Growth Officer

**Reports to:** Executive Director

**Team:** 2 FTEs on partnerships + 1 marketing contractor

**Role Type:** Full-Time Employee

**About Us:**

The Student Basic Needs Coalition (SBNC) is building the national model for connecting students with public benefits and basic needs resources.

Millions of students are eligible for programs like SNAP and Medicaid, yet the majority never enroll due to complex rules, stigma, and administrative barriers. SBNC addresses this gap by partnering with organizations across the country to implement peer-led outreach programs and deploy **Navvy**, SBNC's AI-enabled technology platform that screens students for benefits eligibility and supports the enrollment process.

Since launching in 2020, SBNC has grown rapidly. The organization now partners with **100+ campuses nationwide**, has screened **more than 50,000 students**, and has referred students to **over $116 million in potential public benefits**. In 2024, SBNC hired its first full-time Executive Director and has since grown to a **$2 million organization with a team of seven**, expanding to **ten staff members this year** as it scales its national model.

**Position Overview:**

SBNC is hiring its first Chief Growth Officer (CGO) to turn strong demand and a growing national network into a repeatable growth and earned-revenue model. We already work with 100+ campuses and regularly hear interest from colleges, systems, states, funders, and other partners, but we have not yet built a sales engine or established pricing for our offerings. The CGO will help determine which institutional segments to prioritize, how to position and package our work, what institutions are willing to pay for, and how to move from interest and pilots to recurring paid partnerships. They will work closely with the Executive Director on SBNC's highest-priority sales and relationships while building the systems, pipeline, and team needed to make growth increasingly repeatable. This role does not own fundraising; the CGO coordinates with the Executive Director so growth, partner, and funder messaging stay aligned.

The CGO will also lead SBNC's marketing, building our brand and positioning with institutional buyers while owning our direct-to-student and alternative distribution strategy. That includes deciding where investments in digital channels, creator partnerships, and non-campus partners such as national nonprofits, food banks, and workforce programs can most effectively connect students to Navvy. Direct-to-student channels are measured on reach and impact; earned revenue comes from institutional partnerships.

Growth doesn't end at a signed agreement. The CGO will own renewal and expansion, build a partner-success model that sets new partners up to launch well, and close the loop between the field and product so partner and student insights shape how Navvy evolves.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can move between strategy and execution: shaping go-to-market and pricing, personally advancing important partnerships, using data to decide where to invest, developing staff, and working closely with product and the executive team as SBNC scales. The ideal candidate's deepest strength will be institutional sales and partnerships, paired with the judgment to lead marketing and use data to test which channels best reach students.

**Responsibilities**

**Growth Strategy & Leadership (15%)**

* Set SBNC's growth and marketing strategy across institutional and direct-to-student channels, identifying priority markets, segments, and distribution opportunities based on data, partner feedback, and org positioning
* Achieve targets for Navvy screener adoption, partnerships, and revenue, reporting performance to the executive team, funders, and board on a regular cadence
* Own and evolve SBNC's go-to-market strategy for paid offerings, including market research, customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, pricing, pilot design, sales motion, and testing what institutions will pay for
* Manage, lead and build the growth function over time, including defining roles, systems, processes, developing staff, and planning future hiring needs as the team expands

**Business Development & Earned Revenue (40%)**

* Build and manage a strong, nationwide pipeline of campus, state, system, and other institutional partners
* Lead partnership development and sales strategy from initial outreach through negotiation, close, and implementation, with direct personal ownership of the organization's highest-stakes system and state-level relationships and managerial oversight of all partnerships
* Use Hubspot CRM data and forecasting to drive pipeline visibility and data-informed decisions across the growth team
* Diversify and scale SBNC's earned-revenue base so it grows alongside philanthropic revenue, ensuring pricing and packaging decisions preserve equitable student access as well as organizational sustainability
* Hold accountability for the earned-revenue P&L, setting annual and multi-year targets in partnership with the COO

**Partner Success & Field Learning (25%)**

* Build a scalable partner-success model, ensuring new partners launch successfully with the support, tools, and expectations needed to drive student and staff engagement
* Own renewal and expansion strategy and targets, identifying opportunities to deepen relationships, improve retention, and grow revenue over time
* Partner closely with the Chief Product Officer to ensure Navvy is delivered effectively to campuses/partners, owning the feedback loop so partner and student experience insights inform product development
* Sponsor and sustain the growth team's community of practice among institutional partners, translating field learnings into documented, replicable practices that inform SBNC's tiered engagement model and go-to-market approach
* Track partner satisfaction and account status as core success measures

**Marketing & Direct-to-Student Reach (20%)**

* Lead demand generation, brand awareness, and growth marketing efforts, managing contractors and external partners as budget allows
* Build SBNC's brand and positioning with institutional buyers through case studies, conference presence, thought leadership, and sales enablement materials that support pipeline growth
* Own SBNC's direct-to-student reach strategy, testing channels such as creator partnerships, social, search, and referral to connect students not served through campus partners
* Build non-campus distribution partnerships (e.g., national nonprofits, food banks, workforce programs) that embed Navvy where students already seek help
* Run a structured channel-testing portfolio with clear hypotheses, success thresholds, and stop criteria, scaling what works and sunsetting what doesn't
* Track reach and efficiency metrics (completed screenings, cost per completed screening, downstream benefit applications)

**Skills and Competencies**

We recognize that some individuals from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don't meet 100% of the listed qualifications. Please don't let that discourage you from applying! We value the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each applicant brings, and we encourage you to apply if you believe your background demonstrates the required skills and competencies.

**Required for all Roles at SBNC:**

* Commitment to SBNC's mission to help postsecondary students connect to the resources they need to stay enrolled, complete their education, and build a foundation for economic mobility.
* Treating students as co-designers, not only people we serve, and prioritizing those facing the greatest barriers first, true to our value of **Lead With Students**.
* Resourcefulness and a sense of urgency in removing friction between students and the benefits they qualify for, while maintaining a high bar for quality and follow-through, our value of **Unlock Every Dollar**.
* A commitment to **Design for Scale** by thinking a step ahead of where the organization is today, prioritizing what matters most, and building for the next campus, policy shift, or student barrier before it arrives.
* Comfort wearing multiple hats, **Owning the Outcome**, asking for help when stuck, and showing up for teammates when it counts. A startup mentality.
* Treating growth and innovation as an ongoing habit and leaning on the team to **Learn Together** by seeking feedback, sharing it openly, and adapting when needed.

**Required for this Role:**

* Functional or executive-level leadership experience with 7+ years of management experience, including significant experience leading growth, partnerships, business development, sales, or a related function, while remaining willing and able to perform individual-contributor-level work
* Personally owned and drove at least $500K in annual recurring revenue from higher education institutions, government agencies, systems, or similarly complex institutional buyers
* Experience leading both new business development and partner success/expansion, including renewals and upsells
* Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategy, including market research, positioning, pricing, pipeline development, and testing what drives adoption
* Experience partnering with or overseeing marketing to drive pipeline or adoption
* Experience building systems, processes, or a team from the ground up in an early-stage or resource-constrained environment, rather than solely optimizing an existing function
* Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex institutions and influence senior decision-makers
* Strategic and analytical mindset, using market feedback, performance data, experimentation, and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) to refine growth strategy

**Preferred for this Role:**

* Experience converting grant-funded or free pilots into paid, recurring offerings, including repricing existing partners and managing the shift in partner and funder expectations
* Familiarity with how colleges, systems, and state agencies budget and buy, including procurement cycles, RFPs, and grant-funded purchasing
* Experience pricing offerings in a mission-driven context, balancing access with sustainability (e.g., tiered or sliding-scale models)
* Experience in SaaS or tech-enabled services, partnering with product teams to turn customer feedback into roadmap priorities
* Experience building brand and sales enablement for institutional buyers, such as case studies, conference strategy, and thought leadership
* Experience growing awareness or adoption through marketing or non-enterprise channels, such as digital or consumer marketing, community or channel partnerships, or product-led growth, with fluency in funnel metrics
* Experience reaching students, young adults, or low-income communities through digital channels, creators, or community organizations
* Experience managing external marketing agencies or contractors and deploying a marketing budget
* Knowledge of public benefits programs or student basic needs
* Experience building practitioner networks or communities of practice

**Other Logistics**

* **Location:** Fully Remote
* **Full-time:** 5-day work week, 40-45 hours
* **Salary Range:** $170,000 (SBNC posts a single, non-negotiable salary per role) plus a 10% target performance bonus.
* **Timeline:** Applications will reviewed on a rolling basis until 10/27

**We take care of our employees by providing the following perks and benefits:**

* Medical insurance (100% Paid Employee Only Coverage, 50% for dependents)

Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in one of the 50 U.S. states or the District of Columbia. U.S. territories and work from abroad are not eligible. SBNC does not offer visa sponsorship.

title: Head of Marketing, B2B Payments
description:
**About Rebill**
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.
  
  
The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.
  
  
Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.
  
  
Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.
  
  
Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.
  
  
Built locally. Designed to scale globally.
  
  
Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).
  
  
Why this role exists
  
  
Our product is ahead of our brand.
  
  
We show up in evaluations against the large regional processors. In too many of them we are not in the room at all, and in the ones where we are, we read as earlier stage than we are. A company about to route its regional volume through us needs to see infrastructure, not a startup. That gap costs us deals we should be winning on product.
  
  
At the same time, every piece of marketing we do today is run by the founders in the gaps between other jobs: the ads, the SEO, the content, the launches, the events. It holds at twelve people. It will not hold through the next stage.
  
  
This role owns both.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Brand and positioning. One story about what Rebill is and why it matters, decided once and held everywhere: the site, the deck, the product, the sales calls. There are four versions of it today. The harder half of this is moving Rebill from looking like a startup to being credible to a bank, a public company or a regulated buyer, and doing it without losing the reason people like working with us. Visual identity and the standard of every surface that carries our name are part of the job.
* Product marketing. Our product is technical and our buyer gets more sophisticated every quarter. Someone has to turn what engineering ships into something a CFO or a VP of Finance understands and acts on: launches with a real process behind them, sales material that shortens a cycle instead of decorating it, and airtime for the people building it.
* Content and distribution. Build the publishing engine: site, blog, LinkedIn, press, and the organic surface that AI assistants cite when someone asks how to collect across Latin America. Content goes out in English first and gets localized per market after.
* Events and founder positioning. Own the calendar and the outcome, from Money20/20 and Febraban class shows down to dinners for fifteen people that move one account. Booth, content, capture, follow-up, and the discipline of cross-referencing scanned leads against the CRM so we know what was net new and which opportunities we influenced. The bar is that events pay for themselves and that you can show it. You will also get our founders onto the right stages and make them better once they are up there.
* Demand generation. Campaigns, paid, funnel instrumentation and the loop back to sales. You inherit what the founders run today, starting with Google Ads and SEO.
* Ecosystem. Accelerators, communities, partner co-marketing and the Y Combinator network.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You work inside a technology company today, or did until recently, and someone else paid for that learning curve. Rebill is not where you find out how software gets built and sold. Payments or fintech in Latin America is where our strongest candidates come from. Failing that, a technical B2B category with a sophisticated buyer and a long sales cycle. If your career is in agencies, consulting or consumer brands, this is not the role.
* You have sold to companies, not consumers. You know what a long enterprise cycle feels like from the inside and what actually counts as proof inside one.
* You have run marketing across several countries from one seat. Not one market with regional support. Several markets with different payment cultures, different press and different buyers, with a team you could count on one hand.
* Your career passed through more than one discipline. The people who are best at this job have some combination of classical brand work, where owning a brand meant owning a business, hands-on paid media, and time spent close to product. One lane is not enough here. Two or three is what makes the difference.
* You are hands-on. You write the copy, brief the designer, build the deck and pull the numbers yourself. For the first stretch there is nobody to hand it to.
* You write English at a level that does not need editing, and you present in English and Spanish. Our content is English first.

You use AI tools every day and it is visible in how much you ship and how good it is.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Portuguese. Brazil is a priority market and we invest there.
* You have taken a company through the move from looking like a startup to being credible to a regulated buyer, and you remember what actually shifted it.
* Press and analyst relations in payments or fintech.
* Ownership of a booth or a program at an event the size of Money20/20 or Febraban.
* You have managed a designer or an agency and held visual consistency across markets.
* A real network in the Latin American fintech ecosystem: accelerators, communities, funds, operators.

**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 90 days there is one version of our story and everyone uses it. The site, the deck and the sales team say the same thing, and you can explain in one paragraph why a company should route its regional volume through us.
  
  
By six months there is a content engine publishing in English with a localization path, launches have a process attached to them, and our events are measured against pipeline instead of against how the booth felt.
  
  
By twelve months, when a mid-market or enterprise company in the Americas starts looking for a way to collect across the region, we are on the shortlist. Marketing sources a measurable share of new pipeline and you know which share and why.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
There is no team to inherit. You are the marketing function for the first stretch, and you hire in the second year, not the first.
  
  
The founders stay the public faces of Rebill. We want you to make us better at that and to build a brand that outlasts us doing it. We are not looking for someone to be the voice instead of us.
  
  
We keep marketing in-house. We use agencies for specific pieces, press and visual identity among them, and we do not hand anyone the brand.
  
  
You report to the co-founders, and you will spend your first months earning credibility with people who have never worked alongside a marketing function. That is part of the job and not a sign that it is going badly.
  
  
**Compensation**
Competitive base, meaningful equity, and the scope of a founding function. Hybrid in Buenos Aires, Bogotá or Miami. Remote from Mexico City or São Paulo, with regular time in one of our offices. Travel for events and offsites.

**Show Us Your Work**

**What We Can Offer You**

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

Leading a specific key account/s - driving efficiencies and proactive problem solving to deliver productions that joins the dots between cultural signals and relevance across SMA’S, CAIT, Production, Live Shopping, Experiential + incremental ideas.

The Subject Matter Expert: Serve as VaynerMedia’s internal authority on CAIT. Working closely with our internal Creative team, you are the person internal teams call to help sell a CAIT incremental scope to a hesitant client, and the person Strategy looks to for the latest on platform creator trends.

**Personality and Experience**
yet we do know that these qualifications lead to what
**WE KNOW**

* Navigating Difficulty: You prioritise and navigate difficult conversations effectively, setting the example for the team.

This is a leadership role for someone who thinks in systems and creates with purpose — equally at home directing a video shoot, evaluating an AI tool that eliminates three manual steps, or overseeing a website redesign.
  
This role is not defined by process management. It's defined by output and velocity. The right person uses their fluency in marketing technology and AI to make the team faster, the work better, and the creative more scalable — without letting systems become the point. You have high creative standards, a bias toward action, and a natural instinct for finding smarter ways to work. You lead people who build, design, develop, and produce, and you set the bar for what great looks like across all of it.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
AI-Powered Marketing Efficiency
  

* Lead Aline's adoption of AI tools across the marketing function — identifying where AI can meaningfully accelerate content creation, campaign execution, personalization, and workflow automation
* Stay ahead of the evolving AI and answer engine optimization (AEO) landscape and bring concrete recommendations to marketing leadership
* Set standards for how AI is used responsibly within the marketing function, with clear quality controls and brand guardrails

Marketing Systems & Technology
  

* Own Aline's marketing technology stack — including marketing automation, campaign tooling, and integrations with the CRM (Salesforce)
* Ensure systems are configured to support efficient campaign execution, accurate tracking, and clean data flows into GTM reporting
* Serve as the primary marketing stakeholder for tech stack decisions, vendor relationships, and tool evaluations

Creative & Design
  

* Own Aline's creative output including brand design, sales collateral, product marketing assets, event materials, and campaign creative across all formats
* Manage internal creative resources and/or agency relationships to deliver high-quality work at the pace the business requires
* Ensure all creative output adheres to brand standards and communicates Aline's positioning with clarity, consistency, and visual impact

Web Development & Digital Experience
  

* Own Aline's website, including architecture, content strategy, performance optimization, and ongoing development
* Execute website enhancements, new page builds, and technical improvements on time and to a high standard
* Ensure the website delivers a best-in-class digital experience that reflects Aline's brand, supports SEO/AEO goals, and converts visitors into pipeline
* Partner with Corporate Marketing on content strategy and with RevOps on conversion optimization and A/B testing
* Oversee Aline's multimedia and video production strategy — including customer stories, explainer content, event recordings, and social-ready video

Qualifications
  

* 10+ years of progressive experience in creative, digital marketing, or marketing leadership within B2B SaaS, with meaningful exposure to marketing technology and systems
* High creative standards and a strong portfolio of brand, campaign, and digital work
* Fluency with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or equivalent) and CRM integration (Salesforce); you don't need to be an admin, but you need to know how the pieces fit together
* Proven experience adopting and scaling AI tools to accelerate marketing workflows: content, creative, campaign operations, or analytics
* Experience managing web development and creative functions, including agency relationships
* Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth environment preferred
* Senior living, healthcare technology, or vertical SaaS experience a plus but not required
* Bias toward action - you see inefficiency and fix it; you see a creative gap and fill it
* Collaborative and cross-functional by nature; you build systems and assets that serve the entire GTM team, not just marketing
* High ownership mentality; you set the standard for the team and hold it

title: Director of Brand and Creative
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

As Director of Brand and Creative, you'll own Proof's brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, and creative output across every touchpoint, including proof.com, campaigns, events, sales materials, and executive presence. Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

### **What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:**

* Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.
* Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.
* Brand hub and templates: Build a self-serve brand hub and template library so Sales,  
  Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.
* Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for  
  campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.
* Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.
* Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.
* Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research  
  (awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

### **What we're looking for:**

* 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.
* A portfolio showing brand systems and campaigns that made complex or trust-centric products clear and distinctive.
* Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion.
* Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.
* Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

### **You'll really stand out if you have:**

* Experience building brands for financial services, payments, or identity companies.
* Experience with AI-assisted creative workflows and modern tooling (Figma, Adobe CC, Webflow).
* Experience spanning both B2B enterprise and consumer-facing touchpoints.

### **Position Logistics:**

**Travel:** This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

### **Our Proof Pillars:**

* **Pave the Way:** When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
* **Own It:** We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
* **Act with Integrity:** We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
* **Play to Win:** We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

### **Here are some of our great benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
* 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
* Unlimited Sick and Vacation time
* 14 paid company holidays
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
* Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
* Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit
* Monthly work from home stipend
* Professional development credit
* Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
* And more!

$180,000 - $250,000 a year

This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, discretionary bonus typically paid annually, the benefits listed above, and equity.

This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 23, 2026.

Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director of Brand & Creative Marketing
description:
**Director of Brand & Creative Marketing**
==========================================

Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to the Co-CEOs | Remote (U.S.) | Director: $150k-210k
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

***Please note: Must submit a portfolio to be considered for this role.***

**About the Role**
------------------

Seeking is looking for a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on **Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing** to lead the brand side of our marketing organization.

This is not a traditional management role and it is not a position for someone who wants to sit above the work.

We are looking for an operator.

This person will own Seeking's brand marketing strategy and lead an approximately 13-person organization spanning PR, creative, copy, social, influencer marketing, and broader brand initiatives and activations. They will be responsible for turning company goals into marketing strategy, turning strategy into executable plans, ensuring the right people are accountable for the right work, and ultimately determining whether that work is moving the business.

The role works closely with Seeking's Co-CEOs and alongside our Director of Growth and Lifecycle Marketing. Our Digital Marketing team owns areas such as paid acquisition, lifecycle/CRM, conversion optimization, and digital growth. This role owns the brand side of marketing while partnering closely with Growth to ensure both functions operate as one marketing organization and share accountability for company performance.

Seeking moves quickly. Our team is lean, scrappy, ambitious, and highly adaptable. The right person is comfortable making decisions, changing direction when the data requires it, getting into the details, and personally helping solve problems when necessary.

We do not need another layer of management. We need someone capable of building and leading a high-performing marketing organization.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Marketing strategy, performance, and budget**

* Own Seeking's brand marketing strategy, positioning, messaging, audience strategy, and overall brand direction.
* Translate company objectives into quarterly and annual marketing priorities, initiatives, OKRs, budgets, and measurable business outcomes.
* Develop the marketing strategy in close partnership with the Co-CEOs, progressively assuming greater ownership as alignment and trust are established.
* Understand Seeking's distinct audiences and develop strategies capable of effectively reaching both sides of the marketplace.
* Identify untapped audiences, market opportunities, positioning gaps, competitive opportunities, and new ways to grow the business.
* Own consumer research, competitive intelligence, campaign learnings, and brand insights.
* Determine what Seeking should do more of, less of, stop doing, or approach differently based on performance and business priorities.

### **Integrated Campaign Leadership**

* Originate and lead major brand campaigns from initial insight through strategy, concept, execution, launch, measurement, and post-campaign analysis.
* Develop bold, culturally relevant ideas capable of generating conversation, press, signups, and revenue.
* Define the objective, audience, strategic insight, messaging, channels, success metrics, budget, responsibilities, and execution plan for major initiatives.
* Work closely with Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Digital Marketing, Product, Legal, and external partners to bring campaigns to market.
* Personally contribute ideas rather than relying exclusively on the team for campaign concepts.
* Evaluate concepts, scripts, copy, messaging, creative direction, activations, partnerships, and channel plans with strong creative and commercial judgment.
* Lead campaign production, including talent, agencies, production partners, shoots, post-production, rollout, media requirements, legal considerations, and timelines.

### **Performance & Business Accountability**

* Own the performance of the brand marketing organization and ensure marketing activity ultimately contributes to business growth.
* Monitor company and marketing performance closely, including joins, revenue, CAC, ROAS, conversion, brand search, campaign performance, social growth, influencer performance, earned media, and other relevant KPIs.
* Diagnose why initiatives are or are not working and make changes quickly.
* Reallocate budget, resources, priorities, or strategy when performance does not justify the current approach.
* Maximize ROI across productions and activations by identifying opportunities to create additional revenue-driving content within existing budgets, helping recover costs and improve the overall return on each investment.
* Establish meaningful measurement frameworks for brand initiatives that connect marketing activity to commercial outcomes, including brand health.
* Partner closely with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing to understand acquisition and funnel performance and ensure brand and performance marketing strengthen one another.
* Lead campaign and quarterly retrospectives and turn learnings into concrete changes.

### **PR & Cultural Relevance**

* Set the overarching PR narrative and determine what Seeking should be known for culturally.
* Lead and challenge the PR organization on strategy, angles, pitches, media opportunities, reactive opportunities, partnerships, spokesperson positioning, and execution.
* Help develop provocative, differentiated stories that can break through crowded cultural conversations while protecting the business and brand.
* Be comfortable operating around controversial subjects and challenging cultural conversations without becoming unnecessarily risk-averse.
* Understand what makes a story interesting to media rather than simply what the company wants to communicate.
* Be capable of rewriting or strengthening an angle, headline, pitch, talking point, or narrative when senior intervention is required.
* Build and develop a strong internal PR function rather than relying exclusively on agencies to provide strategic thinking.
* Own reputation and crisis communications, partnering with the Co-CEOs and Legal to protect the brand.

### **Team Leadership & Organizational Performance**

* Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable an approximately 13-person brand marketing organization.
* Manage managers and senior individual contributors across Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Copy, Brand Marketing, and related functions.
* Establish clear ownership, expectations, goals, accountability, and decision-making authority across the department.
* Evaluate talent continuously and identify where employees need coaching, clearer expectations, additional resources, changed responsibilities, or stronger performance management.
* Recognize high-potential employees and create opportunities for them to grow.
* Make difficult personnel recommendations when performance does not meet the needs of the business.
* Identify organizational gaps and recommend changes to team structure, roles, hiring plans, agencies, contractors, or external resources.
* Participate meaningfully in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, performance management, and termination decisions.
* Build a culture that combines empathy and development with extremely high standards for performance.

### **Marketing Operations & Planning**

* Own the integrated marketing calendar in partnership with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing.
* Set department priorities and determine what gets worked on, delayed, re-scoped, or stopped.
* Turn large initiatives into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and success metrics.
* Build and continuously improve the operating processes required for a sophisticated marketing organization.
* Establish clear processes for briefs, campaign development, research, creative concepting, moodboards, reviews, approvals, production, PR planning, launch readiness, asset delivery, reporting, and postmortems.
* Ensure teams are brought into initiatives at the right stage rather than operating reactively.
* Remove bottlenecks before they reach the executive team.
* Identify unclear ownership and correct it.
* Ensure initiatives move forward without requiring the Co-CEOs to manage day-to-day execution.

### **Budget & Commercial Management**

* Own and manage a significant seven-figure brand marketing budget.
* Build annual and quarterly budgets and allocate resources against the highest-value opportunities.
* Evaluate spend based on strategic importance and expected business return.
* Maintain visibility into commitments, actual spend, forecasts, and ROI.
* Oversee agencies, production partners, talent, influencers, vendors, sponsorships, and other external relationships.
* Lead or oversee high-stakes negotiations and ensure the team is negotiating effectively.
* Challenge unnecessary spend and identify opportunities to achieve better outcomes with existing resources.

**How This Role Works With Other Marketing Leaders**
----------------------------------------------------

### **Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing**

The Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing and Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing will operate as peer leaders.

This role owns brand strategy, integrated brand campaigns, PR, Creative, Copy, Social, Influencer, brand activations, consumer insights, and the brand marketing budget.

The two leaders jointly plan around company goals, audience strategy, campaign performance, acquisition, landing-page effectiveness, creative performance, the marketing calendar, and overall business growth.

  

**Leadership vs. Delegation**
-----------------------------

The Director creates the environment in which the marketing team can perform at a higher level by setting the strategy, establishing priorities, structuring the work, challenging the thinking, coaching the team, reviewing performance, removing gaps, and holding the organization accountable for results.

At the same time, this is a hands-on leadership role.

When a major campaign needs a stronger concept, a pitch needs to be rewritten, messaging is not working, a brief is unclear, a negotiation is stuck, or an important initiative needs senior attention, this person is expected to get involved and help solve it.

Strong leaders here do not say, "That's not my job."

They also do not take over their employees' jobs.

They know when to coach, when to challenge, when to make the decision, and when to roll up their sleeves.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, with exceptional candidates considered based on demonstrated scope and trajectory rather than years alone.
* 4+ years of meaningful people-management experience, including experience managing managers or senior functional leaders.
* Demonstrated experience across both brand marketing and PR/communications.
* Strong experience developing and executing integrated consumer marketing campaigns.
* Experience in a startup, high-growth environment, agency environment, or similarly fast-moving business, with the ability to operate with a high sense of urgency and keep pace with rapid execution, shifting priorities, and tight deadlines.
* Experience owning or meaningfully managing substantial marketing budgets.
* Experience working with agencies, production companies, creators, talent, vendors, and external partners.
* Working knowledge of campaign production from concept through delivery and distribution.
* Exceptional copy judgment and the ability to provide meaningful feedback across advertising, PR, social, influencer scripts, campaign messaging, and brand communications.
* Strong negotiator with sound commercial judgment.
* Experience creating structure, processes, and accountability inside growing or evolving teams.
* Comfortable making difficult decisions with incomplete information.
* Able to operate effectively with founders and senior executives who are highly engaged in the brand.
* Confident enough to challenge an executive recommendation when the data, customer insight, or strategy supports a different direction.

Marketplace or two-sided consumer platform experience is a plus.

Experience with culturally provocative, unconventional, entertainment, lifestyle, dating, or otherwise conversation-driving brands is highly valued.
