title: DIRECTOR OF CREATIVE PROGRAMMING, PRODUCTION, AND DIGITAL MEDIA
description:
***DIRECTOR OF CREATIVE PROGRAMMING, PRODUCTION, AND DIGITAL MEDIA***

We're Looking for Someone Who Can Make Great Radio Even Better.

American Ground Radio is looking for a highly creative, energetic, funny, and talented individual who understands that a successful national talk radio show should do more than inform its audience.

**It should entertain them. Make them laugh. Surprise them. Keep them listening. And give them something they can't wait to share.**

We're looking for someone who understands the magic of great personality-driven radio.

Someone who appreciates what made shows like The Rush Limbaugh Show so entertaining—not just the opinions and commentary, but the creative production, humorous parodies, unforgettable sound bites, perfectly timed audio elements, and distinctive personality that made the entire broadcast an experience.

American Ground Radio already has its hosts, its content, and a growing national platform including New York City and Washington, DC.

Now we're looking for the creative professional who can help take the entertainment value, production quality, and digital reach of the show to an entirely new level.

**This is not simply a social media position. This is an opportunity to help shape the sound, personality, humor, and creative identity of a growing national radio show.**

***What You'll Be Doing***

1. Make the Show More Entertaining

We want someone who wakes up thinking about creative ways to make radio more engaging.

You'll work directly with AGR's hosts and production team to develop entertaining elements that complement the show's political commentary and discussions.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Creating humorous radio spots, spoofs, parody commercials, and satirical audio segments.
* Developing funny and memorable recurring features that listeners begin to recognize and anticipate.
* Producing entertaining sound bites, musical elements, character voices, and creative transitions.
* Identifying humorous moments in politics, culture, and current events that can be transformed into entertaining radio.
* Developing creative opens, teases, bumpers, and segment introductions.
* Finding ways to make the moments between host segments as entertaining as the segments themselves.
* Helping establish a consistent, instantly recognizable American Ground Radio sound.

**Our goal is simple: When someone tunes into American Ground Radio, we want them to recognize the show immediately—and want to keep listening.**

2. Turn Great Radio Into Great Video

Some of the most entertaining moments on radio deserve a much bigger audience.

Your job will be to find those moments and bring them to life visually.

You'll be responsible for:

* Identifying the most compelling, funny, insightful, and entertaining moments from each broadcast.
* Producing short-form videos for YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and X.
* Editing longer segments for AGR's YouTube channel.
* Creating attention-grabbing video openings, captions, graphics, animations, and visual effects.
* Developing creative promotional videos featuring AGR's hosts.
* Producing humorous video spoofs and original digital comedy segments.
* Creating professional thumbnails, titles, and video descriptions.
* Repurposing the show's best content for different platforms without making it feel repetitive.
* Helping grow AGR's subscribers, followers, video views, and audience engagement.

We don't want someone who simply posts clips.

**We want someone who knows how to turn a good radio moment into a great piece of digital entertainment.**

3. Build the American Ground Radio Brand

The most successful personality-driven radio programs have something in common: They have a recognizable identity.

Their sound, humor, pacing, and creative production are unmistakable.

You'll help build that identity for AGR by:

* Developing signature production elements unique to American Ground Radio.
* Creating recurring comedic characters, themes, audio drops, and humorous features.
* Producing distinctive show opens, promotional spots, and station imaging.
* Creating entertaining promotions for special broadcasts, guest appearances, and programming announcements.
* Maintaining a consistent creative identity across radio, podcasts, YouTube, and social media.
* Helping establish AGR as a recognizable entertainment brand, not simply another political talk program.

4. Manage and Grow Our Social Media Presence

You'll take an active role in developing and executing AGR's social media strategy.

***Responsibilities include:***

* Managing daily content across AGR's social media platforms.
* Creating and maintaining a consistent publishing schedule.
* Producing engaging graphics, videos, promotional materials, and audience-focused posts.
* Identifying emerging trends and creative opportunities.
* Engaging with the audience and helping build a loyal online community.
* Tracking video performance, audience growth, engagement, and subscriber acquisition.
* Testing creative approaches and improving content based on measurable results.
* Working with the hosts to promote special programming, appearances, and broadcasts.

Our goal is not simply to accumulate followers.

**We want to turn social media audiences into loyal listeners, viewers, subscribers, and enthusiastic fans of American Ground Radio.**

***Who We're Looking For***

The ideal candidate is part radio producer, part video editor, part comedian, part creative director, and part digital marketing professional.

You should be someone who:

* Has a natural sense of humor and understands comedic timing.
* Appreciates personality-driven talk radio and understands what makes it entertaining.
* Can recognize a great audio moment and immediately envision how to make it even better.
* Knows how to create memorable spoofs, parody commercials, and humorous production elements.
* Has strong audio-editing and video-production skills.
* Understands how to make short-form videos compelling within the first few seconds.
* Can take an idea from concept to finished production.
* Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment driven by breaking news and current events.
* Understands the difference between being provocative, being funny, and simply being offensive.
* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and takes pride in creating something distinctive.
* Can collaborate closely with hosts while also bringing original ideas to the table.

***Technical Skills***

Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:

* Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.
* Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, Reaper, or comparable audio-production software.
* Adobe Photoshop, After Effects, Canva, or similar graphic and motion-design tools.
* YouTube Studio and social media publishing platforms.
* Audio mixing, sound effects, music editing, voice processing, and broadcast production.
* Short-form video editing, captioning, motion graphics, and digital storytelling.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted creative production tools, with appropriate editorial review.

Experience in commercial radio production, broadcast imaging, comedy writing, political satire, podcast production, or entertainment marketing is especially desirable.

***What Would Make You Stand Out?***

We're particularly interested in candidates who have:

* Produced creative radio imaging or promotional material for a successful talk-radio or morning show.
* Developed humorous parody commercials, satirical features, or recurring comedy segments.
* Created social media videos that generated significant organic engagement.
* Built or helped grow a successful YouTube channel.
* Worked with recognizable radio personalities, podcasters, comedians, or digital creators.
* Demonstrated the ability to combine humor, storytelling, music, and audio effects into memorable entertainment.

A college degree is welcome, but **your creative portfolio and demonstrated ability matter far more to us than your diploma.**

***What Success Looks Like***

Within the first six months, we want this individual to help AGR achieve several important objectives:

* Establish a more distinctive and entertaining sound for the radio show.
* Develop recurring humorous features and signature production elements.
* Create a consistent stream of high-quality short-form videos from daily broadcasts.
* Improve the production quality and presentation of AGR's YouTube content.
* Expand audience engagement and increase digital discovery.
* Develop a recognizable creative style that distinguishes AGR from other political talk programs.
* Build an efficient production process that allows creative content to be developed and published quickly.

***Why This Is an Exciting Opportunity***

This is an opportunity to do more than manage social media accounts or edit videos.

You'll have the chance to work directly with the hosts of a growing national talk-radio program and help shape its creative future.

You'll have the freedom to pitch ideas, develop recurring features, produce original comedy, create distinctive show elements, and bring your creative vision to a national audience.

We want someone who is excited about the challenge of making a good show great—and making a great show unforgettable.

**If you've ever listened to a talk-radio show and thought, "I know exactly how I could make that funnier, more entertaining, and more memorable," we want to hear from you.**

***How to Apply***

Please submit your résumé along with examples of your creative work.

We're especially interested in:

* Humorous radio spots, parody commercials, or satirical audio productions you've created.
* Short-form videos or YouTube content you've produced.
* Radio imaging, show opens, bumpers, or promotional elements.
* Examples of social media accounts or channels you've helped grow.

**Bonus:** Submit a 30–60-second original concept showing us how you would make American Ground Radio more entertaining.

**We aren't just hiring someone to produce content. We're looking for someone who can help create a show people love to listen to—and can't resist sharing.**

American Ground Radio is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance

Work Location: Remote

title: Director of Product Design, Engage
description:
**About Ancestry:**

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.
  
  
We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- ). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.
  
  
Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.
  
  
Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

This role is a rare opportunity to lead design for the heart of Ancestry’s product—the Tree, the Person Page, Merge, and Records—foundational experiences that define how millions of users engage with their family history. As Director of Product Design on the Engage team, you’ll be at the center of our most critical product surfaces, ensuring they work seamlessly together to deliver clarity, connection, and discovery. This is not just about optimizing what already exists; it’s about reimagining how these core experiences evolve as a unified ecosystem. It requires a design leader with a strong product sensibility, a systems-thinking mindset, and the ability to balance craft with scale. You’ll need to advocate across disciplines, align with senior stakeholders, and guide a team through complexity and legacy to deliver elegant, human-centered solutions. For someone who wants to shape the future of our flagship experience—and the legacy of the Ancestry brand—this is that moment.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Lead the design vision and execution for the Research team, ensuring cohesion and delight across the full customer journey.
* Partner across product areas and functions to eliminate friction, fill gaps, and ensure customers experience Ancestry as a rich, connected, and purpose-driven platform.
* Identify and prioritize key moments in the user journey that drive trust, retention, and discovery — and improve them through thoughtful product design and iteration.

* Proven ability to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution with ease.
* Deep understanding of end-to-end customer journey mapping and experience design.
* Experience leading teams focused on onboarding, lifecycle, navigation, and engagement.
* A strong foundation in human-centered design, with the ability to bring clarity to complex or unfamiliar spaces.
* Strong communicator and influencer who can align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision.
* Passionate about creating connected, high-trust experiences that put the user first.

**Why Ancestry?**

Join a dedicated team working to connect millions of people with their past and enrich their futures. At Ancestry, you will play a role in pioneering legal solutions that shape the consumer genomics industry. Your contributions will help foster and protect our workforce that is dedicated to helping our customers tell their own stories, while supporting a brand recognized and trusted around the world. title: Director of Design
description:
About Mendocino Farms
  
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
  
Our Core Values and Mantras
  

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

Director of Design
  
  
**Reports To:** VP, Design & Construction
  
**FLSA Status:** Exempt
  
**Cost Center:** 9511
  
**Location:** Dallas, TX or Remote, USA
  
**Salary Range:** $117,000–$190,000 (Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.)
  
  
Position Summary
  
Mendocino Farms is seeking a Director of Design to lead the evolution and delivery of our restaurant experience across new restaurants, remodels, refreshes, and strategic initiatives.
  
**This leader will own Mendo’s design function:** the restaurant prototype, design standards, internal and external design resources, and the systems that turn brand strategy into distinctive, functional, and scalable restaurants. You will partner closely with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, and Marketing to create environments that strengthen the guest experience while supporting efficient operations, disciplined investment, and growth.
  
This is an opportunity for a creative and operationally minded leader who can set a compelling design point of view, build a high-performing team and consultant network, and make practical decisions that balance quality, durability, speed, cost, and long-term unit performance as Mendocino Farms expands its restaurant footprint.
  
Core Responsibilities
  
Lead the Design Function
  

* Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop internal designers and external design resources; set clear expectations, effective working rhythms, and a high bar for quality and accountability.
* Resource Alignment: Align internal and external design resources to the development pipeline, identifying when specialized expertise is needed.
* Senior Design Leadership: Serve as the senior design leader for complex, high-visibility, or high-risk projects and decisions.

Own the Brand Environment and Design Standards
  

* Prototype & Standards Ownership: Own and evolve Mendo’s restaurant prototype, design standards, material palettes, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, equipment integration, and reusable design details.
* Brand Consistency: Ensure every restaurant delivers a recognizable Mendo experience while adapting appropriately to site conditions, market needs, and business priorities.
* Brand Evolution: Use operating feedback, field learning, and market insight to keep the brand environment relevant, differentiated, and scalable.
* Creative Point of View: Set and elevate Mendo’s creative design point of view, translating brand strategy into memorable, functional restaurant environments that feel distinctive across markets and formats.

Improve Restaurant Operations Through Design
  

* Operational Design Standards: Maintain and evolve design standards that prioritize guest flow, ordering and pickup, digital and delivery activity, seating, accessibility, storage, serviceability, and day-to-day operations.
* Kitchen & BOH Planning: Partner with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, and equipment vendors to improve kitchen planning, back-of-house flow, equipment integration, team ergonomics, throughput, food safety, and maintainability.
* Post-Opening Learning: Incorporate post-opening learning into future layouts, prototypes, and specifications.

Drive Quality, Clarity, and Design Delivery
  

* Design Delivery: Oversee design delivery for new restaurants, remodels, and refresh programs from feasibility test fits and concepts through permit-ready documentation and design-related construction support.
* QA/QC & Phase Gates: Establish practical design QA/QC and phase-gate practices that produce complete, coordinated, code-aware, and timely deliverables.
* Cross-Functional Reviews: Lead cross-functional reviews using clear agendas, advance pre-reads, recommendations, concise decision requests, and thoroughly documented follow-through.
* Stakeholder Direction: Translate stakeholder input into clear direction for internal teams and consultants, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early.
* Constructability: Partner with Construction to protect design intent, improve constructability, and reduce design-related rework, RFIs, and change orders.

Manage Partners and Investment Decisions
  

* Partner Management: Select, brief, manage, and evaluate architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors; set clear expectations for scope, quality, timing, communication, and accountability.
* Value Engineering: Partner with Construction and Real Estate to understand design cost drivers and make value-engineering recommendations.
* Investment Tradeoffs: Balance brand expression, operating performance, durability, cost, schedule, and long-term unit economics in design and specification decisions.
* Performance Tracking: Track design-function performance, capacity, risks, and priorities; use post-project reviews to improve standards, tools, and partner performance.
* Annual Operating Plan: Develop the annual design operating plan in partnership with Real Estate, including internal and consultant capacity, priorities, budget needs, and key risks; provide regular updates on design delivery.

Leadership Competencies
  

* Ownership & Accountability: Sets clear expectations, follows through reliably, and maintains a high bar for quality.
* People Development & Coaching: Builds the capabilities of internal team members and external partners.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Creates alignment across Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, Marketing, and vendors.
* Creative & Operational Judgment: Balances brand expression with functionality, durability, speed, cost, and unit performance.
* Continuous Improvement: Uses field learning, post-project reviews, and market insight to strengthen standards and systems.
* Clear Decision-Making: Communicates concise recommendations, surfaces risks and tradeoffs, and documents follow-through.
* Strategic Execution: Translates brand strategy into scalable prototypes, standards, plans, and restaurant environments.

Qualifications, Education & Experience
  
  
**Required:**  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Environmental Design, Product Design, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in restaurant, retail, hospitality, architecture, interior design, or another related built-environment discipline.
* Leadership: Experience leading a design team, studio, function, or substantial network of external design partners in a fast-moving, multi-project environment.
* Industry Footprint: Significant hands-on experience with restaurant or similarly operationally intensive commercial design, including prototype development, new-unit growth, remodels, and site-specific adaptation.
* Operational Design: Strong command of FOH/BOH flow, kitchen equipment, labor and ergonomics, guest circulation and accessibility, pickup and delivery, food safety, storage, and maintainability.
* Partner Management: Experience managing architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors against quality, schedule, scope, and budget expectations.
* Technical Knowledge: Working knowledge of construction documentation, design QA/QC, permitting, building and health codes, design detailing, accessibility, shop-drawing review, and constructability.
* Financial Acumen: Fluency with design budgets, cost drivers, value engineering, specification tradeoffs, lifecycle durability, and unit economics.
* Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including concise recommendations and executive-ready presentations.
* Travel: Ability to travel occasionally for market visits, project milestones, and team meetings.

**Preferred:**  

* Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Excel, PowerPoint, and project-management platforms.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or Revit and SketchUp.
* Experience scaling design infrastructure during periods of rapid restaurant growth.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS INCLUDE
  

* Competitive Salary, Bonus, and Equity
* Unlimited Meal Privileges
* Health Care & Wellness Benefits
* HSA/FSA
* Pet Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Commuter Benefits
* 401(k) Plan with Company Match
* Unlimited Paid Vacation
* Note: Benefit offerings may differ based on region, position, and employment type.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  

* Must be able to lift 25 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for 6–8 hours.
* Hand use includes single grasping, fine manipulation, pushing, and pulling.
* Work requires bending, twisting, squatting, and reaching.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & FAIR CHANCE EMPLOYMENT STATEMENT
  
Mendocino Farms is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Director of Learning Design
description:
**About Tergar Schools**

Tergar Schools is a Buddhist-inspired K–12 education nonprofit building a new model of learning (MOL). We operate a pilot school in Kathmandu, Nepal, and are constructing a larger campus in the Yolmo Valley in the Himalayas.

Our model rests on a simple starting point: every child possesses basic goodness and its qualities of awareness, love, compassion, wisdom, and joy. It is our job as educators to help them recognize this and give them tools to sustain it. Our long-term aspiration is to help form people who are resilient, altruistic, and joyful.

We’re now building the next chapter of that work: a comprehensive, fully secular model designed to weave into any school’s existing life — not just our own campuses. Rather than build more schools ourselves, we intend to reach 100+ schools in 4+ countries within five years by helping other schools, secular or religious, adopt the model as their own.

**Why This Role Exists**

Our footprint is growing quickly. Two high-performing private schools will begin piloting our model of learning in 2027. A research lab opens in Nepal with a world-class science team. The interest is real and growing.

What we don’t have yet is a full-time position for building the model itself — the products, courses, training materials, and classroom materials that will constitute MOL — and for leading the team that builds it out.

Today that thinking lives mostly with our Executive Director and the instincts of our founding team. This isn’t sustainable at scale. We need someone who can be fully dedicated to this element of our project: an outside-the-box thinker with real contemplative experience, genuinely excited by the challenge of building an entire family of products from scratch rather than adapting an existing portfolio.

**The Opportunity**

This is a builder’s role. You will not inherit a finished product, a proven training program, or a team. You will build those things — starting hands-on, in the room, with our first two outside partner schools — and then lead the team that takes them to scale.

We have materials. However, none of them is a comprehensive, fully secular contemplative model designed to weave into everything a school already does. That is what you would be building, and there is no template for it.

If you are energized by deciding who you need around you rather than inheriting an org chart, and comfortable being personally in the work now so that later you can hand it to people you have trained this is the position for you. .

**What You’ll Own**

**Building the model**

* Design the teacher training program at the center of the MOL — the core product.
* Build out the materials that make the training usable in a real school. Today we imagine adaptable toolkits fitted by hand to each school, a playbook for staff and administrators, and family-facing materials. That is a starting hypothesis, not a spec — the process of choosing what comes is yours to lead.
* Run the model as a product, not a document. Form real hypotheses about what teachers and schools need, test them in live classrooms, and let what you learn change what gets built.
* Propose what gets built now and what waits — and defend those calls. We hold two commitments at once: build lean, and be the best in the world at this. We call it *Minimum Viable Mastery*. You are the person who makes that real week to week, not just in principle.

**Nailing the first schools**

* Be personally hands-on with our new partner schools in Nepal as they begin onboarding in 2027. You will do this work in tandem with the Executive Director (ED).
* Use what you learn there to define what a stable first phase actually looks like, and build the real template other schools will follow.

**Building your team**

* Decide what team you need, and in what order — a Nepal Country Director and Trainer, Country Coordinators, strategic consultants, instructional designers, a UX researcher, and others as the shape of the work becomes clear (a Head of Training in Nepal is currently being hired).
* The ED and the Director of Operations (DOO) authorize and execute the actual hiring. The judgment about who and when is yours.

**Setting the standard, over time**

* Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche and the ED hold final say on model fidelity today. As you build a track record — likely marked by a completed first onboarding cycle with our two partner schools — that authority shifts substantively to you.
* Turn Rinpoche’s two to four multi-day sessions a year into material the team can use again: recorded, distilled, built into training, rather than a remarkable conversation nobody can revisit.

**Working with the evidence**

* Partner with the research lab opening in Nepal in late 2026 — led by Drs. Richard Davidson, Robert Roeser, and Robin Nusslock — translating what they learn into real product and training decisions.

  

**What’s Yours, and What Isn’t**

You own the model and the team you build around you. Three things sit outside that:

* **Fundraising and donor relationships.** A separate role entirely.
* **In-country adaptation and community relationships.** Local teams own this on the ground, but you liaise with them directly and are in very frequent communication.
* **Hiring mechanics.** You decide who you need and when; the DOO handles offers, contracts, and process.

One thing sits in between: **production**. Instructional designers, visual designers, and media support will eventually build finished materials from your direction. You will not be making them yourself for long — but their quality is still on you.

**Who You Are**

**What we’re really looking for**

* **A builder grounded in pedagogy.** Deep pedagogical expertise is essential — you understand how children and adults actually learn, and you've designed for it. What sets you apart is that you build and deliver: you've turned that expertise into programs, curricula, or training that real teachers use. A tech or startup background alongside that is a genuine asset.
* **Fluency in a lean approach to product design.** You can talk concretely about strategic experiments, problem/solution and product/market fit, and validated learning — and you have actually worked that way, not just read about it.
* **Real, lived contemplative experience.** A genuine taste of practice, not necessarily in Tergar’s own lineage, and not merely theoretical familiarity. This is the one non-negotiable that doesn’t bend for the right resume.
* **Comfortable being hands-on first and stepping back later.** Personally in the work with our first schools, then deliberately building the standards and training that let a team carry it without you in the room.
* **Able to build lean and aim to be the best in the world at the same time,** without treating those as a trade-off.

**Experience**

* You bring substantial experience in education — as a teacher, school leader, curriculum developer, or learning designer — and you've built something real from that experience and gotten it into people's hands without much money or staff.
* Some experience directing, mentoring, or building a team from scratch, since you will be doing exactly that here.
* Comfort working directly from a founder’s evolving vision rather than a finished brief — you will be co-writing the brief as you go, especially in the first months.

**Personal qualities**

* Discernment above all: knowing which calls are yours to make outright and which need to go to the Rinpoche or the ED. This carries more weight here than almost any other quality, because for a long stretch there is no layer of management between your judgment and the model’s integrity.
* Genuine curiosity about and respect for a tradition that may not be your own, without needing to adopt it as your own practice.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a mandate that will keep changing shape under you as the first schools teach you things no one currently knows.

  

**How We Work Together**

* Intensive, hands-on time in Nepal during onboarding and the first deployment of the model. Expect three to five months during the first year.
* Frequent, close contact with the ED for the first six months, settling into a slower rhythm as trust builds.
* Two to four multi-day sessions a year with Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche, alongside the wider team.
* A small, distributed, high-autonomy culture across Vermont, Wisconsin, Ireland, Kathmandu, and Minnesota — deep, steady, skillful work over speed.

  

**Compensation & Logistics**

* Full-time
* Fully remote.
* Compensation: $75,000–$100,000, DOE
* Benefits: flexible schedule, unlimited PTO, and health care reimbursement up to $1,000 per month

title: Paid Media Director-Programmatic
description:
**Paid Media Director - Programmatic**

**Location:** Atlanta, GA

**Department:** Paid Media

**Who We Are**

Acadia is a trusted digital growth agency for mid-market disrupters. We help brands out-flank their competition through paid media, retail media and marketplaces, analytics, SEO and CRO, and content and creative services. Headquartered in Atlanta with a team across the globe, we’re a tight-knit and fast-growing team of marketing strategists and analysts, driven to make a real impact for our clients and communities.

**About the Job**

Acadia is looking for a highly proficient collaborator, motivator, and thought leader to serve as the senior leader of the Paid Media department.

Reporting directly to the Head of Paid Media, this position plays a pivotal role in shaping the broader agency offering, working alongside various departments including Integrated Media, Influencer Marketing, Organic Social, SEO, CRO, Analytics, Account Management, and Retail Media.

You will lead the execution of the paid media department’s strategic direction across all accounts and verticals, own the department’s budget and operational structure, manage and develop the Associate Director and Sr Manager leadership team, and represent the agency’s paid media expertise in new business pitches and senior client engagements. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning paid search, social, and programmatic strategy and execution end-to-end, excels at optimizing internal operational efficiency, and is skilled at developing senior talent.

**Responsibilities**

*Note: Items below referring to broad ownership should be interpreted as the director group’s collective responsibility to own team strategic direction. Individual levels of ownership for overarching items will vary based on expertise, interest, and workload.*

* Lead execution of the paid media department’s strategic direction across all accounts and verticals, ensuring account strategies ladder up to agency positioning
* Partner with BU leadership to pressure-test strategic direction and flag emerging opportunities and risks
* Own the department’s budget allocation across teams, tools, and resources, and report financial performance and resource utilization to BU leadership

* Own reporting standards and BI infrastructure across the department, and drive adoption of advanced analytics techniques such as MMM and incrementality

* Own the operational structure and day-to-day workflow of the paid media department, and resolve cross-departmental friction points
* Own AI adoption outcomes and cultural accountability across the department, and embed AI skill criteria into hiring and performance reviews

* Decide when an engagement warrants ad serving at all, weighing ad serving and ad ops fees against the measurement value returned
* Keep the workflow connected end-to-end across Ad Ops, Analytics, Creative, and Dashboarding, ensuring Ad Ops runs as a defined process rather than a catch-all for cross-team logistics
* Represent Acadia’s programmatic capability and supply-chain transparency in new business pitches and senior client conversations

**Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* 12-15 years of experience in paid media advertising
* 8+ years of team management experience, including leading managers or team leads overseeing onshore and offshore employees
* Proven track record of driving performance results and leading teams through complex challenges
* Track record of building and developing high-performing paid media teams
* Highly persuasive presenter, comfortable in C-level client environments and new business pitches
* Deep hands-on experience buying programmatically through Google Marketing Platform (DV360, CM360) and other DSPs, and managing DSP or trading partner relationships

**Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Expert Microsoft Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPS/XLOOKUPS, SUMIFS, and chart building
* Experience in Google Suite
* Strong executive communication skills; comfortable presenting to C-suite client stakeholders
* Skilled at translating leadership vision into team structure, process, and accountability
* Demonstrated track record of developing senior talent and building department-level capabilities

**What we offer – The Perks**

* 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave to welcome and bond with your growing family
* Solid health benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance)

* Opportunity for growth that is second to none in the industry

**Here’s how we live our values at Acadia**

title: Associate Resource Director, Creative
description:
**NVE** is a brand experience and production agency dedicated to building ideas rooted in culture and guided by the principle that 'The Right Moment Will Transform Someone Forever.' NVE's team of creatives, strategists and producers develop insight-driven ideas rooted in culture to convert consumer attention into commitment, action, and brand loyalty.

**Summary of Position:**

The Associate Director of Creative Resource Management is a senior, hands-on leader within NVE's centralized resourcing team, responsible for overseeing strategy and execution exclusively for the Creative department. This role bridges high-level workforce planning with day-to-day staffing decisions, ensuring creative teams (including visual designers, spatial/environmental designers, copywriters, art directors, 3D visualizers, and creative directors) are thoughtfully cast, sustainably balanced, and aligned with both business goals and human needs.

Reporting to the VP, Resource Director with a dotted line to Creative Leadership, this role partners closely with Creative Leadership, Accounts, Strategy, Production, and Finance to translate pipeline and forecasts into actionable staffing plans.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who deeply understands the nuances of the creative process in experiential marketing, operates confidently in ambiguity, and brings both rigor and empathy to resourcing decisions.

**Success in This Role Looks Like:**

* Creative resourcing runs smoothly, consistently, and proactively across all agency creative projects
* Creative team members achieve target utilization, billability, and balanced workloads across experiential, branding, and strategic design initiatives
* Leadership has clear visibility into Creative capacity, utilization, skill set alignment, and upcoming bandwidth risks
* Creative team members feel supported, guided, intentionally cast, and aligned in how staffing decisions are made
* Resourcing is trusted as a strategic partner by Creative leadership, ensuring the right creative talent is matched to the right briefs based on expertise, passion, and availability.
* The ability to balance people-first decision-making with creative excellence and financial realities

**Role Priorities:**

Creative Resourcing Leadership & Strategy

* Own the resourcing strategy for the Creative department, translating agency-wide resourcing frameworks into department-specific execution
* Serve as the primary resourcing partner to Creative leadership, maintaining a deep understanding of team structures, individual skill sets, portfolios, and delivery realities
* Act as the primary escalation point for creative staffing challenges, competing project priorities, and high-impact casting decisions
* Evaluate incoming briefs and project workloads to assign incoming jobs to design and creative resources in collaboration with department management
* Contribute to the development of centralized resourcing best practices and optimization of resourcing systems

Forecasting & Workforce Planning

* Partner with the VP, Resource Director, Creative Leadership, and Finance to build and maintain Creative-specific capacity forecasts
* Identify upcoming gaps, bottlenecks, or overages in creative bandwidth and proactively recommend solutions (rebalancing, freelance support, hiring)
* Support scenario planning for new business pitches, large-scale experiential programs, retainers, and seasonal spikes in creative demand

Operational Excellence

* Maintain accurate, real-time Creative resourcing data and visibility within centralized resourcing systems
* Ensure resourcing standards, processes, and cadences (intake, casting, forecasting) are applied consistently across the Creative department
* Partner with Finance to ensure staffing decisions align with project budgets, scopes, and margin targets
* Track and report on creative utilization, capacity, and resourcing health to inform executive decision-making

Freelance & External Talent Strategy

* Oversee freelance strategy and usage within Creative, ensuring the right balance of full-time employees and external support
* Maintain a robust, diverse, and high-performing bench of freelance creative talent (designers, copywriters, 3D artists, art directors, specialized agencies)
* Conduct proactive outreach to foster relationships with external talent and grow the freelance bench based on forecasted skill set needs
* Oversee freelance onboarding, compliance, rate alignment, and timesheet management in partnership with finance and talent operations

Culture, Wellbeing & Talent Development

* Champion a human-first approach to Creative resourcing, balancing project delivery urgency with sustainable workloads to prevent burnout
* Partner with Creative leadership to align staffing decisions with team members' career development pathways and skill growth goals
* Promote inclusive, equitable casting practices across all Creative department projects

**Requirements:**

* 5–8+ years of experience in creative resourcing, resource management, traffic management, or creative operations within an experiential marketing agency or creative agency
* Deep understanding of the end-to-end creative process across visual design, environmental/spatial design, pitch development, branding, and copywriting
* Proven ability to manage complex staffing dynamics, balance competing priorities, and partner effectively with senior executive and creative leaders
* Proficiency in resource management and project management software
* Strong financial acumen regarding project margins, utilization metrics, and freelance budget management
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills, combining operational rigor with empathy

**Location****:**We are a hybrid company with hub locations in Los Angeles and New York City. The ideal candidate is located in either of our hub locations, however, we will consider remote candidates for this role.

**Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging:**

At NVE, we are led by curiosity and fueled by humanity. Authentic connection is at the heart of our work and we embrace the opportunity and responsibility we have as an organization to provide the tools and resources needed to deliver the best and most equitable experiences possible for our employees and the clients we serve.

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Health & Wellness Benefits
* 401k Match
* Communication Stipend
* Paid Company holidays & PTO Package
* Company get togethers & retreats
* Paid Parental Leave
* Flexible WFH policy

**Salary Estimation:** **[$100,000.00-$125,000.00 per year]**

This is an Exempt full-time role. NVE intends to provide a competitive total compensation package which includes a variety of incentives, benefits, growth and developmental opportunities. There are many factors to the presented salary range, including but not limited to - location, departmental budgets, certifications, and overall job-related qualifications.

**Employment eligibility verification is required for this role. In certain states, NVE participates in the E-Verify program in accordance with local regulations.**  
*Applicable states: Utah, Arizona, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, Alabama, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Florida.*

title: Vice President, Brand and Creative
description:
**VP, Brand & Creative**

$230,000–$250,000 base + bonus · Remote · Reports to Chief Customer Officer

*You'll own the creative soul of LaserAway — setting the brand vision, leading the team that brings it to life, and building the systems that let a high-growth company stay visually and strategically sharp at scale.*

**About LaserAway**

LaserAway is the nation's leader in aesthetic dermatology — PE-backed, founder-influenced, and operating 200+ clinics nationwide with aggressive expansion ahead. The brand sits at the intersection of medical credibility and aspirational beauty, and this role exists to make sure it stays there as we scale. This is not a maintenance role. The creative infrastructure, the team, and the brand expression all have room to grow — and the mandate to do it.

**What You'll Own**

The full creative and brand function — visual identity, campaign concepting, content production, influencer partnerships, and PR — plus the team, the systems, and the cross-functional relationships that make all of it run.

Day-to-day: setting creative direction across paid, organic, social, and partner channels; leading a team of designers, copywriters, and production staff plus an influencer manager; overseeing agency relationships; driving PR strategy including press, store openings, and local partnerships; and collaborating with marketing ops and technology to ensure digital touchpoints are on-brand and conversion-focused. You'll also own the process — content calendars, workflow systems, brand guidelines — so the team scales without losing quality.

**Why This Role Is Different**

LaserAway has earned its market position through a distinctive brand — one that feels premium without being inaccessible, clinical without being cold. The next chapter requires someone who has navigated exactly this kind of inflection point: a founder-influenced culture moving through PE-backed high growth, where the brand must evolve without losing what made it work. If you've done this before — maintained creative integrity while building the infrastructure to operate at scale — this is the role for you.

**Who Thrives Here**

* **7+ years in creative leadership** in beauty, wellness, aesthetics, or an adjacent lifestyle category — with a portfolio that shows a clear, distinctive point of view
* **Experience in founder-led, PE-backed environments through high-growth scale** — you know how to move fast, earn trust quickly, and build systems without bureaucracy
* Equally strong as a creative director and an operator — you can concept a campaign and build the workflow system that gets it produced on time
* Track record with influencer strategy and PR, not just awareness — you understand how these functions drive measurable brand and business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting to executive leadership and cross-functional partners — you can articulate creative rationale in business terms
* Travel flexibility for clinic visits, production, and leadership meetings as needed

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **$230,000–$250,000 annual base salary + performance bonus**
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Employee discounts on treatments and products

**Why Now**

* LaserAway is in active expansion — new markets, new clinic openings, and a brand that needs to scale without diluting
* The creative function has a strong foundation — this role is about elevating and systematizing it, not starting from scratch
* Direct seat at the table with the Chief Customer Officer and visibility to the executive team from day one

*LaserAway is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace and will provide reasonable accommodations as required by law.*

**Benefits Summary:**

*LaserAway provides competitive compensation packages and a comprehensive range of benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability and Life Insurance, a 401(k) plan with a company match, and additional ancillary benefits. We also offer Paid Time Off (PTO) in compliance with state and federal requirements, ensuring our employees are supported both professionally and personally. LaserAway also provides incentive compensation, including potential bonuses and commissions, depending on role and performance.*

title: Executive Business Partner to the CEO
description:
**About OptimizeRx**

OptimizeRx is a leading healthcare technology company that’s redefining how life science brands connect with patients and healthcare providers. Our platform combines innovative AI-driven tools to deliver timely, relevant, and privacy-safe engagement. By bridging the gap between HCP and DTC strategies, we empower brands to create synchronized marketing solutions that drive faster treatment decisions and improved patient outcomes.

**Job Title:** Executive Business Partner  
**Reports to:** Chief Executive Officer  
**Location:** Remote  
**Job Type:** Full-time

**Position Summary:**

The Executive Business Partner serves as a trusted resource to the Chief Executive Officer, providing high-level support across day-to-day priorities, commitments, meetings, communications, and travel.

This role goes well beyond traditional calendar management and administrative support. The Executive Business Partner is expected to stay ahead of the CEO’s needs, manage competing priorities, track commitments and follow-up items, and ensure important actions do not get missed as priorities shift.

The ideal candidate is highly polished, exceptionally detail-oriented, proactive, and able to operate effectively in a dynamic executive environment. They must be able to quickly understand what is important/needs to be prioritized, exercise sound judgment, communicate confidently with senior leaders, the Board of Directors, and external stakeholders, and bring a high level of organization and follow-through to the CEO’s day-to-day responsibilities.

This person will have significant visibility across the organization and must be someone the CEO can rely on completely to manage sensitive and confidential information.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the CEO’s primary administrative and organizational partner by helping manage his time, priorities, commitments, and day-to-day responsibilities.
* Proactively manage a complex and frequently changing calendar; Use sound judgment to prioritize meetings, resolve scheduling conflicts, protect focus time, and ensure the CEO’s schedule reflects the company’s most important priorities.
* Maintain a clear understanding of the CEO’s commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items arising from leadership meetings, client conversations, Board discussions, and other interactions.
* Capture key action items and commitments made by the CEO during meetings and proactively follow up with him and others to ensure they are completed by deadlines.
* Keep the CEO informed of outstanding items, approaching deadlines, required decisions, and issues requiring his attention.
* Prepare the CEO for meetings by ensuring he has the appropriate agenda, background information, materials, context, and prior follow-up items in advance.
* Anticipate upcoming needs and identify potential scheduling, communication, or follow-through issues before they become problems.
* Act as a trusted point of contact between the CEO and members of the Executive Leadership Team, Board members, employees, clients, investors, partners, and other external stakeholders.
* Serve as a point of coordination for the CEO’s interactions with investors, equity research analysts, and other public-company stakeholders, ensuring meetings, communications, materials, and follow-up items are managed professionally and efficiently.
* Support the CEO’s preparation for investor and analyst engagements by coordinating schedules, organizing relevant background materials and briefing information, tracking follow-up commitments, and partnering closely with Finance and Investor Relations as appropriate.
* Manage incoming requests for the CEO’s time and attention by determining urgency and prioritizing important matters as they align with Company goals and strategy.[MA1]
* Draft, review, organize, and coordinate correspondence, presentations, reports, meeting materials, agendas, and other documents on behalf of the CEO.
* Coordinate and support CEO-led leadership meetings, including agenda development, preparation of materials, documentation of decisions and action items, and follow-up.
* Manage all aspects of the CEO’s business travel, including detailed itineraries, transportation, accommodations, meeting logistics, and last-minute changes.
* Manage and reconcile the CEO’s business expenses accurately and on time.
* Maintain highly confidential and sensitive business, personnel, financial, and organizational information with exceptional discretion.
* Develop effective systems for organizing information, tracking open items, managing deadlines, and ensuring commitments are followed through to completion.
* Identify opportunities to make the CEO’s time and workflows more efficient and implement practical solutions without requiring significant direction.
* Step in to resolve logistical or administrative issues independently whenever appropriate, escalating only when the CEO’s involvement is necessary.
* Provide limited support to other members of the Executive Leadership Team when needed and when aligned with the CEO’s priorities.
* Handle special projects and other responsibilities on behalf of the CEO as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 8+ years of progressively responsible executive support experience, with significant experience directly supporting a CEO, President, C-suite executive strongly preferred.
* Extensive experience managing a highly complex executive calendar and balancing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional organizational skills and an unusually high level of attention to detail.
* Proven ability to track numerous commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items simultaneously without losing sight of details.
* Highly proactive approach with the ability to anticipate needs, identify issues, and take action without waiting for direction.
* Strong judgment and the ability to understand when to act independently, when to seek input, and when an issue requires immediate escalation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with senior executives, Board members, clients, investors, and other external stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal skills and executive presence, with the ability to represent the CEO and the company professionally in all interactions.
* Exceptional discretion and experience handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Ability to understand business priorities and use that context when managing the CEO’s time, meetings, communications, and commitments.
* Ability to remain composed, organized, and responsive when priorities change quickly or unexpected issues arise.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and other productivity and collaboration tools.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to take ownership of matters through completion.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

OptimizeRx is an equal opportunity employer. The Company maintains policies and practices that are designed to prevent discrimination or harassment against any qualified applicant or employee to the extent prohibited by federal, state, and local laws and regulations. By way of example, discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), age, marital status, sexual orientation physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information (including test results), status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran, uniform service member status, political affiliation, union membership, gender identity or gender expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law is prohibited.

**Note:**

*This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments.*

title: Director of Customer Experience Operations
description:
**About Assembly Software**

Assembly Software is a visionary technology company dedicated to revolutionizing the legal industry. It blends decades of history and industry experience with next-generation, customer-focused innovation, bringing together two of the legal profession’s pioneering case management brands, Needles and Trialworks, both of which have contributed to Neos, Assembly's reimagined cloud-based solution. With its premier case management solution, Neos, and the game-changing NeosAI, Assembly Software empowers law firms to exceed expectations and maximize their potential through innovative software solutions.

Assembly's Neos is a cloud-based practice management software with embedded AI that combines customizable workflows, seamless integrations, and powerful analytics. Neos empowers law firms to streamline their operations, enhance productivity, and manage all aspects of their practice. In addition, NeosAI seamlessly integrates within Neos, empowering users to leverage AI capabilities without needing to switch between different platforms

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned-up industry.

**Vision Statement**

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

**Mission Statement**

Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

**Core Values**

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency + feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth + learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions + work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative + open-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer + our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service + add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity + Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.

Implementation hands a customer off to Support. Support hands them off to Success. Somewhere in those handoffs, context gets lost, and by the time anyone notices, the customer is already frustrated. We're looking for someone who looks at that mess and can't help but want to fix it.

As the **Director of Customer Experience Operations,** you are a builder, not a spectator. You'll sit on our Chief Customer Officer's leadership team and build the operational backbone connecting Implementation, Support, Success, and Enablement into one coherent Customer Experience Group: the KPIs everyone actually trusts, the playbooks that make good practices repeatable, and the systems that keep our data clean enough to make real decisions on.

You won't have a team of your own, and that's by design. Your job is to make the people who do run cleaner, faster, and more consistent, not to build something underneath you. If what energizes you is bringing order and rigor to a fast-growing customer organization that's still finding its shape, this is exactly that job.

If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

**When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:**

**1. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  
Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

**2. What makes Assembly Software different?**  
Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

**3. What's the benefits package like?**  
Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program

We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

*Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

title: Director, Patient and Brand Marketing
description:
**Location**
------------

Remote

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**
--------------

All Cost CentersSales & MarketingBrand Marketing & CommunicationsPatient & Brand Marketing

**Compensation**
----------------

* $212K – $265K • Offers Equity

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

  

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 85,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for our first Director of Patient & Brand Marketing to join Headway at a pivotal time for our company. In this role, you will lead a team responsible for making Headway the #1 place people turn when they need great mental healthcare built around their unique needs. You will report to the Head of Brand, PMM & Communications and your team’s work will span product marketing and brand marketing including media partnerships and creative strategy.

As Director, Patient & Brand Marketing, you'll own the levers that matter most in building a brand people trust and love. You'll shape the products and experiences that make patients feel seen and heard, define the creative strategies that set Headway apart from everyone else in the market, and decide where and how we show up so that our message breaks through and drives real results.

You'll be accountable for building long-term brand awareness and trust while also driving efficient patient growth, so you'll need to be just as comfortable talking about the cultural relevance and media reach & frequency required to break through the clutter as you are about the testing frameworks and data that proves the work is working to get more patients into great care.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

In this role you’re expected to operate as a player, coach, hiring, leading and working alongside an exceptional team responsible for:

**Product Marketing:** Bringing best-in-class consumer product experiences to market for the patients on our platform. You'll develop a deep understanding of what people believe, fear, and need at every step of their mental healthcare journey, from first intake through their last session, and translate that into what has to be true in our products, experiences, and messaging to move them forward.

**Brand Media & Partnerships:** Determining where we show up when we tell our story. Plan 360 advertising campaigns, influencer marketing campaigns, brand partnerships, activations and experiences that capture attention and drive the brand and business outcomes we're aiming for. You’ll be responsible for planning media campaigns that drive intended business results, managing large budgets, testing & optimizing spend and channel mix to maximize impact.

**Brand Strategy**: Shaping the products, content, and experiences we build and ship so Headway shows up as distinct and differentiated in the market, while driving commercial value. You'll drive the strategy behind what makes for work that is compelling, memorable and something only Headway could deliver.

**Measure What Matters:** Owning brand and patient marketing outcomes that ladder up to company growth goals, including brand awareness, brand perception, funnel conversion (from intake to booking to first appointment), acquisition efficiency, and experimentation velocity and win rate. As a result, you’re fluent in A/B testing, incrementality testing, brand trackers, media mix and attribution modeling.

**Build and Lead the Team** Attract, develop, and retain high-performing marketers who do the best work of their careers under your leadership.

  

**Background That Will Set You Up for Success**
-----------------------------------------------

* Experience across brand marketing, product marketing, and integrated marketing, ideally a blend of all three.
* At least 3 years of hands-on media experience. You understand media math and know how to optimize campaigns to drive business goals; your background isn't exclusively on the creative side.
* Experience leading or partnering closely with product marketing teams, with a clear point of view on how brand and product marketing work best together.
* Driving brand strategy, creative and partnerships for products or services in highly competitive, regulated categories, where cultural relevance and a strong POV was required to stand out.
* 15+ years of marketing experience, mix of agency and in-house, working at best-in-class consumer tech brands, multi-sided marketplaces a plus.

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.

Headway participates in E-Verify.

A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

title: Senior Content Marketing Specialist
description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

Zipliens has grown through referrals and relationships. Now we're building a content engine that earns attention beyond them. As our Senior Content Specialist, you'll be an early member of a small, growing marketing team, reporting to the Director of Marketing and working side by side with product marketing, events, marketing operations, and design.

You'll drive how Zipliens shows up in search engines (SERPs and AI platforms) and in the resources law firms rely on: our SEO strategy and baseline, website content, the LinkedIn content calendar, blog posts, customer newsletters, and case studies. Lien resolution is technical (Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation), and your job is to turn that complexity into content that paralegals, case managers, and attorneys actually find, use, and trust.

You'll thrive here if you love both the craft of a sharp draft and the discipline of keyword research and performance data, enjoy pulling insight out of subject-matter experts, solving industry pain points through creative mediums, and want to build a content program from the ground up. The role is primarily hands-on writing and execution, with growing ownership of strategy and planning as the program grows.

 **Requirements**  
Responsibilities:

**Build the SEO and content strategy**

* Establish an organic search baseline (traffic, impressions, rankings, branded vs. non-branded performance, top landing pages, backlinks, and technical health) before optimizing.
* Partner with internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop and execute the keyword and topic strategy across lien resolution, Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation, settlement administration, and personal injury firm operations, balancing high-intent commercial terms with educational and long-tail searches.
* Build and maintain the editorial/blog calendar, aligned to our ideal customer profile, product launches, and events.
* Partner with marketing operations to connect organic visibility to qualified traffic, leads, and pipeline rather than traffic volume alone.

**Create content that earns trust**

* Write and edit blog posts, guides, checklists, templates, FAQs, and reports that help personal injury law firm teams solve real lien resolution problems.
* Partner with lien resolution SMEs, Customer Success, and company leadership to turn operational and regulatory knowledge into accurate, practical content.
* Use Voice of the Customer (VOC) insights to develop customer case studies and spotlights that put proof behind our positioning, working with Product Marketing and Customer Success.
* Support executive and employee thought leadership, including LinkedIn posts, bylines, and speaking abstracts.
* Turn each strong source asset into multiple formats across channels.

**Own website content and marketing collateral**

* Manage Zipliens’ public-facing resource center, partnering with subject matter experts to develop and publish content such as eBooks, whitepapers, case studies, infographics, etc.
* Write and optimize website content, including service pages, landing pages, and metadata, in partnership with Product Marketing and Design.
* Run on-page SEO/AEO and regular content refreshes, updating or consolidating underperforming pages.
* Partner with marketing operations on calls to action, forms, and conversion paths so content connects to Sales.

**Run channels and customer communications**

* Manage the LinkedIn content calendar, balancing core themes/pillars: thought leadership, brand awareness, campaign messaging, customer outcomes, employee advocacy, and event promotion.
* Write and edit customer newsletter, nurture, and release-announcement copy, partnering with Customer Success, Product Marketing, and the team member building campaigns in HubSpot.
* Create event content with the Events Manager, including pre-event promotion, session and speaker content, and post-event recaps.
* Report on content performance regularly and recommend what to scale, update, or stop.

Qualifications:

Required

* 5+ years in content marketing, SEO, or B2B content strategy, with a portfolio of published work.
* Experience supporting organic traffic growth through SEO-driven content, and a solid understanding of how SEO strategy translates into rankings and conversions.
* Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate technical or regulated topics into clear, accurate content.
* Experience interviewing subject-matter experts and turning their input into finished content.
* Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, drafting, and repurposing while maintaining accuracy and brand voice.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and build process in a small team.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with SEO and analytics tools (e.g., Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, or Ahrefs) and a CMS.
* Experience in legal, legal tech, insurance, healthcare, or other complex or regulated B2B topics; familiarity with personal injury or lien resolution is a plus.
* Experience with HubSpot (CMS, email, and reporting).
* Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for team meetings, offsites, and select events.

  
**Benefits**  

* Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants
* Flexible Spending Accounts (Health & Dependent Care)
* Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Coverage
* Voluntary Long-Term Disability, Life, AD&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options
* 401(k) Plan with Company Match
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time & 10 paid Holidays)
