title: Retention & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
**About Onnit:**

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

**JOB SUMMARY**

We're looking for an analytical, hands-on lifecycle marketer to own email, SMS, and customer retention, with a particular focus on subscription growth and churn reduction. You'll execute the strategy and work in Klaviyo, from creating content blocks and building campaigns to launching flows, refining segments, and analyzing results. Use customer behavior, cohort performance, and lifetime value insights to decide what to send, to whom, and when.

This role combines strategic ownership with end-to-end execution. You're someone who enjoys being "in the weeds", turning ideas into live campaigns, managing day-to-day production, and using results to shape your next move. This is an opportunity to own the full lifecycle marketing process and see the impact of your work on customer relationships and business growth.

This role is designed for someone with roughly 5 years of relevant experience who wants meaningful ownership while staying close to the work.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Email and SMS strategy and execution

* Own the email and SMS calendar, balancing promotional campaigns with customer education, replenishment, subscription conversion, and retention messaging.
* Personally build, QA, schedule, and launch campaigns and automated flows in Klaviyo.
* Create, maintain, and manage reusable content blocks and templates; assemble and format messages for launch.
* Build and refine customer segments using purchase behavior, subscription status, engagement, lifecycle stage, and cohort insights.
* Develop and optimize journeys such as welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, subscription onboarding, cancellation prevention, and winback.
* Run practical tests across messaging, offers, creative, timing, frequency, and audience selection, then apply what you learn.
* Maintain strong execution standards across mobile rendering, links, personalization, deliverability, and consent practices.

Subscription Growth and Churn Reduction

* Execute lifecycle marketing initiatives that convert one-time purchasers into subscribers and help existing subscribers stay engaged.
* Identify which customers are most likely to benefit from subscription and develop relevant messages, offers, and conversion journeys.
* Analyze subscription churn, cancellation patterns, and customer behavior to identify opportunities to improve retention.
* Build and test onboarding, education, replenishment, save, and reactivation initiatives that address those opportunities.
* Bring customer insights to product, brand, and customer-experience partners to help strengthen the overall subscriber experience.

Lifecycle Strategy and Practical Analytics

* Develop lifecycle and cohort strategies that reflect how different customers discover, buy, return, subscribe, and lapse.
* Analyze cohort retention, repeat purchase, customer lifetime value (LTV), subscription conversion, and churn to prioritize the highest-impact work.
* Own recurring lifecycle performance reporting, connecting campaign and flow results to broader retention and subscription outcomes.
* Translate analysis into clear recommendations, a prioritized testing plan, and hands-on execution.
* Distinguish channel-attributed results from broader customer trends and use practical testing to assess what is working.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner directly with the Director of E-commerce and Retention on broader retention strategy, priorities, and performance reviews.
* Coordinate with creative, product, customer experience, and acquisition partners as needed to keep lifecycle messaging accurate and relevant.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5 + years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, or email/SMS marketing, ideally for CPG subscription business.
* Strong, recent, hands-on Klaviyo experience: you can independently build campaigns and flows, manage content blocks, create segments, run tests, and report on performance.

* Experience improving repeat purchase, subscription conversion, subscriber retention, or churn, with concrete examples of work you personally executed.

title: Donor Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Remote)
description:
**Main areas of focus:** Donor Retention, Recurring Giving, Upgrades & Additional Gifts, Multichannel Marketing

**Location:** Remote - U.S. only; Nashville preferred

**Eligibility:** At this time, we are only considering candidates who are eligible to work in the United States without the need of company sponsorship now or in the future.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As Donor Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you'll own the donor journey after the first gift and be responsible for growing the lifetime value of charity: water's consumer donor base. You'll spend most of your time designing, launching, and optimizing multichannel lifecycle programs across email, SMS, paid media, and direct mail, including onboarding and welcome journeys, stewardship and impact touchpoints, failed-payment recovery, upgrade asks, and additional-gift campaigns. You'll treat retention as both a science and a craft: segmenting donors thoughtfully, testing relentlessly, and making sure every message feels personal and meaningful.

This role sits on the Marketing & Growth team and reports to the Director of Consumer. You'll work closely with the Creative, Partnerships, Social, and RevOps teams to hit retention and revenue goals.

**YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR…**
------------------------------

* Owning retention, upgrade, and additional-gift strategy for charity: water's recurring (The Spring) and one-time donors, with clear accountability for retention rate, average gift, upgrade rate, and donor lifetime value
* Building and managing automated lifecycle journeys, including welcome and onboarding series, anniversary and milestone moments, impact updates, lapse prevention, and win-back programs
* Planning and executing multichannel campaigns across email, SMS, paid social and search retargeting, and direct mail, making sure each channel plays a distinct and coordinated role
* Developing upgrade programs that invite recurring donors to increase their monthly gift at the right moments, and additional-gift appeals timed around key moments like year-end and World Water Day
* Reducing involuntary churn by partnering with RevOps on failed-payment recovery, card updater tools, and payment-method outreach
* Partnering with the paid media team and agency partners on retention and reactivation campaigns, contributing to audience strategy, creative testing, and performance insights
* Collaborating with the direct mail team and vendors on programs for recurring and multi-year donors, providing input on audience selection, messaging, and timelines, and helping analyze results
* Designing and running a disciplined testing roadmap across subject lines, ask amounts, timing, creative, and channel mix, and turning results into lasting improvements
* Partnering with RevOps to build segmentation and reporting that tracks cohort retention, channel performance, and revenue attribution
* Collaborating with Creative to develop compelling donor-facing storytelling that connects supporters to the impact of their giving
* Identifying high-potential donors from recurring and mid-level segments and handing them off to Key Relationships Managers for personal cultivation
* Managing agency and vendor relationships, as well as program budgets and timelines
* Staying current on trends in lifecycle marketing, recurring giving, and nonprofit fundraising, and bringing new ideas to the team

**YOU MUST HAVE…**
------------------

* 4–6 years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or digital fundraising marketing, with a track record of measurably improving retention or donor value
* Hands-on experience running programs across at least three of these channels: email, SMS, paid media, direct mail
* Experience building automated journeys in an email or marketing automation platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Marketo, Klaviyo, HubSpot)
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to segment audiences, read test results, and make decisions
* Excellent writing skills and a sharp instinct for what makes a message land
* Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines
* A passion for charity: water's mission and a genuine interest in the people who support it

**IT'S AN ADDED PLUS IF YOU HAVE…**
-----------------------------------

* Experience with recurring or subscription programs, whether in the nonprofit sector or at a subscription business
* Channel-specific experience in direct mail fundraising (including lettershops and list vendors) or SMS platforms and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with Salesforce NPSP, Iterable, JIRA, SQL, or data visualization tools like Looker or Tableau

**YOU'LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF…**
----------------------------

**You're obsessed with the donor experience**

You think about the whole journey, not just the next send. You want every supporter to feel appreciated, informed, and connected to the impact they're making.

  

**You're data-driven but story-led**

You let the numbers guide your decisions, but you know that retention is ultimately about emotion and connection. You balance rigorous testing with great storytelling.

  

**You think in systems**

You build programs that scale and improve over time, not one-off campaigns. You spot gaps in the journey and fix them.

  

**You're a strong collaborator**

You work well across teams and can rally creative, data, and fundraising partners around shared goals.

  

**You're a self-starter**

You're organized and proactive, and you take ownership of results without needing to be told what to do next.

The Marketing & Partnerships team is a deeply passionate and highly skilled group of storytellers, marketers, and makers. **About the Team**
------------------

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

As a Senior Manager, Content Amplification at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are here to… help us create an entertaining betting proposition that appeals to Fanatics customers. Reporting into the Director of Sportsbook Content, you will play an integral role in the Sportsbook Content team, as well as the wider Fanatics Betting & Gaming. Sportsbook Content Analysts will work to prepare and manage a range of daily custom offers that differentiate the Sportsbook and integrate seamlessly with the features of the Fanatics Betting & Gaming product.

**The Role**

Own the paid amplification layer that supports organic content and creator output. This role takes what's produced by the content and creator teams and makes sure it reaches scale through smart amplification. The mandate is awareness and share of voice.

What You'll Own

**Amplification Strategy & Execution**

* Run boosting across owned, creator, and aggregate accounts, prioritizing spend against content that's already showing organic traction
* Build and operate the programmatic amplification engine that fires off real-time performance thresholds, in lockstep with the Programming/Real-Time Response function
* Set and manage the paid boosting budget as part of the Senior Director's annual portfolio, forecasting spend against content calendar and moment-driven opportunities
* Prioritize CPM-based media buys over CPA/CPC structures. This role is bought for reach efficiency and brand exposure, not click or install performance, and should be evaluated on cost per thousand impressions against benchmark, not cost per acquisition
* Split amplification spend and reporting across the two brand mandates, Fanatics Sports & Casino and Fanatics App, so awareness lift can be attributed to each rather than blended into a single top-line number

**Measurement**

* Report against reach, non-follower reach, engagement, and share of voice, the same scoreboard the Senior Director owns, not payback or CPA
* Build a clean read on amplification's contribution to unaided awareness, separate from any conversion-tied media
* Maintain the boundary: no SUO, promo code, or conversion mechanic runs through this budget. Anything with a payback requirement gets routed to Performance Media, full stop
* Goaled on CPM efficiency and reach delivery against target, not conversion volume. Any deal structured on CPA, CPC, or revenue share gets flagged and routed to Performance Media rather than counted toward this role's targets
* Track unaided awareness and brand favorability lift for Fanatics Sports & Casino and Fanatics App as the primary success metrics, with share of voice and non-follower reach as leading indicators between brand studies
* Report media efficiency in CPM terms against category benchmarks (sportsbook, casino, and broader app-based competitors), not against payback multiples

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with Performance Media on shared platforms (paid social, CTV/OLV) where buying responsibility is split, per existing delineation guidelines
* Coordinate with Creator & Talent on which creator content gets amplification support and at what threshold

**What You'll Bring**

* 4+ years in paid social or programmatic media buying, with direct experience in reach/awareness-oriented (CPM) buying rather than performance/direct response
* Experience building or operating a programmatic, rules-based amplification engine triggered by performance thresholds
* Fluency in reach, non-follower reach, engagement, and share of voice as primary success metrics, and comfort being evaluated on CPM efficiency rather than CPA/CPC
* Experience managing a paid media budget and forecasting spend against a content calendar
* Judgment to flag and route any CPA, CPC, or revenue-share-structured deal to Performance Media rather than absorbing it into this budget
* Experience in sports, betting, gaming, or a comparable fast-moving consumer category is a plus

description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Senior Director, Marketing & AI Innovation

### **What You Will Be Doing**

Brand without performance accountability is positioning. Performance without brand coherence is noise. This role exists at that intersection. You will *design* and *orchestrate* omnichannel campaigns across web, email, and social that build brand presence and move measurable business metrics, using agencies and freelancers as execution arms while you own the strategy, the brief, and the outcome. You will also serve as the brand intelligence layer for paid media, feeding creative direction and audience signal to the teams running paid so that owned and paid tell the same story and reinforce each other.

### **What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* Design omnichannel campaigns with a defined performance thesis: what the campaign is supposed to move, how each channel contributes to that movement, and how the audience journey connects web, email, and social into a single arc rather than parallel activations.
* Own AEO and SEO strategy as a performance lever, not a hygiene function. Define how the brand wins organic discovery, brief agencies to execute against that architecture, and hold them accountable to rankings, traffic quality, and content performance.
* Conceive social media campaigns with measurable intent, then direct creative agencies to execute with fidelity to the original strategy. Organic social is the proof of brand voice; you own what it says and what it is trying to do.
* Own always-on email as the highest-accountability channel in the mix: lifecycle architecture, segmentation logic, automation sequences, deliverability, and performance. This is where brand investment converts to relationship, and you treat it accordingly.
* Brief web agencies on messaging hierarchy, page intent, and conversion narrative. The brief is your product; the agency executes it.
* Quantify brand performance: share of voice, earned mentions, amplification rates, sentiment movement, and how those signals correlate with downstream pipeline or revenue metrics. Present brand health as a business argument, not a marketing report.
* Supply paid media teams with creative strategy, audience insights, and messaging frameworks drawn from owned channel performance, so that paid amplification reflects what is actually working, not what looks good in a deck.

### **Requirements**

* 3 to 6 years in brand, content, or *digital* marketing with a clear throughline of performance accountability: roles where you were measured on outcomes, not output.
* Proven ability to architect campaigns that operate across owned channels simultaneously, with the discipline to define how each channel's job is distinct and how they compound.
* Strong AEO and SEO strategic fluency, including an understanding of how large language models and answer engines are reshaping organic brand discovery.
* Agency management experience with *evidence* that your briefs produced sharp, on-strategy work, not just adequate work.
* Deep operational ownership of email as a performance channel: you have built lifecycle programs, optimized sequences, and reported on email's contribution to business outcomes.
* Ability to connect brand metrics to business metrics. You can explain why share of voice moved, what drove it, and what it is worth.
* Educational Requirements: Bachelor's in Communication, Journalism, or related Marketing degrees

#### **You Are Not the Right Fit If**

* You think brand and performance are different teams' problems.
* You measure success by what you produced rather than what it moved.
* You let agency interpretation substitute for strategic clarity in your briefs.

US - Remote

**About the Role:**

IPSY is looking for a VP, Lifecycle Marketing and Member Engagement to own the strategy for how we engage members from first touch through long-term retention. This role owns the measurement framework, the team, and the operating model that make personalized member engagement work.  
  
You'll define the engagement strategy and the segmentation approach behind it, build the measurement infrastructure to prove CRM's value to the business, and lead a team that includes the loyalty program, email, mobile, site marketing, retention, win-back strategies, and supporting specialists. This is a leadership role. You set the targets, the operating model, and the culture.  
  
The right person is a strategist and a leader who knows MarTech well and can serve as a coach and player. You've built measurement programs that proved CRM's contribution to the business. You've earned credibility for CRM teams in companies where the channel was undervalued. You want to do it again.  
  
IPSY has a great deal of first-party data, a loyal member base, and a real opportunity to build one of the best lifecycle marketing programs in the beauty industry. This role will shape what that looks like.

**This position reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and is ideally hybrid from Santa Monica, CA or Pembroke Pines, FL, OR can be fully remote for the right fit.**

**What You'll Be Doing:**

Strategy and Vision

* Define the member engagement strategy: how member journeys map to channels, what role each channel plays, and how contact strategy evolves as the business grows. Channels include email, push, SMS, site/app, direct mail and more.
* Own the member segmentation framework: who the audiences are, how they're built, what triggers movement between segments. Make sure it's applied consistently across campaigns, product, and CRM programs.
* Set the vision for IPSY's loyalty program, including the ongoing evolution of IPSY Rewards, in partnership with the Senior Director and relevant team leads.

Measurement and Business Ownership

* Own Lifecycle Marketing's measurement framework: define what the org measures against, guide holdout and attribution infrastructure, and establish the reporting that proves CRM's contribution to the business.
* Own Lifecycle Marketing's financial narrative, budget, and performance targets. Represent the function's business case at the leadership level.
* Build a team and grow a culture that tests, measures, and learns from results rather than just reporting them.

Team and Organization

* Build and lead the lifecycle marketing org. Define the team structure, shape the Director role, and make headcount and capability cases as the program matures.
* Drive the team's operating culture: Put the consumer at the center of everything we do, consistently learn through smart testing strategies, and be data-driven in all recommendations and decisions.

Technology and Architecture

* Own the architecture vision for the MarTech stack: what the technology needs to do, whether current tools (Iterable, Segment) are the right long-term answer, and what scalable infrastructure looks like.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Represent lifecycle marketing at the leadership table. Negotiate priorities with peer leaders across Growth, Product, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Creative, and Merchandising.
* Own the boundary with Acquisition/Growth: define where acquisition ends and lifecycle begins, and make sure hand-offs between the two are clean.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 15+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or engagement marketing, with increasing leadership scope. Experience in subscription, paid membership, or DTC ecommerce strongly preferred.
* Track record of building measurement frameworks that proved CRM's value to the business: revenue attribution, holdout testing, incrementality, or whatever the right model was for that business.
* Experience earning credibility for CRM in companies where the channel was undervalued or under-measured.
* Strong grasp of MarTech architecture: ESPs, CDPs, personalization and testing tools, data pipelines. You've led architecture evaluations and know how to ask the right questions even when you're not the one configuring the tools.
* Experience building and scaling lifecycle marketing teams: org design, hiring, developing senior ICs and people managers.
* Significant loyalty program experience: launching, scaling, or materially improving a loyalty or rewards program.
* Strong cross-functional operator. You've negotiated priorities with peer leaders and represented your function's interests at the leadership level.

title: Portfolio Marketing Manager
description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation's most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we're redefining what's possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We're proud to be recognized as one of Houston's fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we've created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that's transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let's transform healthcare together.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Prescribers put their name on every prescription, and they count on us to deliver the right medication, made right and on time. Our medications reach patients through prescribers, clinics, and telehealth partners. Many compounders work with the same molecules, and compliance shapes what we can say. That makes execution the difference: launches that land on schedule, pricing that protects margin, provider tools the field relies on, and prescriber-facing pages that convert.

As Product Marketing Manager, you'll own one to two therapy lines with real revenue attached from day one, in areas such as hormone health, sexual health, aesthetics, and longevity. You'll run launches end to end, keep the scorecard, execute pricing, and equip our sales team and partners to win. You'll report to the Senior Director, Product Marketing, and work within the category strategy, pricing structure, and formulary roadmap that role sets.

This is a hands-on role with room to grow. You'll work close to pricing and portfolio decisions, own the commercial metrics behind your lines, and help shape how we launch, with AI built into the workflow. It's experience that prepares you for broader category and portfolio leadership, at a company where marketing has a seat at the growth table.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Launch Execution**

* Launch Management: Run launches in your therapy lines from workback plan to post-launch readout. Coordinate Clinical, Pharmacy Operations, Quality, and Regulatory at each step, and bring a clear recommendation to the go/no-go decision.
* Launch Materials: Build provider materials, clinical reference resources developed with Medical Affairs, partner announcements, and web content. Carry each piece through Medical Affairs, Regulatory, and Legal review while keeping it clear and useful.
* Launch Readouts: Track script volume, provider adoption, partner uptake, and reorders after each launch, then report results with recommended next steps.

**Pricing Support**

* Price Execution: Implement pricing updates, bundles, and clinic volume tiers within the established pricing structure across the 503A and 503B channels.
* Price Monitoring: Run regular competitive price checks across compounders and telehealth platforms in your therapy lines.
* Margin Tracking: Monitor margin and partner economics, and catch margin erosion, unplanned discounting, and pricing risks early.

**Category Scorecard**

* Performance Tracking: Maintain the scorecard for your therapy lines: script volume, provider acquisition and retention, reorder rates, and margin. Report monthly on what's changing, why, and what to do about it.
* Roadmap Inputs: Build the market research, competitive sizing, and demand signals behind new formulation business cases and forecasts, and use them to inform the formulary roadmap.
* Field Intelligence: Join sales calls and provider conversations, review win/loss notes, and turn what you learn into messaging, pricing, and roadmap recommendations.

**Provider and Partner Enablement**

* Sales Tools: Build battlecards, objection-handling guides, proof points, and pitch support with the sales team, and keep them current.
* Partner Enablement: Create launch kits, onboarding materials, and ordering resources that help telehealth platforms and clinic partners bring your therapy lines to their prescribers.
* Compliant Copy: Draft copy and new claims with Medical Affairs and Regulatory, carry them through MLR review, and turn approved language into pre-cleared language the team can reuse. Write for what's approvable from the first draft.
* Web Content: Keep your prescriber- and partner-facing therapy line pages current, accurate, compliant, and built to convert as products and pricing evolve.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS**

* Exceptional writing: a core part of this role is distilling complex clinical and commercial information into clear, concise copy that busy providers and sales teams act on.
* Disciplined project management: you run multiple launches, review cycles, and web updates in parallel, keeping timelines, owners, and dependencies visible.
* Fluency with AI as a daily working tool across drafting, research, competitive analysis, and managing multiple workstreams, paired with the judgment to validate its output for accuracy, compliance, and quality before it goes anywhere.
* Comfortable building where the playbook is still being written: you bring structure to open questions, make sound calls with the information available, and adjust quickly as the category evolves.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in marketing, including at least 3 years in brand, product, or category marketing at a pharma, healthcare, telehealth, or wellness company, or at a healthcare agency.
* Experience marketing to or through healthcare professionals, such as providers, clinicians, or B2B buyers, and a clear understanding of how that differs from consumer marketing.
* Experience taking work through medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review, with the skill to keep copy sharp through the process.
* A track record of finished work: launches you ran, sales materials the field used, and campaigns you carried from brief to results.
* Strongly preferred: experience in one or more of our therapy lines, including Hormone Replacement, Men's Health, Women's Health, Sexual Health, Aesthetics, or Longevity.
* A plus: experience in Weight Management, including GLP-1 therapies, alongside one of the areas above.

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
* Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
* Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
* Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
* Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
* Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
* Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
* Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
* Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

**Values:**

* People: Empowering people defines who we are.
* Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
* Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
* Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

**Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:**

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more: https://careers.empowerpharmacy.com/benefits/

**Physical Requirements:**

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Within our Teacher Education Ecosystem, including Moreland University, we connect with aspiring and current educators, alumni, and school leaders to support their professional journeys. Social media helps us build authentic relationships with these audiences and connect them with valuable resources and opportunities.

**Before you apply...please read this!**

This position is intended for experienced social media marketing professionals who have successfully managed and grown social media accounts for businesses or organizations. **We are not seeking influencers or UGC only content creators whose primary experience is managing personal social media accounts.** A professional social media portfolio is required to be considered for this position. Your portfolio must showcase actual social media work created or managed for businesses or organizations, ideally including measurable results. Personal Instagram, TikTok, or LinkedIn profiles do not qualify as professional portfolios. Applications submitted without a professional social media portfolio will not be considered. IF this fits you, please carry on!!

**Come Build What’s Next**

We’re looking for a Social Media Managerto lead and grow the organic social media presence of Colibri Group’s Teacher Education Ecosystem. This person will shape how our brands show up across social channels, bring educator-focused stories and campaigns to life, build engaged communities, and use performance insights to support awareness, qualified traffic, leads, and applications.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with meaningful ownership of social strategy, day-to-day content production, community engagement, social measurement, and the management of our existing influencer program. As a general guide, approximately 50% of the role is content creation, 25% is social strategy, and 25% spans analytics, reporting, and influencer-program work. The balance will shift with campaigns and business priorities.

We’re looking for someone who has managed social media on behalf of a company, organization, or agency client and understands what it means to collaborate with a marketing team and be accountable for KPIs. You should be equally comfortable developing a channel plan, filming and editing a short-form video, speaking on camera, tailoring content for different audiences, engaging with followers, and explaining what the performance data says to do next.

**Important distinction:** This is a professional social media management position, **not an influencer, brand ambassador, or personal-content-creator opportunity**. You will manage Moreland University's owned social channels and work with external influencers as partners; you will not be hired to promote our brands primarily through your own personal accounts.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Own organic social strategy and editorial planning:** Build audience-specific strategies and content calendars across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging channels. Prioritize Instagram and TikTok for educator audiences, tailor LinkedIn content for school leaders and alumni, and explore authentic, non-promotional participation in relevant Reddit communities. Translate wider Marketing initiatives into platform-native campaigns
* **Create content hands-on, with a strong emphasis on short-form video:** Personally concept, script, film, edit, caption, and publish videos; appear confidently in talking-head content and social live events. Independently produce graphics, carousels, stories, and copy using tools such as Canva, collaborate with the Graphic Designer on brand consistency, and develop social assets to promote guides, events, and podcasts (without hosting the podcast)
* **Build and serve engaged communities:** Manage organic social accounts day to day, including comments, DMs, tags, audience conversations, and admissions-related questions that need routing to the appropriate team. Proactively identify educator and school-leader stories and opportunities for meaningful engagement, not merely one-way posting
* **Measure performance and continually improve results:** Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement, video performance, website traffic, leads, guide downloads, and applications attributable to organic social. Use reporting, experiments, and audience insights to refine creative decisions and channel priorities; demonstrate how social contributes to integrated marketing goals
* **Manage influencer partnerships and collaborate across Marketing:** Oversee existing external creators, including briefs, content review, approvals, deliverables, renewals, payment coordination, budgets, and ROI. Recommend when to expand, adjust, or pause partnerships. Partner closely with content, design, and paid media colleagues; direct management of paid advertising is not part of this position. Occasionally support events and content opportunities requiring travel

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Professional organizational social media experience:** Approximately 2–4 years managing organic social accounts for an employer, organization, or agency client, with personal ownership of deliverables and accountability for KPIs. Managing only your own personal influencer accounts does not meet this requirement; additional relevant professional experience is welcome
* **Proven creation and on-camera skills:** Direct experience independently planning, filming, editing, and publishing compelling short-form video for a brand, plus the ability to appear on camera and support live social content. Strong social copywriting and hands-on Canva, Capcut, or comparable design skills are also expected
* **Demonstrated growth and analytical judgment:** Evidence that you have grown audiences, not solely maintained existing accounts; ability to explain the KPIs you owned, results you achieved, and changes you made based on data. Familiarity with engagement, website traffic, lead or application attribution, and testing is valuable
* **Audience-focused collaboration and execution:** Experience adapting tone, formats, and channels for distinct audiences; engaging communities through comments and DMs; and working within a marketing team to manage a busy editorial calendar, multiple priorities, and cross-functional projects
* **Required professional portfolio:** Include an accessible portfolio link or relevant work samples showing organizational/client accounts, short-form videos you personally produced, and ideally measurable outcomes. Redacted or anonymized case studies are welcome for confidential work. Education/edtech experience, previous influencer-program coordination, Reddit knowledge, a related bachelor's degree, and familiarity with tools such as Sprout Social or ClickUp are helpful but not required. Occasional travel may be necessary

**Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use**

Experience with every tool below is not required. We care more about your ability to create strong work, manage the process, and make decisions from results than about checking specific software boxes.

* **Social channels:** Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and Reddit or other educator communities
* **Video creation:** CapCut or comparable filming and editing workflows. The team is open to effective tools you already know and use
* **Design and production:** Canva, Capcut, and brand templates or design review with an in-house Graphic Designer
* **Scheduling, analytics, and collaboration:** Sprout Social or comparable social management and native analytics tools; ClickUp or similar project-management platforms
* **Measurement and improvement:** Reporting dashboards, campaign tracking, tests, performance reviews, and thoughtful use of AI for ideation, research, repurposing, or productivity while maintaining originality and brand standards

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Own the organic social presence of a mission-driven education ecosystem and shape how our brands show up online
* Create original, video-first content and tell relevant stories for teachers, future educators, alumni, and school leaders
* Grow priority channels such as Instagram and TikTok while testing thoughtful community opportunities, including Reddit
* Collaborate with content, design, and marketing colleagues while retaining autonomy over day-to-day creative execution
* Connect creative work to measurable engagement, leads, and applications while helping evolve an established influencer-partnership program

**We Encourage You to Apply**

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants with relevant experience in education, edtech, consumer brands, nonprofit or mission-driven organizations, corporate, and other environments where they have managed professional social channels, served distinct audiences, and delivered measurable results.

However, this position does require professional responsibility for an organization’s or client’s social presence, hands-on short-form video creation, comfort contributing on camera, and the ability to assess performance against KPIs. If your experience has primarily been creating content for your own personal influencer accounts, without managing an organization’s or client’s channels and results, this role is unlikely to be the right match.

A professional social media portfolio or relevant work samples must be included with your application to be considered. Please share a working link to campaigns, social accounts, video examples, or case studies that demonstrate your direct work and impact. If your work is confidential, you may submit redacted or anonymized case studies and examples that respect client or employer requirements.

If you enjoy creating content yourself, collaborating within a marketing team, using data to make it better, and helping real communities connect with an education brand, we would love to hear from you.

**Please do not submit your application more than once.**

**What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process**

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next. We do not use AI to review applications; your application is reviewed by a human on the Talent Acquisition team. While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:

1. **Recruiter Conversation:** An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition about your professional social media background, interests, expectations, and fit for this position

2. **Hiring Manager Conversation:** A deeper conversation with the Senior Director of Marketing, including review of your work, approach to short-form video, audience segmentation, strategy, and results

3. **Team / Cross-Functional Conversation:** A conversation with team members, focused on collaboration and the capabilities relevant to day-to-day success in this role

4. **Final Conversation and Decision:** A final conversation with the team. For finalists, there may be an optional opportunity to connect with additional content teammates. Talent Acquisition will share details and preparation expectations throughout the process.

**Application deadline: Tuesday, October 20th, 2026.**

Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.

**Our Commitment to Inclusion**

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director Of Digital Marketing - TN
description:
**Title**: Director of Digital Marketing  
**Reports To:** President/CEO  
**Location:** Bellingham, WA, Waynesboro, TN, or Vancouver, WA (negotiable)

*This is a single position posted at all of our locations, Bellingham, WA, Vancouver, WA, and Waynesboro, TN. We will hire in whichever location produces the strongest candidate.*  
**Department:** Marketing

**Salary:** $150k - $180k annual base salary for the initial six months, with transition to an attractive incentive-based compensation package designed to reward performance and contribution.

  

**About Us**

Seeking Health is a nutritional supplement company built on education. We help people understand their health, then direct them to the solutions that fit. When people are well informed, they choose well, and they stay with us for life.

We have grown 20% year over year, with $50M in total revenue across multiple channels, by putting scientific integrity and customer education ahead of typical marketing tactics.

**Our Core Values**

***Create Customers for Life • Take Purposeful Action • Embrace Sudden Change • Collaborative Effort • Never Settle • Be You***

* **Create Customers for Life:** First, we listen to our customers. Then, we make decisions which amplify our customers' success.
* **Take Purposeful Action:** A diversity of opinion is balanced with the need to make and implement decisions. Believe in yourself to make a timely decision that supports the overall mission of the company.
* **Embrace Sudden Change:** There is no innovation if you operate out of fear of the new or untested.
* **Collaborative Effort:** Together, we minimize our individual weaknesses and amplify each other's strengths.
* **Never Settle:** We take every opportunity to optimize. Do what you need to do to make things better. Then make those things great.
* **Be You:** Always be authentic.

Read more: https://www.seekinghealth.com/pages/core-values

**The Role**

Own our $17M direct-to-consumer channel and grow it through education. You will lead SEO, email, YouTube and content, e-commerce, and paid media with one goal: help more people understand their health and find the right solution at the right time. You will build and lead a team that listens to customers, acts on data, uses AI well, and keeps improving every metric.

  

**Your Mission**

Grow our DTC business profitably through education, with a clear CAC and ROAS bar for every channel. Raise customer lifetime value by connecting people to the right product the first time. Transform our DTC business from $17M to $30M+ while improving unit economics and customer lifetime value.

  

**Year One Goals**

* Raise blended ROAS and lower CAC against agreed thresholds within the first 90 days.
* Grow DTC revenue 20% at or above target contribution margin.
* Reduce product mismatch by guiding more customers to the right product, using our product-match quiz.
* Grow organic traffic and YouTube-to-site conversion.
* Lift repeat purchase and subscription rates.
* Build the DTC marketing team with clear ownership of each channel.

  

Drive $5-8M incremental DTC revenue, improve ROI 20%+ across channels, establish us as the go-to educational authority in our space, build a world-class marketing team, and create a scalable foundation for continued growth.

  

**What You’ll Do**

**Education-First Campaigns:** Turn complex nutritional science into clear education that helps people understand their health and find the right solution. Lead content across YouTube, blogs, guides, email and social, working with Dr. Lynch and the content team. Oversee SEO, email automation and paid media, which exist to bring educated people to our content.

**DTC Growth Leadership:** Own the P&L and growth plan for our $17M DTC business. Build financial models for CAC, LTV, channel contribution and margin. Set and hold a clear ROAS and CAC bar for every channel. Partner directly with the CEO on growth initiatives.

**E-commerce Excellence:** Own the digital customer journey from first visit to loyal customer. Improve conversion, retention and subscription. Use our product-match quiz and guides so every customer lands on the right product. Work with e-commerce operations on platform excellence.

**Multi-Channel Collaboration:** Work with retail, wholesale and Amazon teams for consistent brand and education across channels, while running DTC as its own high-growth channel. Share insights and use our total company scale ($50M) for better vendor relationships and testing.

**AI-Driven Innovation:** Use AI to personalize education, segment customers, speed up content, and improve targeting and spend efficiency. Test boldly, measure honestly, keep what works.

**Analytics & Optimization:** Define OKRs and report DTC performance, ROI and efficiency. Own attribution, incrementality testing and the marketing tech stack, with a focus on getting full value from every tool.

**Team Building:** Recruit, develop and lead the DTC marketing team, [including existing paid media, SEO and content staff]. Build a culture of collaboration, purposeful action and never settling.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of progressive digital marketing experience; 3+ years leading teams at DTC brands doing $17M+ in revenue
* Proven track record growing DTC revenue profitably, with disciplined CAC, ROAS and margin management
* Experience marketing health products that need customer education (supplements, functional medicine, health optimization), including working within FDA and FTC rules on health claims
* Experience building or running education-led marketing: expert-led content, video (YouTube), SEO, email and lead nurture
* Experience working with a physician, scientist or founder as the public voice of a brand
* Deep technical expertise in SEO/SEM, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, attribution modeling and funnel optimization

**In this role, you'll:**

**Strategic Branding & Marketing Communications**

* Through cross functional collaboration and partnership, ensure the brand story is promulgated across all touchpoints including customer communications, website, e-commerce and other digital platforms, sales, direct mail and email

* Oversee product marketing for new and existing offerings, ensuring positioning, messaging, and commercialization strategies maximize customer acquisition and lifetime value.
* Leveraging a playbook of traditional and innovative tactics, drive awareness and consideration of gFiber in incumbent, acquired and expansion markets
* Evolve brand and consumer insights focus group research program, including execution, analysis and implications of quantitative and qualitative feedback

  

**Social Channel, Digital Advocacy & GEO/LLM Development**

* Drive innovation and impact in social media, elevating the channel as a key communications, awareness, consideration and growth platform
* Establish innovative internal and external influencer strategy
* In collaboration with Digital team, advocate for and support digital-first brand principles, with special attention on the gFiber App
* Build out organizational competency for blog, education and digital platform content to optimize LLM-geared GEO strategy

  

**Executive and External Communications**

* Lead professional team responsible for press, public relations and executive communication strategies, developing high-stakes communications, presentations, and creative assets, identifying and mitigating risks, and uncovering new opportunities for exposure
* Provide leadership to cross functional communications task force, addressing needs in customer education, operations and growth

  

**Operational Excellence & Team Management**

* Increase productivity and impact of brand efforts, driving efficiencies across production, agency and other spending categories
* Manage Cross-Functional Alignment across Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Legal to ensure brand and communication initiatives meet strategic, financial, and compliance objectives.
* Lead team of 20+ employed and contracted marketing professionals as well as multiple agencies.

**At a minimum, we would like you to have:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of progressive leadership experience in brand strategy, product marketing, growth marketing, communications or a related field for a consumer product, B2C technology or B2C telecommunications company.
* Demonstrated ability to drive consensus and execute complex programs in a highly ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated experience operating at an executive level, with a track record of driving strategic outcomes through direct engagement with C-suite leadership.

**It's preferred that you have:**

* MBA or a Master's degree in a related field (e.g., Marketing, Strategy, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, General Management, Communications, Psychology, Analytics)
* 7 years marketing experience in a consumer enterprise with a recurring revenue business model
* Business line leader with proven track record of customer growth or P&L responsibility
* Demonstrated fluency in digital marketing
* Experience in consumer product positioning, marketing, and/or packaging a plus
* Experience in both B2C and B2B environments
* Prefer candidate who lives in one of gFiber serviceable metro areas

  
  

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $350,000 - $375,000 + bonus + benefits. As pay varies by location, your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.

title: Director of Production
description:
**Keep Growing with Nutrafol**
------------------------------

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients - and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too - by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

#### **About you:**

Nutrafol's in-house Creative team makes everything from brand campaigns and product photography to performance ads, social content, and retail assets. As our Director of Production, you'll own how all of that work from a photography, casting and film standpoint gets made: the budgets, expenses. the schedules, the partners, and the shoot days.

This is a senior individual contributor role to start. You won't have direct reports at first. Instead, you'll lead through a network of production companies, agencies, photographers, directors, and freelancers, and through close partnership with our in-house creatives. You'll build the production function from the ground up, set the standards, and help shape how the team grows.

#### **What You'll Do:**

**Own production end to end**

* Lead production for all photo, video, and content shoots across brand, performance marketing, social, e-commerce, and retail.
* Take projects from brief to delivery: scoping, bidding, pre-production, on-set leadership, post-production, and final asset handoff.
* Act as producer on key shoots, and make sure every other shoot has the right producer.

**Manage budgets and partners**

* Build and manage the annual production budget, plus a budget for each project. Track actuals and report on spend to the SVP, Creative.
* Find, vet, and manage a roster of production companies, agencies, directors, photographers, editors, post houses, and freelance crew.
* Run bids, negotiate rates and contracts, and get the most value out of every dollar without lowering the quality of the work.
* Work with Legal and Procurement on SOWs, vendor agreements, and payments.

**Build the operating model**

* Design and run the production calendar across all creative work, balancing what the business needs with the team's capacity.
* Create repeatable workflows, templates, and best practices: production books, call sheets, approval steps, and delivery specs.
* Find ways to make more content more efficiently, such as shoots that serve several channels at once, modular content systems, and in-house studio capabilities.
* Look at and adopt new tools, including AI-assisted production and post-production workflows, where they make the work better or faster.

**Protect the brand and the business**

* Manage talent, model, and influencer usage rights, releases, and renewals. Keep a clear record of where and how long each asset can run.
* Make sure productions follow union rules (SAG-AFTRA and others where they apply), location permits, insurance, and on-set safety.
* Partner with Legal and Regulatory early in the process so that claims, testimonials, and before-and-after content meet our standards for a health and wellness brand.
* Oversee how finished assets are organized, labeled, and stored in our DAM so the whole company can find and use them.

**Partner across the company**

* Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Designers, Copywriters, and Brand teams so the work looks the way it was meant to.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-commerce, Retail, and Product Marketing to understand what assets they need and when.
* Bring production feasibility, cost, and timing into the conversation early, during concept development.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 10+ years of production experience, with at least 3 years at a senior producer, head of production, or director level.
* Experience at an in-house brand team, a creative agency, or a production company. Ideally a mix.
* A track record of producing large-scale photo and video campaigns as well as high-volume content for performance and social channels.
* Strong budget management skills, with experience owning a multimillion-dollar annual production budget.
* A deep network of production partners, crew, and talent, and the judgment to match the right partner to each project.
* Working knowledge of talent contracts, usage rights, union rules, and production insurance.
* Experience setting up production processes and systems where none existed.
* Clear, calm communication with creatives, executives, and vendors, especially when plans change on set.
* Comfort leading through influence. You get things done without direct reports.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in beauty, wellness, CPG, or another regulated category where claims and before-and-after imagery need legal review.
* Experience building or running an in-house studio.
* Familiarity with project management and DAM tools (e.g., Airtable, Asana, Monday, Bynder, Frame.io).
* Experience growing a production team over time.

Nutrafol takes into consideration a wide range of factors in final compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package.

Salary Range:

$160,000 - $170,000 USD

#### **Perks & Benefits**

* Fully remote work experience
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package, including FSA/HSA program
* 401K with employer match
* Quarterly Bonus Program
* Flexible PTO
* Two company-wide wellness breaks every day
* Free lunch on us every Tuesday and Thursday via Seamless/Grubhub
* Monthly wellness stipend
* Monthly internet stipend
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Annual learning & development stipend
* Free meditation app membership (Headspace)
* Free monthly Nutrafol subscription
* Pet insurance discounts and benefits

*California residents may review our CCPA* *notice**.*

title: Cokesbury Kids Director
description:
**JOB SUMMARY**
===============

The **Director of Cokesbury Kids** is the designated team leader for the strategic and daily operations and planning for UMPH-published Cokesbury Kids programs, with accountability for the performance of the business unit team in meeting the needs of markets served by the programs, improving present processes, developing new processes to accomplish the work of the team, and working with other internal units in support of financial goals for Cokesbury Kids. The incumbent supervises and coordinates Cokesbury Kids product planning, theme and content development, manuscript acquisition, editorial development, marketing, and business planning of Cokesbury Kids resources to serve The United Methodist Church and other markets.

**ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT & AREAS OF IMPACT**
============================================

**Reporting Relationship & Peers**
----------------------------------

Reports to the Associate Publisher, as do:

* Associate Editor
* Associate Editor / Project Coordinator
* Cokesbury Kids Team Lead
* Editorial Assistant
* Lead Editor
* Media Editor
* Production & Design Manager(s)
* Production Manager

**Reporting to This Job**
-------------------------

### *EXEMPT*

* Indirect supervision (7)

### *NON-EXEMPT*

* Indirect supervision (1)

### *EXTERNAL*

* Various contractors

**Areas of Impact (as applicable)**
-----------------------------------

### *SALES BUDGET*

* $2.2 M

### *DEPARTMENT OPERATING BUDGET*

* $50,000 (portion of department budget this position administers)

**RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE**
============================

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

### ***PRIMARY***

* Leads the Cokesbury Kids team in developing and implementing an annual publishing, marketing, and promotional plan to assure achievement of financial budgets, targets, and objectives for sales, expenses, cost of goods, inventory levels, and net contribution.
* Directs and guides the editorial stages of production for the 100-plus components of VBS from development through point of delivery of the product to the printer. Writes original content, directs editing of manuscripts, and manages their development through the editorial production process by analyzing structure and content, comparing formats and appeal to competitor products, and appraising and improving readability and format. Leads the editorial team in monitoring the biblical and theological quality and consistency of within Cokesbury Kids resources (with an emphasis on VBS), looking for both compatibility with United Methodist teachings and breadth that allows broader use by other mainline denominations.
* Leads the theme and content development process for VBS and related programs, including customer summits and focus groups, story consultations, and other forms of research.
* Coordinates with the Business Manager, Marketing Manager, Buyer, and editorial staff to create business plans that present product lines designed to meet sales and cost-of-goods targets, optimize inventory, and offer new products that fit audience market interests.

### ***SECONDARY***

* Works with the Marketing Manager to plan and implement competitive promotion and sales campaigns for Cokesbury Kids programs.
* Conducts or supervises product-related workshops and training events as needed.

*These essential job functions are* *not* *intended to cover all work details or the occasional performance of other tasks as assigned by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.*

**Common or Complex Problem-Solving Challenges**
------------------------------------------------

* Achieving the financial objectives for Cokesbury Kids programs in all areas
* Keeping abreast of current trends in Christian education and children’s programming within The United Methodist Church, other constituencies and markets, and secular education markets in order to produce user-friendly resources that sell and are consistent with United Methodist theological and educational standards
* Planning and developing, with the Cokesbury Kids team, dynamic programs and resources to meet or exceed customer expectations and specific UMPH sales and market-penetration goals
* Directing time and available resources to manage more than 100 VBS components through development and production, on time and within budget, while maintaining positive relationships with creators, contract editors and content developers, and internal support units and assuring a high-quality product line
* Working within UMPH-approved policies and business plans to establish schedules, achieve quality standards, and meet sales objectives for the team
* Leading the Cokesbury Kids team in developing general product-line strategies and specific proposals for Cokesbury Kids publishing
* Applying needs and interests of Cokesbury Kids market segments identified through research to product-line development

**Authority & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Authority to collaborate, plan, develop, acquire, and market a range of Cokesbury Kids products to meet editorial, financial, and sales objectives
* Authority to maintain knowledge of customer segments and marketplace trends and to cultivate specific segments in order to increase the customer base
* Authority to develop, implement, and/or review annual strategic plans and individual product-line business plans in consultation with appropriate team members and leaders to support overall UMPH operational objectives
* Accountability for collaborating, developing, and implementing an annual plan to achieve objectives for revenue, expenses, cost of goods, inventory values, inventory turn, net contribution, and other key operational and financial objectives
* Accountability for collaborating with marketing and sales as they develop and implement marketing and promotional plans to achieve financial budgets, targets, and objectives for Cokesbury Kids programs
* Accountability for meeting the editorial, financial, and sales objectives of Cokesbury Kids programs

**Regular Contacts & Stakeholders**
-----------------------------------

### ***INTERNAL***

* Cokesbury Kids team members and other UMPH cross-functional personnel from various units; Business/Buyer team; Marketing team; Sales team; Allied Products team; Digital Production Services; Core Function Managers – provides indirect direction to the Cokesbury Kids leads, media editor, editors, production and design managers, business manager/buyer, and marketing manager

* Contract writers, editors, content developers, and producers; internal and external reviewers/evaluators; United Methodist Curriculum Resources Committee; other external partners and teams as assigned

====================

**Education, Experience, & Certifications**
-------------------------------------------

### ***REQUIRED***

* Bachelor’s degree in business, English, journalism, communications, education, religion, or a related field
* At least five (5) years of experience in publishing, religious education, business management, product development, marketing, or a related field

### ***PREFERRED***

* Master’s degree
* Current or previous participation in Christian education programs within a local congregation

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**
----------------------------------

* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of children’s ministry programs and Cokesbury Kids resources.
* Strategic leadership
* Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills and ability to manage a large cross-functional team.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to make presentations and lead workshops.

title: Director, Digital Experience and Strategy for Enrollment Management
description:
**Position Highlights**

Each year, over one million prospective and current students, school counselors, parents, and other key stakeholders visit and access Enrollment Management digital platforms, obtaining information, interacting with the campus community, scheduling visits, registering for events, requesting information, and applying for admission. The divisional digital platforms (websites, social, digital screens, advertisements, experiential tools) directly influence the enrollment of approximately 5,000 new students annually and provide financial aid information and services to more than 12,000 students.

  

The Director, Digital Experience and Strategy leads and manages all digital projects focused on relationship building between RIT and the prospective student marketplace by aligning digital architecture, content, and experiences with the strategic needs of the prospective student market for admissions, and the prospect and current student market for financial aid. On a day-to-day basis, this position oversees the strategic development and maintenance of digital content and user experiences aimed at making relationship-building simple, experiential, informative, and highly effective. This includes comprehensive management of the admissions and financial aid domains of the rit.edu site, all related content located throughout rit.edu, social media content, and other digital content management. This role also leads the implementation and strategic utilization of generative AI, chat bots, personalized portals, and other advanced digital applications to improve human connectivity and engagement.

  

The position directly reports to the Associate Vice President for Enrollment Marketing and Global Strategic Initiatives. The Director is a critical collaborative partner with the entire Enrollment Management division for new initiatives, supports university-wide efforts in maintaining and continuously improving the rit.edu digital presence, and leads the adoption of digital project management and collaboration tools. The position is integral to ensuring that the division’s web and overall digital media presence is easy to navigate, delivers exceptional service experiences while optimizing resource allocation and reducing costs, and ultimately enhances the division's efficiency and effectiveness. This position requires a sophisticated combination of digital strategy, user experience (UX) and web strategy, technical skills, project management, analytical skills, team leadership, and high-level customer service.

  
  

Key responsibilities include:

* Strategic Digital Leadership: Proven ability to develop and execute long-term digital strategies that drive results, align with institutional goals, and adapt to a dynamic environment; strong business acumen and strategic thinking.
* Comprehensive User Experience (UX) and Web Strategy: Deep expertise in user-centered design principles, research methodologies, and optimizing digital journeys; advanced knowledge of web design, usability, accessibility (ADA compliance), mobile optimization, responsive design, and visual communication.
* Advanced Web and Technical Proficiency: Mastery of modern standards-based web technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, front-end frameworks; specific expertise with Drupal CMS.
* Data-Driven Optimization and Analytics: Demonstrated ability to analyze performance metrics, interpret data for actionable insights, and drive data-informed decisions utilizing tools such as Google Analytics, CrazyEgg, Siteimprove, and BrightEdge SEO; proven experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
* Digital Engagement and CRM Integration: Superb understanding of social media platforms and institution-wide digital content and advertising strategies; experience managing digital customer journeys, specifically with Slate Technolution CRM.
* Project, Vendor, and Operational Management: Demonstrated leadership in digital project management, including leading adoption of project management/collaboration tools; experience overseeing digital initiatives and effectively managing external digital vendors.
* Exceptional Communication and Cross-functional Collaboration: Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts and requirements into clear business solutions for non-technical stakeholders; high-level internal customer service skills.
* Crisis Management and Availability: Experience in crisis communication strategies leveraging digital platforms; availability for off-hour crisis support.
  

  

Preferred education, experience or specialized skills:

  

* Bachelors required/Master’s preferred in Web/Graphic Design, User Experience Design, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, or other related fields.
* Experience in higher education or student recruitment preferred
* Experience leading or building a digital team in a growing or evolving organization.
* Proactive experience monitoring industry trends, technologies, and standards, with the ability to research, recommend, and apply new technologies as they emerge to drive innovation.
* Knowledge of broader customer experience (CX) strategies and tools, and familiarity with additional marketing automation platforms beyond core CRM integration.
* Exceptional troubleshooting skills.

  

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Designs, implements, and assesses the effectiveness of the university marketing and communications strategy. Gathers and prioritizes objectives, sets course of action, and deploys necessary resources
* Conceptualizes and executes multi-channel campaigns to ensure the alignment of communications and messaging across all traditional and non-traditional channels
* Builds and manages long-term relationships among faculty, staff, and alumni. Provides expert consultation and recommends marketing and communication strategies
* Leads, supervises, and mentors professional and paraprofessional staff. Assigns and prioritizes work and provides performance evaluations
* Administers, oversees, and monitors budget planning and expenditures
* Participates as a key member of the division. Collaborates with team members and provides support for department, division, and university initiatives

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Knowledge of communications, public relations, marketing, branding, graphic design, and social media
* Ability to write, proofread, and edit clear, concise, persuasive, and grammatically correct communications
* Ability to translate vision, strategic direction, and long-term goals into communications tasks and projects
